description:
Location: Remote – Philippines

Type: Full-Time

Experience Required: Minimum 24 months on TikTok (content, commerce, or brand management)



About the Role:

We are looking for a results-driven TikTok Shop Specialist to own and grow our TikTok Shop presence. You will manage the full lifecycle of our TikTok commerce operation — from product listings and affiliate programs to live shopping and performance analysis. This role is ideal for someone who lives and breathes TikTok and has a proven track record turning content into sales.





Responsibilities:

-Manage and optimize all TikTok Shop product listings, including titles, descriptions, pricing, and imagery

-Build and maintain the TikTok affiliate program — recruit creators, manage commissions, and track performance

-Plan and execute TikTok Live shopping sessions to drive real-time sales

-Collaborate with content creators and internal teams to develop shoppable video content

-Monitor TikTok Shop analytics and provide weekly performance reports with actionable insights

-Identify trending opportunities within the TikTok ecosystem

-Manage customer inquiries, reviews, and order issues within TikTok Shop

-Stay current on TikTok algorithm updates, Shop policies, and emerging commerce features

-Coordinate with logistics and fulfillment teams to ensure accurate product availability and shipping timelines

-Run and optimize TikTok Shop-sponsored ads and in-app promotions



Requirements

-Minimum 24 months of hands-on TikTok experience (brand account management, TikTok Shop, or content strategy)

-Demonstrated experience managing a TikTok Shop account with measurable sales results

-Strong understanding of TikTok's algorithm, trending content formats, and the For You Page (FYP)

-Experience with TikTok affiliate programs and creator partnerships

-Proficiency in TikTok Seller Center and TikTok Ads Manager

-Strong analytical skills — comfortable reading dashboards and translating data into decisions

-Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

-Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously

-Based in the Philippines with availability to work 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM EST, Monday through Friday



Nice to Have:

-Experience in e-commerce (Amazon, Shopify or similar platforms)

-Familiarity with video editing tools (CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or similar)

-Background in pet, health/wellness, or consumer goods categories

-Experience with influencer marketing platforms (CreatorIQ, Grin, etc.)



What We Offer:

-Competitive salary 

-Fully remote, flexible work environment

-Opportunity to grow with a fast-scaling brand

-Direct collaboration with US-based leadership team

-Performance bonuses tied to TikTok Shop revenue growth

title: Amazon Account Specialist
description:
Join Leap Stores and Become a Key Player at a Growing Amazon Marketing Agency!



Leap Stores is dedicated to helping brands WIN on Amazon. We are a top 1% Amazon Seller and we utilize our listing optimization expertise, creative listing visuals, and proprietary software to skyrocket their sales. Our team is growing and we're looking for a dynamic, data-savvy, and skilled Amazon Account Specialist to jump on board! You will make a big impact as a critical supportive tea
mber to our Brand Manager as you ensure our Amazon listings are optimized and growing.



What You'll Do as an Amazon Account Specialist:



- Own day-to-day catalog operations, including listing creation, variation setup, flat file uploads, and backend troubleshooting

- Monitor Buy Box performance and top ASIN health to ensure revenue stability

- Open, manage, and resolve Seller Central cases, compliance issues, and appeals efficiently

- Conduct routine listing audits to maintain policy compliance and prevent account risk

- Collaborate with the design team to improve creative assets and optimize listings for higher conversion rates

- Launch and manage A/B tests and listing experiments to drive measurable performance improvements

- Manage promotional tools including Virtual Bundles, Lightning Deals, Coupons, and other growth levers

- Monitor returns, A-to-Z claims, chargebacks, customer messages, and seller feedback to protect account health

- Perform keyword research using Brand Analytics and third-party tools to improve ranking and discoverability

- Analyze competitors and identify listing optimization opportunities



What does Success Look Like?



- On-Time Delivery: Complete 90%+ of assigned tasks on or before the agreed-upon due date

- Quality of Work: Maintains under 2% error rate on accuracy, keyword usage, and compliance checks

- Drive conversion rate growth on top listings



What Makes You a Perfect Fit:



- 3+ years of experience with Amazon account management, with a track record of improving metrics like CVR and CTR

- Deep expertise with Amazon Seller Central and Amazon Terms of Service

- Basic-level & understanding of Amazon SEO strategies

- Proactive communicator and a get-it-done attitude

- An analytical mindset and ability to work with data (Microsoft Excel, Pivot Tables, Formulas)

- Proficiency in tools such as Jungle Scout, Keepa, DataDive, Helium 10, Data Rova, Smart Scout

- A self-starter with a detail-oriented approach, ready to take on challenges in a fast-paced environment

- Ability to work 7am-3pm EST, Monday-Friday.



Why Join Leap Stores?



- A culture that values creativity and data-driven results

- Generous Paid Vacation Time and standard Holiday Pay to enjoy work-life balance

- Opportunities for professional growth in a rapidly expanding company

- A competitive salary package, reflective of your contributions

- Trainings and personal development opportunities

- Work from home



How do I apply?



To formally apply for this position, please send a copy of your resume to 
 and use the subject "Your Next Amazon Account Specialist" (don't forget this step).



As an Amazon Account Specialist with Leap Stores, you’ll join a high-performing team focused on execution, accountability, and results. Your expertise will directly impact our brand partners’ growth on the world’s largest e-commerce platform. If you’re ready to take ownership, solve complex challenges, and contribute to a team that’s continuously pushing performance forward, we’d love to connect. Apply today, and let's grow together!

title: Project Coordinator – Commercial Furniture
description:
Project Coordinator – Commercial Furniture



Remote | Philippines | Full-Time



Office Design & Furnishings LLC is a U.S.-based commercial furniture dealer serving government and commercial clients. We are looking for an experienced Project Coordinator with prior U.S. commercial/contract furniture industry experience to join our remote team.



This is not a general virtual assistant position. We are specifically looking for someone who understands how commercial furniture projects move from approved specifications and purchase orders through manufacturer ordering, acknowledgments, delivery, installation, and closeout.



What You'll Do



You will support our project management and operations team with responsibilities that may include:



Review approved furniture specifications, quotes, purchase orders, and project documentation before ordering.

Assist with commercial furniture order entry and processing.

Work with specifications and order information generated through CAP/2020, CET or similar commercial furniture software.

Prepare and process manufacturer/vendor purchase orders.

Review manufacturer order acknowledgments against submitted orders.

Identify discrepancies involving model numbers, quantities, finishes, pricing, freight, ship-to information, and delivery dates.

Track orders, acknowledgments, production status, lead times, estimated ship dates, and deliveries.

Follow up with manufacturers and vendors regarding order status and discrepancies.

Maintain accurate project and order documentation.

Coordinate information between project managers, specifiers, manufacturers, installers, and other project partners.

Assist with delivery and installation scheduling.

Track project issues, punch items, replacements, and warranty items.

Maintain project status and documentation within our project management systems.

Escalate order discrepancies, delays, and other risks to the Project Manager.

Experience We're Looking For



Prior experience with U.S. commercial/contract furniture is strongly preferred.



Ideal candidates may have previously worked for:



A U.S. commercial furniture dealer

A contract furniture manufacturer

A furniture dealership support company

An office furniture project management or specification company

A remote/offshore team supporting U.S. furniture dealers



Experience with manufacturers such as Teknion, Steelcase, Haworth, MillerKnoll/Herman Miller, Knoll, Allsteel, HON, KI, OFS, SitOnIt, Global, or similar commercial furniture brands is highly valuable.



Preferred Technical Experience



Experience with any of the following is a major advantage:



CAP/2020 / 2020 CAP Complete / CET

Commercial furniture specifications

Furniture order entry

Manufacturer/dealer ordering systems

Purchase orders

Order acknowledgments

Specification/BOM review

Dealer pricing and discount structures

Freight and shipping coordination

Lead-time and delivery tracking

Installation coordination

Commercial furniture project management



Teknion experience is especially valuable.



What We're Looking For



You should be:



Extremely detail-oriented

Comfortable working with complex furniture orders containing many line items

Able to compare specifications, POs, quotes, and acknowledgments and identify discrepancies

Organized and comfortable managing multiple active projects

Able to communicate professionally with a U.S.-based team

Comfortable asking questions rather than making assumptions when information does not match

Proactive about following up on outstanding orders and issues

Comfortable learning new software and processes

Important



We are not looking for a general administrative VA who happens to have project coordination experience.



We are specifically interested in candidates who understand the commercial furniture industry and furniture dealer workflow.



If you have previously supported a U.S. commercial furniture dealer remotely from the Philippines, we would especially like to hear from you.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application:



1. Commercial Furniture Experience

Describe your experience working with U.S. commercial or contract furniture companies. Include the company/dealer type and your responsibilities.



2. Manufacturers

Which commercial furniture manufacturers have you worked with? Please list the brands.



3. CAP/2020 Experience

Have you used CAP/2020, 2020 CAP Complete, or similar furniture specification software? If yes, explain specifically what you used it for.



4. Ordering Experience

Have you personally processed commercial furniture orders? Walk us through what you did after a customer approved a furniture specification or quote.



5. Order Acknowledgments

Have you reviewed manufacturer order acknowledgments? What information did you check before considering an order correct?



6. Project Coordination

What responsibilities did you handle between order placement and furniture installation?



7. Example Problem

Tell us about a furniture order where you discovered an error, discrepancy, delay, or other problem. What did you find, and what did you do?



8. Systems

What CRM, project management, specification, accounting, manufacturer portal, or other software have you used?



9. Work Schedule

Are you comfortable working remotely with a U.S.-based company and maintaining some overlap with U.S. business hours?



Please begin your application with the words “COMMERCIAL FURNITURE” so we know you have read the full posting.

title: Recruiting & Candidate Sourcing Specialist I U.S. Company
description:
Recruiting & Candidate Sourcing Specialist | U.S. Company



We are a growing U.S.-based organization looking for an experienced Recruiting & Candidate Sourcing Specialist to join our team long-term.



Your primary responsibility will be finding qualified U.S.-based candidates who are actively looking for career opportunities and building a consistent pipeline of recruiting leads for our hiring team.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



• Source candidates and resumes from job boards, recruiting platforms, social media, online communities, and other permitted recruiting sources you are authorized to use

• Identify candidates who are actively looking for work in the United States

• Collect and organize candidate information including name, phone number,
, location, resume, and source when available

• Enter recruiting leads accurately into our system/spreadsheet

• Maintain organized records and prevent duplicate leads

• Meet daily and weekly candidate-sourcing goals

• Track which sourcing methods are producing the best candidates

• Communicate with management regarding daily production and results



Potential additional responsibility:

Depending on your English communication skills and previous experience, you may also have the opportunity to make outbound recruiting calls, contact candidates, pre-screen applicants, and schedule candidates for interviews.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We strongly prefer applicants with previous experience in:



• Recruiting

• Candidate sourcing / resume sourcing

• Lead generation

• U.S. job boards and recruiting platforms

• LinkedIn or social-media sourcing

• Data entry and spreadsheet management

• Outbound calling or appointment setting



You should be resourceful and already understand how to find candidates online without needing someone to show you every step.



Experience recruiting for U.S.-based companies is highly preferred.



IMPORTANT



We are specifically interested in applicants who already understand candidate sourcing.



In your application, please tell us:



How long have you worked in recruiting or candidate sourcing?

Which job boards, recruiting platforms, databases, social platforms, or other sourcing methods have you personally used?

Which platforms do you currently have authorized access to for recruiting/candidate sourcing?

Approximately how many legitimate U.S. candidate leads could you realistically source during an 8-hour workday?

Have you previously recruited for U.S.-based companies?

Do you have experience making outbound calls to U.S. candidates?

What hours are you available to work in Philippine Time?

What is your expected monthly salary?

VOICE RECORDING REQUIRED



Please include a 60–90 second voice recording with your application.



For the first 20–30 seconds, briefly introduce yourself and explain your recruiting experience.



For the remainder of the recording, pretend you are calling a U.S. job seeker who recently expressed interest in career opportunities. Give us an example of how you would introduce yourself, create interest, and begin the conversation.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term position, takes ownership of their work, communicates well, and can consistently produce results.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Customer Support Lead for Fast Growing DTC Brand
description:
About Us

- We're a fast growing DTC ecommerce brand in the couples games niche, scaling fast through paid social. We're building out our customer support function from the ground up and we're looking for the person who will own it.



- This is not a ticket-answering role. This is a leadership seat. You'll come in as our Customer Support Lead with a clear path to Customer Support Manager as the team grows underneath you.



What You'll Own

- Full ownership of the customer support department: inbox, response standards, tone of voice, escalations

- Building scalable support systems from scratch (macros, SOPs, help docs, workflows) that grow with the business and future team members

- Maintaining exceptional response times. Speed matters to us. Customers should never be left waiting

- Communicating directly with our logistics and fulfilment partners on shipping issues, delays, and order problems

- Turning support insights into feedback for the wider team (recurring issues, product questions, objections)

- Hiring, training, and leading support agents as we scale



Who You Are

- Proven experience in a customer support or customer support manager role at a 7 to 9 figure DTC ecommerce brand. This is a hard requirement, please include the brand(s) in your application

- Fluent written English with a warm, professional customer-facing tone

- Experienced with Shopify and helpdesk tools (Gorgias, Zendesk, Reamaze or similar)

- Comfortable working in a fast paced startup environment where things change quickly

- Systems thinker: you don't just answer tickets, you build the machine that answers them



The Mindset We're Looking For

- You're coming onboard a fast growing business. We are not looking for someone to come on and just maintain. We want you to be proactive, invested and obsessed with owning this side of the brand. If you treat support as a ticket queue, this isn't for you. If you treat it as a department you're building, keep reading.



What's In It For You

- Genuine internal growth: this role becomes Customer Support Manager as the team scales

- Real input on how the brand operates as it grows

- Long term, stable role with a business that is actively scaling, not a short term contract



To Apply

Start your application with the word YES so we know you read this fully. Then tell us:

- Which 7 to 9 figure DTC brand(s) you've supported and your role there

- One support system or process you built that made a measurable difference

- Your average first response time standard and how you maintain it



Applications that don't follow this format will not be considered.

title: Nonprofit Grant Research and Application Specialist
description:
We are hiring an experienced Nonprofit Grant Research and Application Specialist to identify, evaluate, organize, draft, and manage grant opportunities for a U.S.-based nonprofit focused on financial wellness, economic mobility, workforce development, entrepreneurship, and community empowerment.



This is not a general virtual assistant role. You must understand how to research U.S. grant opportunities, determine true eligibility and funder alignment, write persuasive applications, manage deadlines, and organize supporting documents.



Your work must be accurate. You will never invent statistics, partnerships, program results, organizational history, budgets, credentials, or other information to complete an application.



Your Responsibilities



* Research grants from private foundations, corporations, banks, community foundations, and government agencies.

* Identify opportunities aligned with our mission, programs, location, target population, and organizational capacity.

* Review eligibility requirements before recommending that we apply.

* Evaluate each opportunity based on fit, competitiveness, funding amount, deadline, restrictions, and application workload.

* Maintain a complete grant prospect database and rolling 12-month grant calendar.

* Draft letters of inquiry, concept papers, grant applications, proposals, and follow-up responses.

* Write program descriptions, needs statements, goals, activities, outcomes, evaluation plans, and sustainability narratives.

* Customize every application to the funder instead of submitting generic proposals.

* Coordinate required attachments, including budgets, board information, policies, IRS documents, financial records, and program materials.

* Track application status, decisions, reporting deadlines, renewal dates, and funder communications.

* Maintain an organized library of approved organizational language and supporting documents.

* Research funder history, past grantees, geographic priorities, and typical award amounts.

* Clearly identify missing information before drafting unsupported answers.

* Submit applications only after receiving approval.

* Provide a weekly report showing opportunities researched, rejected, approved, drafted, submitted, and awaiting decisions.



Required Qualifications



* At least three years of grant research or grant-writing experience.

* Experience supporting U.S.-based nonprofit organizations.

* Strong written English with excellent grammar and attention to detail.

* Experience researching private foundation and corporate grants.

* Ability to distinguish basic eligibility from strong funder alignment.

* Experience managing several applications and deadlines at the same time.

* Ability to review lengthy guidelines and identify critical requirements.

* Strong organizational, research, fact-checking, and documentation skills.

* Experience developing grant calendars and prospect-tracking systems.

* Comfortable working independently and requesting clarification when information is missing.

* Reliable internet, computer, and professional workspace.

* Willingness to complete a paid skills assessment.



Preferred Experience



Preference will be given to applicants with experience in:



* Financial literacy or financial wellness

* Economic mobility

* Workforce development

* Career pathways

* Small-business development

* Entrepreneurship

* Community development

* Underserved communities

* Adult education

* Capacity-building grants

* Program development

* Grants.gov or SAM.gov

* Candid or Foundation Directory

* Instrumentl, GrantStation, Foundant or Submittable

* Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets and project-management systems



Nonnegotiable Accuracy Standards



You must never:



* Guarantee that a grant will be awarded.

* Invent organizational facts, statistics, outcomes, partnerships, budgets or participant numbers.

* Submit an application without approval.

* Apply for opportunities that do not meet the eligibility requirements.

* Reuse generic language without adapting it to the funder.

* Present loans, contracts, sponsorships or tax credits as grants without clearly identifying the difference.

* use AI-generated content without reviewing every fact and statement.

* Hide missing information instead of requesting clarification.



Accuracy and funder alignment are more important than application volume.



Performance Expectations



You will be measured on:



* Quality of grant opportunities identified

* Accuracy of eligibility reviews

* Strength of funder alignment

* Quality of written applications

* Completion of applications before deadlines

* Organization of grant records and supporting documents

* Accuracy of submitted information

* Number of strong applications completed

* Reporting and follow-up management

* Communication, reliability, and attention to detail



You will not be evaluated solely on grants awarded because funders control final decisions. You will be evaluated on whether your work gives the organization the strongest reasonable opportunity to compete.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. A brief introduction describing your nonprofit grant experience.

2. The number of years you have worked with U.S.-based nonprofits.

3. The types of grants you have researched or written.

4. The industries or nonprofit causes you have supported.

5. The grant-research databases and submission platforms you have used.

6. Two redacted grant-writing samples.

7. One example of a grant opportunity you advised an organization not to pursue and why.

8. A description of how you determine whether a nonprofit is competitive for a grant.

9. Your availability and preferred working hours.

10. Your expected hourly or monthly compensation.



Application Assessment



Qualified finalists will receive a paid skills assignment.



You will review a grant opportunity and prepare:



* An eligibility assessment

* A funder-alignment assessment

* A summary of required attachments

* Risks or missing information

* An apply, do not apply, or investigate recommendation

* A short draft project summary using only the information provided



Applications without relevant writing samples will not be considered.



Attention-to-Detail Requirement



To confirm that you read the entire job description, include the following phrase in the subject line of your application:



The color blue

Full-Time | Remote

US Dollar Rate | Independent Contractor

Response time: We review every application carefully and will update you on your status within 24-48 hours.



ABOUT THE ROLE

This role is ideal for someone who has succeeded as a Home Care Scheduler, Staffing Coordinator, or Scheduling Manager and is passionate about helping others succeed. You will lead training programs for new and existing virtual assistants, with a primary focus on home care scheduling operations, caregiver staffing, client scheduling, and scheduling software platforms. Your real-world experience will bridge the gap between theory and execution.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Facilitate live virtual training across the company's core curricula and the WellSky-focused universal scheduler certification, including onboarding bootcamps that get every new cohort ready before client placement. Coordinate role-specific tracks for schedulers, recruiters, and home care admin support VAs, and deliver one-on-one coaching for VAs who need extra support. Maintain and improve existing training assets (module decks, Taglish narration scripts, knowledge checks, and assessments) and build new modules in response to client feedback, platform updates, and industry shifts. Partner with the Service Experience Coordinator to translate recurring client issues into curriculum improvements. Keep all content current on HIPAA, home care compliance, and platform best practices. Identify VA skill gaps from client feedback, audits, and performance reviews, then design targeted remediation plans or curriculum updates. Maintain individual VA training records, certifications, and continuing education tracking, and celebrate the wins. Run a centralized, clearly versioned training library, and track completion, assessment, and certification metrics across the workforce. Report weekly to the Training & Development Manager and Director of Operations on training operations and program effectiveness, tied to VA performance and client retention.



PLATFORM EXPERIENCE (at least one major home care platform)

WellSky, AxisCare, SwyftOps 



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Previous experience as a Lead Scheduler, Staffing Coordinator, Scheduling Manager, or Workforce Coordinator in the home care industry. Prior experience creating SOPs, training materials, or instructional content. Experience training, mentoring, coaching, or onboarding team members. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Comfort facilitating virtual training sessions via Zoom or Google Meet. Tagalog and English bilingual communication skills. Experience working with remote teams or virtual assistants. Knowledge of HIPAA and home care compliance requirements.

title: Dedicated Short-Form Video Editor for Growing Brand (Reels/TikTok)
description:
Hi! I'm Kat, a Filipino-American entrepreneur based in Maryland, but born and raised in the Philippines. I run a US-based company that is entirely Filipino — from our leadership to every single VA on our team.  Many have been with us for years



Now I’m hiring a dedicated, full-time Short Form Video Editor & Social Media Manager to help us grow our brand. This is a PERMANENT, LONG-TERM position — not a one-off project. If you’re looking for a stable role with a Filipina-owned company that values your talent and invests in your growth, keep reading.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



Your main job is to turn my raw talking-head videos into scroll-stopping short-form content that grows our audience and generates leads. Specifically:



• Edit 15–20 short-form videos per week from raw batch footage (Instagram Reels, TikTok, LinkedIn)

• Create scroll-stopping hooks in the first 1–2 seconds with pattern interrupts, zooms, and text pops

• Add text overlays, captions, trending audio, and B-roll at strategic 
nts to maximize watch time

• A/B test different hooks on the same content — we want TWO versions of every key video

• Track performance data and recommend iterations based on what’s actually working

• Schedule content, manage posting calendar, and write captions with strategic CTAs

• Repurpose content across platforms (same video, different edits for IG vs. TikTok vs. LinkedIn)

• Manage community engagement — respond to comments, flag important DMs, build relationships



YOU MUST HAVE



• A portfolio showing social media accounts you’ve edited that actually GREW (show before/after follower counts or engagement metrics — this is non-negotiable)

• Proven experience editing short-form vertical video (Reels/TikTok, NOT wedding videos or YouTube longform)

• CapCut and Descript proficiency

• Canva Pro skills for thumbnails and carousels

• Excellent English for captions, text overlays, and community management

• Understanding of retention editing: jump cuts every 2–3 seconds, pattern interrupts, pacing

• Reliable internet connection and your own computer/laptop with editing capability

• Minimum 4-hour daily overlap with US Eastern Time (overlap 10AM to 2PM EST )



BONUS POINTS (NOT REQUIRED, BUT WILL MAKE YOU STAND OUT)



• You can name 3 creators you study (Codie Sanchez, Dan Martell, Hormozi, etc.) and explain what makes their editing work

• Experience editing for B2B brands or professional services (not just lifestyle/vlog content)

• Experience with ManyChat or GoHighLevel

• You watch content from Dan Iles (Viral Coach) or similar and understand retention editing principles

• You’ve grown your OWN social media account using these editing techniques



THE DETAILS



• Position: Full-time, permanent (this is a long-term role, not freelance or project-based)

• Hours: 40 hours/week, Monday–Friday

• Salary: $800 – $1,400 USD/month depending on experience and portfolio quality

• Payment: Bi-monthly via Wise (1st and 15th)

• Time Tracking: Hubstaff

• Tools Provided: Canva Pro/Descript/Opus Clip/ access, scheduling platform access, Google Drive for raw footage

• Start Date: ASAP — paid edit test required before final hiring decision

• Growth: Top performers earn rate increases. 



WHY WORK WITH US?



This isn’t a faceless foreign company. I’m Filipina. I understand the culture. I’ve built my companies specifically to create meaningful, well-paying opportunities for Filipinos. Here’s what our tea
mbers say:



• Stable, long-term work opportunity (many tea
mbers have been with us 2+ years)

• Competitive salary that’s 2–3x the local market rate for video editors

• Room to grow — this role could evolve into Creative Director as we scale

• A mission that matters — we’re transforming lives in the Philippines through meaningful work



HOW TO APPLY



Please start your application message with the word “WATCHTIME” so I know you read this entire post. Then include the following:



1. Links to 2–3 social media accounts you’ve edited for (with proof that the account grew while you were editing)

2. Answer this: What is a “pattern interrupt” and why does it matter for short-form video?

3. Name ONE creator whose editing you admire and explain ONE specific technique they use that you’d bring to our content

title: Senior AI Systems Architect & Engineer — Data Platform, Agents & Automation
description:
ABOUT ENGAGE



Engage Studio is a Toronto-based custom jewellery company building an AI-native operating system for its sales, marketing, design, production, inventory, and administrative workflows. Our company goal is to create the most thoughtful engagement experience in the world and AI is integral to assisting us achive this.



Our business operations information is currently siloed in multiple systems and platforms. We are undertaking an AI makeover to establish a secure, connected AI foundation that understands the complete client and order journey—from first marketing contact through consultation, design, production, delivery, and future purchases.



We want to unify this environment around a shared data and AI foundation. Our objective is not to add another disconnected AI tool. We want to build production AI systems and agents that can progressively replace redundant SaaS platforms, manual data entry, and fragmented workflows.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You are a senior, hands-on AI engineer who can architect and build this system. You investigate unfamiliar systems, identify root causes, and turn complex business needs into maintainable production software. You communicate trade-offs clearly, challenge weak assumptions constructively, and take ownership from discovery through architecture, implementation, testing, documentation, training, and handover.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will design a unified AI-native operating layer consisting of shared data services, domain models, APIs, event-driven workflows, specialized agents, and role-based interfaces. The system must connect information across the complete client and order journey while preserving security, traceability, human oversight, and operational reliability.



You will also identify where existing platforms should:

• Remain the authoritative system of record.

• Be integrated temporarily.

• Be reduced to a limited function.

• Be replaced by purpose-built AI agents and internal applications.

• Be retired after their data and workflows have been safely migrated.



Platform consolidation must be evidence-based and incremental. We do not want a risky, simultaneous replacement of every system.



Core responsibilities will require you to:

• Define canonical data models and identifiers for clients, leads, appointments, orders, stones, designs, CAD files, vendors, invoices, payments, shipments, and related entities.

• Establish data ownership, lineage, reconciliation, and source-of-truth rules.

• Design the appropriate operational data platform using technologies such as PostgreSQL, object storage, search, vector retrieval, event queues, and workflow orchestration where justified.

• Build reliable integrations with authentication, idempotency, retries, monitoring, audit logs, and failure recovery.

• Design and implement production AI agents using tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, deterministic validation, and human approval.

• Build shared agent tools and services instead of duplicating integrations for every use case.

• Create role-based internal interfaces and work queues for sales, production, design, administration, and management.

• Implement automated evaluations, data-quality checks, access controls, and observability.

• Document the architecture, code, data models, operating procedures, and platform-replacement roadmap.

The engineer must determine which capabilities require an LLM, conventional application logic, workflow automation, statistical models, computer vision, or human judgment. We are not looking to force an LLM into every process.



MINUMUM REQUIREMENTS



• You must work during our business hours (9:30am to 6pm EST)

• Strong Python and/or TypeScript software engineering.

• LLM APIs, tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, evaluations, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

• Data engineering, relational modelling, SQL, and PostgreSQL or comparable databases.

• API, webhook, database, document, and event-driven integrations.

• Identity resolution, data lineage, reconciliation, and conflict handling.

• Queues, idempotency, retries, monitoring, logging, and failure recovery.

• Secure handling of confidential business and customer data.

• Role-based access control, auditability, and credential management.

• Git-based development, automated testing, deployment, and documentation.



HIGHLY DESIRABLE



• Salesforce, 
, NocoBase, n8n, WordPress, Google Workspace, Calendly, WhatsApp, or similar integrations.

• ERP, CRM, manufacturing, inventory or production systems.

• Multimodal AI, document extraction, transcription, image similarity, or computer vision.

• Vector and hybrid search.

• CAD, 3D files, technical catalogues, or product information management.

• Marketing attribution, forecasting, anomaly detection, and financial reconciliation.

• Experience replacing third-party SaaS workflows with internal applications or AI-enabled systems.



WHAT WE OFFER:



100,000 to 230,000php per month salary (for full-time based on qualification assessed)



Upon successful passing of a probationary period:



13th month bonus pay (pro-rated depending on start date)

SSS premium benefit

PhilHealth premium benefit

Private health insurance



HOW TO APPLY



Please put the following phrase in the subject heading: CONNECTED AI FOUNDATION



Please provide:

1. A short video walkthrough showing the most sophisticated production AI system you personally built.

2. An example where you replaced or consolidated existing software platforms, including the migration strategy and measurable result.

3. An example of a system you inherited from another developer. Explain how you understood it, collaborated with its existing owner, and made changes without destabilizing it.



Shortlisted candidates will be given a paid, time-boxed exercise to complete. We will assess architecture, implementation skill, speed, reliability, systems thinking, communication, and judgment—not presentation polish alone.

title: Long Form Youtube Content Editor
description:
About the Role



We're a Info Marketing Agency producing long-form YouTube videos for a growing roster of clients. We're hiring one editor to take ownership of two client channels, delivering one finished video per client per week (2 videos/week total). Finished runtime is typically 9–20 minutes.



This is not a gig-by-gig arrangement. You're being brought on for a consistent weekly base pay, with the same two channels every week, so you learn each client's voice, pacing, and preferences instead of starting cold on every project. As we grow, there's room to take on more channels at a higher rate.



The Editing Style (please read this part)



We are not looking for over-produced, hyper-edited, effect-heavy content. Our style is raw and realistic — it should feel like a real person talking, not a motion graphics reel.



What that actually means day to day:



Clean, straightforward cuts that keep the video moving

Removing dead space, filler, stumbles, and mistakes

Accurate, well-timed captions

Tasteful pop-ups, b-roll, images, and light text callouts where they support the point

Simple zooms and cuts for emphasis

Basic audio cleanup and consistent levels

Light color correction so footage looks natural



What we don't want: constant meme-stacking, whooshes on every cut, aggressive zoom-punch on every sentence, or anything that pulls attention away from the speaker. Restraint is the skill here.



What You'll Be Responsible For

Editing 2 long-form videos per week (one per client) to final, upload-ready delivery

Hitting agreed weekly deadlines consistently

Following each client's style guide / reference videos

Handling one round of revisions per video

Organizing project files and delivering in the correct export specs

Communicating clearly if something is unclear or a deadline is at risk

What We're Looking For



Required:



Demonstrable experience editing long-form YouTube content (not just Reels/TikToks — please don't apply with only short-form work)

Fluency in your editing software of choice (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or CapCut Pro)

Strong sense of pacing — knowing what to cut and what to leave in

Clean, accurate captioning

Reliable internet and a machine that can handle long-form projects without constant crashes

Solid written English and responsive communication

Ability to commit to the same weekly output every week



Nice to have:



Experience with talking-head, podcast, vlog, or educational/business channels

Basic thumbnail support

Familiarity with YouTube retention basics (hooks, cold opens, chapter pacing)

Light sound design and stock footage sourcing

Why This Role Is Worth Your Time

Predictable income — a fixed weekly base rate, not feast-or-famine project work

Stable workload — you know exactly what's on your plate each week

Long-term — we want an editor who stays and grows with us, not a one-off hire

Room to scale — more channels and higher pay as you prove reliability

How to Apply



Send your application with all of the following. Incomplete applications won't be reviewed.



Your portfolio — links to 2–3 long-form YouTube videos you personally edited (9+ minutes). Please note specifically what you did on each one, since we know editors often work as part of a team.

Your software and current editing setup (computer specs + internet speed).

Your realistic weekly capacity — how many long-form videos you can deliver per week alongside your existing commitments.

Your expected weekly rate in USD for 2 videos per week.

Your typical turnaround time for a 15-minute video, from receiving raw footage to first draft.



Include the word "PACING" at the top of your message so we know you read the full post.



We'll review portfolios first, then move a short list to a quick call and a short paid test edit.

title: Outbound Cold-Calling / Outreach Specialist
description:
About Neugent

Neugent AI LLC is a small AI consulting and engineering shop -- "AI agents that actually work." We build custom chatbots, voice agents, and automation for businesses that know what they want automated but don't have the engineering resources to build it themselves.



The role

We're looking for someone based in the Philippines to run outbound cold-calling for Neugent, full workday, timed to hit prime calling hours across all four continental US time zones (EST, CST, MST, PST) back-to-back.



What you'd actually be doing

- Cold calling prospects across a schedule built to hit EST/CST/MST/PST prime hours in sequence

- Researching good niches to call into using our own prospect-scoring criteria (decision-maker accessibility, budget, urgency, revenue fit, sales cycle speed, competitive saturation, referenceability)

- Writing and refining call scripts that hold up over real calls, not just read well on paper

- Logging call outcomes and prospect status so we can see pipeline movement without having to ask



What we're looking for

- No accent -- needs to sound natural to a US-based prospect picking up a cold call

- Good with words -- comfortable improvising past a script when a call goes off-plan

- Knows how to research good niches, or can be trained fast on our scoring criteria

- Knows how to write good scripts, or learns it quickly by listening to their own call recordings

- Good English, spoken and written

- A voice that carries authority -- prospects need to take the call seriously in the first 10 seconds (use the word "cadence" in your application so we know you read this)



Schedule

Full workday, scheduled to cover EST through PST prime calling windows -- maximum coverage of the US business day.



How we screen

1. Apply with at least 8 Apply Points attached to your application.

2. Short written application

3. A voice sample or short recorded call

4. A real test task: we'll give you a handful of sample prospects and our scoring criteria and ask you to rank them -- this is literally the "research good niches" part of the job, not a hypothetical.

title: Social Media Manager / Content Creator
description:
**Digital Marketing, Social Media & WooCommerce Manager – UK Builders Merchant**



We are looking for a reliable, proactive and creative person** to take ownership of the online presence of Builders Supplies, an independent builders merchant based in Blackpool, UK.



This is intended to be an ongoing, long-term position, not simply a one-off project.



Our main focus is currently Instagram,
 and our 
 website. We want someone who can learn our business, understand the products we sell and gradually take responsibility for developing our online presence.



Social Media – Instagram &



You will be responsible for managing and growing our Instagram and
 accounts.



This will include:



* Creating and scheduling regular content

* Designing professional posts, carousels, stories and promotional graphics

* Editing Reels and short-form videos using footage we provide

* Writing captions suitable for a UK construction/trade audience

* Creating and managing a monthly content plan

* Promoting products, special offers and new product ranges

* Promoting our delivery and other services

* Showcasing customer projects and completed work

* Growing followers, reach and engagement

* Developing ideas for campaigns and promotions

* Helping turn social media activity into genuine enquiries and sales

* Monitoring what content performs well and adjusting accordingly



We don't want to have to tell you exactly what to post every day.



We want someone who can **learn the business, come up with ideas and proactively tell us what photographs, videos, product information or other content you need from us.**



## WooCommerce / WordPress Website



Our WooCommerce website has already been **partially built**, but it still requires further development and work before it is where we want it to be.



Initially, part of your role will be to **help us finish, improve and build out the existing website**, before moving into ongoing management and development.



This may include:



* Reviewing the existing website and identifying what still needs completing

* Helping finish and improve existing pages

* Improving the overall layout, appearance and usability

* Building and improving product and category pages

* Adding and organising our product ranges

* Adding new products and updating existing products

* Uploading and improving product images

* Writing and improving product descriptions

* Updating pricing and product information

* Creating promotional banners and homepage sections

* Improving menus, navigation and product filtering

* Making sure the website works well on desktop and mobile

* Basic WooCommerce configuration and troubleshooting

* Basic on-page SEO

* Improving how customers find products and make enquiries/purchases

* Continually maintaining and developing the website once the initial build is completed



We **do not need a completely new website built from scratch**.



We want someone comfortable working with an existing WordPress/WooCommerce website who can help us finish what has already been started and then take responsibility for its ongoing development.



We have a large and continually expanding product range, so there will be ongoing website work even after the initial build is completed.



Ideally, you will be confident enough with WordPress and WooCommerce to make improvements independently, while also communicating with us if more advanced development work is required.



Connecting Everything Together



A major part of this role is making sure our **website and social media work together** rather than being treated as completely separate areas.



For example, when we introduce a new product range, we would like you to be able to:



**Add the products/range to the website ? create the social media content ? promote the range ? direct customers to the relevant page ? monitor the results.**



Our product ranges include:



* Building materials

* Timber & sheet materials

* Landscaping & outdoor products

* Bathrooms

* Plumbing & heating

* Windows & doors

* Flooring & tiles

* Fixings & sealants

* Tools & workwear

* Decorating & interior products

* Other construction and home improvement products



You don't need to already know every building product. However, you must be willing to **learn our products and understand our customers**.



Who We're Looking For



Ideally, you will have experience with:



* Instagram

*

* WordPress

* WooCommerce

* Canva or similar graphic design software

* Reels / short-form video editing

* Product uploads and e-commerce management

* Basic website design

* Basic SEO

* Content planning

* Digital marketing

* Growing business social media accounts



Experience working with a **builders merchant, construction company, home improvement business, landscaping company, e-commerce business or other trade-related company** would be a major advantage.



As the majority of our customers are UK based, **excellent written English is essential**. Content must sound natural and professional to a British audience.



What We Will Provide



We can provide:



* Company branding and logos

* Product information

* Prices

* Product photographs

* Videos and footage from the business

* Delivery/project photographs and videos

* Information about promotions and new products

* Access to the existing website and social media accounts



We expect you to then help us turn this information into professional content and identify what additional material you need from us.



When Applying



Please provide:



1. Examples of Instagram/Facebook accounts you currently manage or have managed previously

2. Examples of WordPress/WooCommerce websites you have worked on

3. Examples of social media graphics, Reels or other content you have created

4. A brief explanation of how you would approach improving the Builders Supplies online presence

5. What you would prioritise during your **first 30 days**

6. Your experience with WooCommerce and WordPress

7. How many hours per week you recommend for the role

8. Your expected monthly salary/rate



Please don't send a generic application.



We're not simply looking for someone to **upload a few posts and products**.



We want someone who can eventually **take ownership of our digital presence, bring ideas to us, improve what we're currently doing and help us grow our online audience, enquiries and sales.**



There is significant potential for this role to grow as the business and our online sales develop.



**Please start your application with the words “BUILDERS SUPPLIES” **

title: Remote Recruitment Coordinator – U.S. Operations
description:
Remote Recruitment Coordinator – U.S. Operations

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time / Long-Term

Company: Luxura

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Remote Recruitment Coordinator to support and manage the day-to-day recruitment process for our growing U.S.-based organization.

We operate multiple locations across the United States and are continuously hiring for a variety of positions. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of our recruitment pipeline — making sure every open position is actively advertised, applications are reviewed promptly, and qualified candidates are identified and passed to the appropriate hiring manager.

This is primarily a recruitment and candidate management role, not a general HR or administrative position.

Key Responsibilities

Job Posting & Sourcing

Maintain an up-to-date list of all open positions across our locations.

Create and publish job postings based on information provided by our management team.

Post and regularly refresh positions across platforms such as Indeed, LinkedIn,
, relevant
 Groups, and other recruiting channels.

Proactively identify additional channels and communities where we can attract qualified candidates.

Ensure that every active position is consistently being promoted until it is filled.

Candidate Screening

Serve as the first point of review for incoming applications and resumes.

Review resumes against the requirements and qualifications provided for each position.

Identify strong candidates and filter out applicants who do not meet the basic requirements.

When required, conduct brief initial screening calls to confirm experience, availability, communication skills, compensation expectations, and overall fit.

Present hiring managers with a shortlist of qualified candidates rather than large volumes of unfiltered applications.

Recruitment Pipeline Management

Maintain a centralized recruitment tracker covering all locations and open positions.

Track candidates through each stage of the hiring process.

Follow up internally to ensure qualified candidates are reviewed quickly.

Keep management updated on hiring activity, candidate volume, and positions that require additional attention.

Make sure no position or qualified candidate gets lost in the process.

What We're Looking For

Previous experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, recruitment coordination, or candidate sourcing.

Experience recruiting for U.S.-based companies is strongly preferred.

Strong experience with Indeed and LinkedIn.

Experience sourcing candidates through
, online communities, and other recruiting channels.

Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

Strong judgment when reviewing resumes and evaluating candidate fit.

Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple open positions simultaneously.

Proactive and able to work independently without needing constant direction.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets, recruitment trackers, and online recruiting platforms.

Reliable, responsive, and detail-oriented.

Preferred Experience

Experience recruiting for any of the following is a plus:

Medical spas / aesthetics

Healthcare

Beauty & wellness

Sales

Front desk / customer service

Estheticians and service providers

Medical or clinical positions

Multi-location businesses

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means that management always has a clear picture of what positions are open, every position is actively being advertised, applications are reviewed quickly, and hiring managers receive a manageable shortlist of strong candidates.

Our goal is simple: hiring managers should not have to sort through dozens of resumes. Your job is to help us find and identify the candidates who are actually worth interviewing.

We are looking for someone who can become a long-term part of our team and take real ownership of the recruitment process as the company continues to grow.

title: Full-Time Administrative Assistant (Remote)
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and experienced Full-Time Administrative Assistant to support our day-to-day operations. This is a fast-paced remote position requiring excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail, and confidence using CRM systems and administrative tools.



As an Administrative Assistant, you will play a vital role in managing client files, maintaining accurate records, coordinating with internal teams, and ensuring that daily administrative processes run efficiently. This is a long-term career opportunity for individuals who thrive in structured environments and take ownership of their work.



Key Responsibilities

As a Full-Time Administrative Assistant, you will:

Contact clients via phone to provide updates, request information, and assist with inquiries.

Manage client files from initial intake through completion while ensuring accuracy and completeness.

Maintain and update client records using CRM platforms such as GoHighLevel (GHL), 
, or similar systems.

Prepare, organize, and review documents, forms, and administrative records.

Send professional
s and follow-ups to clients, colleges, and internal departments.

Coordinate with the Sales, Administration, and Student Support teams to ensure smooth workflow.

Maintain accurate notes, statuses, and documentation within company systems.

Follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and internal processes consistently.

Identify potential issues early and communicate them promptly to management.

Complete assigned administrative tasks efficiently while meeting daily deadlines.



Qualifications & Requirements

Applicants should possess:

Previous experience as an Administrative Assistant, Virtual Assistant, Executive Assistant, Customer Service Representative, or in a related administrative role.

Strong verbal and written English communication skills.

Confidence communicating with clients over the phone.

Experience using CRM platforms such as GoHighLevel (GHL), 
, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, or similar systems.

Excellent organizational, multitasking, and time management skills.

High attention to detail and accuracy when handling client records and documentation.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset.

Commitment to a long-term, full-time remote position.



Technical Requirements

Applicants must have:

A reliable computer or laptop capable of handling daily administrative work.

Stable high-speed internet connection.

Backup internet (mobile hotspot or secondary internet provider).

Backup power source (generator, power station, UPS, or equivalent).

A quiet and professional home workspace.

Non-Negotiable

Professionalism, reliability, and accountability.

100% remote work environment.

Long-term career growth.

title: Real Time Review Specialist
description:
Job Summary

SpartanX is seeking a highly detail-oriented Real-Time Review Specialist to review residential solar projects as they move through the sales and project pipeline. This role serves as an important quality checkpoint, ensuring submissions are accurate, complete, and compliant before projects move to the next stage.



This is not a sales position. We're looking for someone who understands residential solar, knows what a clean and complete project should look like, and can quickly identify issues that could create delays, rework, or compliance concerns downstream.



What You'll Do

- Conduct real-time reviews of residential solar project submissions

- Review contracts, financing documentation, proposals, system information, and supporting project documents

- Verify submissions are complete and accurate before projects are approved to move forward

- Identify missing documentation, discrepancies, errors, and potential compliance concerns

- Return incomplete or inaccurate submissions with clear, actionable notes for correction

- Review project information for consistency across contracts, proposals, financing documents, and internal systems

- Maintain accurate documentation of reviews, findings, and outcomes

- Monitor recurring submission issues and communicate trends to leadership

- Work closely with Sales, Operations, Compliance, and Training teams to improve submission quality

- Apply company review standards consistently across all projects

- Help prevent downstream project delays by catching issues early in the process



What We're Looking For

- Previous residential solar industry experience strongly preferred

- Experience in solar operations, quality control, compliance, project review, sales support, or a related function

- Understanding of the residential solar project lifecycle

- Familiarity with solar contracts, proposals, and project documentation

- Knowledge of common solar financing structures, including loans, PPAs, and cash projects, preferred

- Exceptional attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies quickly

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Ability to make objective decisions based on established requirements and standards

- Strong written communication skills

- Ability to manage a high volume of reviews while maintaining accuracy

- Experience working with CRM systems and solar proposal platforms preferred



What Success Looks Like

- Accurate and consistent project reviews

- Fast turnaround without sacrificing quality

- Fewer downstream errors and project delays

- Clear feedback that allows issues to be corrected quickly

- Consistent application of company and compliance standards

- Identification of recurring issues before they become larger operational problems



Why SpartanX?

The earlier we catch a problem, the easier it is to solve.

As a Real-Time Review Specialist, you'll serve as an important checkpoint between a completed sale and the teams responsible for moving that project forward. Your ability to catch missing information, identify inconsistencies, and maintain high standards directly impacts project efficiency, compliance, and the homeowner experience.



If you know residential solar, have an exceptional eye for detail, and aren't afraid to stop a project when something isn't right, we want to hear from you.

title: Virtual Assistant / AI Operations Support
description:
About Neugent

Neugent AI LLC is a small AI consulting and engineering shop -- "AI agents that actually work." We build custom chatbots, voice agents, and automation for businesses that know what they want automated but don't have the engineering resources to build it themselves. We're a lean team moving fast.



The role

We're looking for a Virtual Assistant who can take real operational and administrative work off our plate. Someone who's comfortable working alongside AI tools (specifically Claude Code/Cowork) as part of how the work gets done. This is not a content-writing VA role and not a dev role. It's operations + a genuine AI-literacy requirement (or confidence in ability to learn how to leverage ai).



What you'd actually be doing

Admin & finance support: chasing contractor paperwork (W-9s, ACH forms), building/maintaining simple trackers, following up on pending items with vendors/agencies, data entry and bookkeeping support, keeping our CRM/contact list current, organizing meeting notes, scheduling across time zones.



Growth support: executing cold
 campaigns from a template/list we provide, posting/engaging on Reddit per a content plan, prepping materials ahead of sales/demo calls.



AI operations / quality control (the distinctive part of this role): reviewing AI-drafted documents against real source material before anything gets used, flagging anything unverified or inconsistent -- not just trusting AI output. Running well-scoped tasks in Claude Code yourself, under our direction, once you're comfortable with it.



Operations: drafting sops, proposing organizational structures, creating spreadsheets, etc. 



Research: researching best approaches/industry standards for processes across all pillars of the business. Synthesizing findings into easy to audit reports for executive review.



What we're looking for

- Speaks and writes clearly -- communication quality matters as much as task execution

- Comfortable with AI tools, ideally has used ChatGPT/Claude for real work already -- willingness and aptitude to learn Claude Code specifically matters more than prior exact experience with it (use the word "sonnet" into the first line of your application so we know you are reading)

- Detail-oriented and skeptical -- the AI-QA part of this role only works if you actually check things instead of rubber-stamping them

- Reliable availability overlapping with US time zones for at least part of the day

- Prior VA/admin experience is a plus but not required if the above are strong

- Lack of skills listed can be compensated with a strong willingness to learn, natural problem solving skills, resourcefulness, and an outstanding work ethic. 



How we screen

1. Apply with at least 8 Apply Points attached to your application.

2. Short written application

3. Video interview

4. A real test task: we'll give you an actual AI-drafted document from our files and ask you to verify a few specific claims against source material we provide, flagging anything unconfirmed. This is real work, not a gimmick -- it's exactly what the role does day to day.

PPC campaign strategies

title: Experienced YouTube Thumbnail Artist Needed
description:
My name is Rick, and we are scaling a network of YouTube automation channels across several niches.



We are looking for a reliable thumbnail artist to join our team as soon as possible. This is an AI-assisted role focused on creating, comparing and improving clickable YouTube thumbnails. You will not be creating thumbnails from scratch. 



Our internal video-production tool, Vidrush automatically generates thumbnail options for each video. Your job will be to review those outputs, run our proven in-house thumbnail prompts, compare the different concepts and d
 which thumbnail is most likely to attract clicks.



The video title, topic, channel style, reference thumbnails and creative direction will be provided.



We are looking for someone who understands YouTube thumbnail psychology, including curiosity, contrast, composition, readable text, emotional expressions and what makes viewers stop scrolling and click.



Example channel styles









## Main Responsibilities



• Review the thumbnail options automatically generated by Vidrush.



• Run our in-house AI thumbnail prompts to create alternative concepts.



• Compare the Vidrush thumbnails against the new AI-generated options.



• Select the thumbnail that is most likely to achieve the highest click-through rate.



• Improve or touch up thumbnails in Photoshop when necessary.



• Create up to six thumbnails per working day when the workload requires it.



• Understand that six thumbnails will not be required every day, as some days may have fewer videos in production.



• Follow the provided video titles, topics, channel styles, prompts and creative instructions.



• Ensure every thumbnail is clear, clickable and easy to understand on mobile, desktop and television screens.



• Use strong composition, contrast, facial expressions, colours and readable text.



• Make sure the thumbnail accurately represents the video topic and does not look random or misleading.



• Remove obvious AI defects and ensure the final thumbnail looks polished and professional.



• Make revisions when requested.



• Follow our SOPs, reference channels and established thumbnail styles.



Position Details



• Role:YouTube Thumbnail Artist and Quality-Control Specialist



•Output:Up to six thumbnails per working day, depending on the production schedule



• Workflow: Review Vidrush outputs, run our in-house prompts, compare the results and select or improve the strongest thumbnail



• Additional tools: ChatGPT, Midjourney, Ideogram, Leonardo, Canva or other AI and design tools will be provided 



• Compensation:$125 USD per month



•Position type: Long-term role for someone reliable, consistent and able to deliver work on time



Requirements



• Previous experience creating YouTube thumbnails.



• Photoshop experience and the ability to make professional touch-ups.



• A strong understanding of clickable YouTube thumbnail design.



• Experience using AI image-generation tools.



• Ability to follow detailed prompts and existing channel styles.



• Good judgement when comparing multiple thumbnail options.



• Strong eye for layout, text placement, contrast, facial expressions and visual clarity.



• Ability to identify and correct AI-generated mistakes.



• Ability to create thumbnails that look professional rather than cheap, generic or obviously AI-generated.



• Reliable communication and the ability to complete assigned work on time.



• Willingness to make revisions and follow feedback.



## Ideal Candidate



You understand that the role is not simply about generating an image and submitting it.



You are able to look at several thumbnail options and identify which one has the strongest potential to attract clicks.



You understand how curiosity, simplicity, contrast, scale, facial expressions and readable text affect thumbnail performance.



You are comfortable following an established channel style rather than creating something completely different for every video.



You are also comfortable using Photoshop to fix hands, faces, text, lighting, composition or any other issues that may appear in an AI-generated thumbnail.



## How to Apply



Applications that do not follow these instructions are less likely to receive a response.



1. Start your application with the name of your favourite animal.



2. Send examples of YouTube thumbnails you have created.



3. Send links to any YouTube videos where your thumbnails were used.



4. Briefly explain which AI and design tools you use.



5. Describe your level of experience with Photoshop.



6. Explain how you would d
 which thumbnail is most likely to attract more clicks when comparing several different options.



7. Confirm that you can follow existing channel styles, prompts and SOPs.



8. Confirm that you are comfortable making revisions when requested.



9. Confirm that you understand the workload is up to six thumbnails per working day, although six will not always be required.



10. Confirm that you understand the compensation is **$125 USD per month**.

title: Virtual Assistant - Special Assets
description:
Who We Are:

Dominion Financial Services (DFS) is a nationally recognized private lender dedicated to supporting real estate investors. With a focus on Short-Term Bridge Loans and Long-Term Rental Loans, DFS empowers clients to scale their businesses and build lasting generational wealth. 



Our Values:

- Integrity

- Accountable & Dependable

 -Team Centric

- System & Process Oriented

- Service Ethic

- Organized Efficiency – Risk Management & Compliance



At Dominion, we are committed to building a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. We embrace emerging technologies, including AI, to help our team members work more efficiently, solve problems more effectively, and create greater impact in their roles. Employees are encouraged to explore new tools and processes that improve productivity, enhance the customer experience, and support the company's growth.



Position Summary 

The Virtual Assistant supports the Special Assets team in advancing the resolution of defaulted loans and loans showing early signs of distress. This is a high-volume follow-up and information-gathering role. The person in this seat makes persistent contact with borrowers, schedules calls with team leadership, collects documents and payment information, and maintains clean, current records so that decision-makers always have an accurate picture of each file. 



Success in this role is measured by how little chasing leadership has to do. The Virtual Assistant closes the loop. 



Key Responsibilities 

Borrower Outreach and Follow-Up 

- Execute outbound contact efforts by phone,
, and text to borrowers on assigned watchlist and default files, working from approved scripts and templates. 

- Maintain a disciplined follow-up cadence, documenting every attempt, connection, and outcome. 

- Escalate unresponsive borrowers, disconnected numbers, and bad contact information promptly rather than allowing files to go quiet. 

- Conduct basic skip-trace and public-record lookups as directed to refresh borrower contact information. 



Call Coordination 

- Schedule and confirm calls between borrowers and Special Assets leadership, accounting for time zones and calendar conflicts. 

- Send confirmations and reminders, and reschedule missed calls the same business day. 

- Circulate a short pre-call summary of the file's status and open items so that leadership is not reading in cold. 

- Capture call notes and next steps immediately following each call and distribute to the assigned team members. 



Information and Document Collection 

- Request, track, and follow up on borrower deliverables, including: 

- Payment confirmations, wire receipts, and proof of funds. 

- Signed extension, modification, forbearance, and reinstatement documents. 

- Evidence of hazard insurance and property tax payment. 

- Payoff, refinance, and sale documentation, including contracts of sale and listing agreements. 

- Construction and rehabilitation status updates, budgets, and draw documentation. 

- Borrower and guarantor financial information as requested by leadership. 

- Property condition, occupancy, and access information. 

- Verify that what arrives is complete and legible before routing it, flagging missing pages, unsigned signature lines, and figures that do not match the file. Save all documentation to the correct loan file using established naming conventions. 



Reporting and Record-Keeping 

- Maintain contact logs, tracking sheets, and status notes in the loan servicing system and internal trackers with accuracy and same-day currency. 

- Prepare recurring status reports summarizing outreach activity, borrower responses, outstanding items, and files requiring attention. 

- Surface time-sensitive developments immediately, including any mention of bankruptcy, requests for counsel, disputed balances, property damage, occupancy changes, or listing activity. 



General Administrative Support 

- Draft routine correspondence for internal review prior to sending. 

- Prepare mailing, courier, and certified delivery packages and track delivery confirmations. 

- Assemble file summaries and document packages in support of internal review or referral. 

- Support ad hoc projects for the Special Assets team as assigned. 



Scope and Limits of Authority 

- This role gathers information and coordinates communication. It does not exercise discretion over loan resolution. Specifically, the Virtual Assistant will not: 

- Negotiate or agree to any loan terms, forbearance, extension, payoff amount, or settlement. 

- Quote payoff, reinstatement, or default figures except by transmitting a statement issued by authorized personnel. 

- Provide legal or financial advice, or characterize the company's legal position or intentions. 

- Continue direct borrower contact once the borrower is known to be represented by counsel or has requested that contact cease. Such files are routed to the Director of Special Assets immediately. 

- Deviate from approved scripts, templates, and contact procedures without prior approval. 

- All communications are conducted on company systems and are subject to monitoring and review. The Virtual Assistant is expected to complete assigned training on borrower communication standards before commencing outbound contact. 



Required Qualifications 

- One or more years of experience in a remote administrative, collections, loan servicing, customer service, or executive assistant role. 

- Excellent spoken and written English, with a clear, neutral, professional telephone presence and the ability to hold composure in tense conversations. 

- Exceptional attention to detail. This role depends on accurate names, dates, dollar figures, addresses, and loan numbers. 

- Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage a large volume of concurrent follow-ups without items falling through. 

- Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Word, and the ability to learn proprietary loan servicing platforms. 

- Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet dedicated workspace, and a professional home office environment. 

- Availability during standard U.S. business hours, Eastern Time. 



Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience in mortgage servicing, default servicing, collections, real estate, or private and business-purpose lending. 

- Familiarity with loan documents, including notes, mortgages and deeds of trust, extensions, modifications, and payoff and reinstatement statements. 

- Prior experience following compliance-driven call scripts and documentation standards. 

- Experience with CRM or loan servicing systems and structured document management workflows. 



Attributes for Success 

- Persistent without being abrasive. Comfortable making the fourth and fifth call when the first three went unanswered. Writes things down. Assumes nothing about a file and asks rather than guesses. Treats borrowers under financial stress with professionalism and discretion. 



Project Details

- Fully remote position with sustained telephone and computer work. 

- Coverage is required during U.S. Eastern business hours regardless of the incumbent's home time zone. 

- Occasional deadline-driven volume in connection with maturity dates, payoff timelines, and scheduled disbursements.

**This is NOT a general virtual assistant position.**



I am specifically looking for someone who has previously worked with a trucking company, freight brokerage, dispatch company, carrier, or logistics operation and understands the day-to-day workflow.

Typical responsibilities include:



* Entering loads into AscendTMS

You do **not** need to be a full-time dispatcher, but you must understand how trucking operations work.

I do not want someone who needs to be taught basic trucking terminology or how a load moves from:

I can teach you our specific company procedures.

If a broker has not paid, you follow up.



If something needs my attention, you tell me.



I should not have to constantly check behind you.

Do NOT send me a generic application.

10. Have you completed broker setup packets or carrier onboarding?

11. Have you communicated directly with U.S. freight brokers?

12. What hours are you available in U.S. Eastern Time?

13. What is your expected hourly rate?



At the beginning of your application, write:



**“I KNOW TRUCKING OPERATIONS”**



Applications that do not include that sentence and do not answer all questions will not be considered.
