title: Inventory Controller
description:
Inventory Controller

Location: Remote — Philippines  |  Type: Full-time, remote (engaged as an independent contractor)  |  Level: Individual Contributor  |  Reports to: Director, Supply Chain





Schedule: Core overlap with US business hours required.

About Rhino USA

Rhino USA is a family-founded brand that designs and sells premium tie-down straps, recovery gear, and outdoor and automotive accessories. We sell across our own storefronts and major marketplaces, ship from multiple domestic and international warehouses, and run our operations on the Fulfil ERP. As we scale across channels and regions, keeping a single, trustworthy view of inventory is mission-critical — and that is exactly what this role owns.

The Role

We are hiring a detail-obsessed Inventory Controller to be the person who makes our inventory numbers true. You will reconcile stock, movements, and settlement data across every channel and warehouse we operate — Fulfil ERP, Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop, and other marketplaces, our 3PL/WMS feeds, and our international warehouses — and turn a tangle of conflicting reports into one clean, defensible source of truth.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys hunting down a 12-unit discrepancy until they know exactly where it came from. You will not manage a team; you will own the accuracy of the data itself. If you find satisfaction in a reconciliation that ties out to zero, you will fit in well here.

What You'll Do

Multi-channel reconciliation (the core of the job)

Reconcile on-hand, inbound, reserved, and in-transit inventory between Fulfil ERP (our system of record) and every sales channel and warehouse, identifying and resolving every variance.

Own channel-level reconciliation across Amazon (Seller & Vendor Central / FBA & FBM), Walmart, TikTok Shop, and our other marketplaces and storefronts — matching stock ledgers, inbound/receiving records, reserved and unfulfillable quantities, and settlement/financial reports back to Fulfil.

Reconcile 3PL and warehouse (WMS) feeds — receipts, putaways, picks, adjustments, and cycle counts — against ERP records for both domestic and international warehouses, accounting for multi-currency, multi-location, and customs/in-transit nuances.

Investigate root causes of discrepancies (mis-scans, timing/cutoff differences, unmapped SKUs, returns not processed, FX and unit-of-measure mismatches, sync failures) and drive them to resolution rather than just flagging them.

Reconcile Amazon and marketplace reimbursements, lost/damaged inventory, and settlement data, and open/track cases to recover what we're owed.

Data accuracy & controls

Maintain accurate SKU mappings, unit-of-measure conversions, and channel listings so data flows cleanly between systems.

Design and run a recurring cycle-count and audit cadence with warehouse partners, and lead investigation of count-to-system variances.

Post and document inventory adjustments in Fulfil with clear, auditable notes and supporting evidence.

Monitor system syncs and integrations for failures or drift; escalate and follow up until data is aligned again.

Reporting & continuous improvement

Produce clear, recurring reconciliation reports and inventory-accuracy dashboards for Supply Chain and Finance, with variances quantified and explained.

Build and maintain reconciliation workbooks / trackers (advanced spreadsheets, and reporting inside Fulfil) that others can trust and follow.

Document repeatable SOPs for every reconciliation process you own, and continuously tighten them to reduce recurring errors.

Surface trends and systemic problems (channels or warehouses that drift most, common error types) and recommend process or system fixes.

Cross-functional collaboration

Work closely with Operations, Finance, Purchasing, and warehouse/3PL contacts — often across time zones and languages — to resolve issues and close the loop.

Support month-end and periodic inventory close with reconciled, sign-off-ready numbers.

Partner on new channel, warehouse, or region launches to ensure inventory data is set up correctly from day one.

What You Bring

Must-haves

3+ years in inventory control, inventory/reconciliation analysis, inventory accounting, or a closely related operations/finance role — ideally supporting a US-based e-commerce, retail, or distribution business.

Demonstrated experience reconciling data across multiple systems (ERP vs. marketplaces vs. warehouse/WMS), with a track record of finding and resolving discrepancies.

Hands-on experience with at least one major marketplace back end — Amazon Seller/Vendor Central strongly preferred — plus familiarity with how marketplace inventory, reserved stock, inbound, and settlements work.

Advanced spreadsheet skills (Excel / Google Sheets): pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, SUMIFS, and comfort cleaning and matching large, messy data sets. 

Exceptional attention to detail and numerical accuracy — you notice the row that doesn't tie out, and you can't leave it alone.

Strong investigative and problem-solving instincts: you trace a variance to its root cause instead of writing it off.

Excellent written and spoken English for clear async communication with a US team.

Reliable remote-work setup: quiet workspace, stable high-speed internet, backup power/internet contingency, and a capable computer.

Able to maintain overlap with US business hours and work independently with minimal supervision.

Nice-to-haves

Direct experience with Fulfil ERP (or comparable ERPs such as NetSuite, Cin7, Brightpearl, SkuVault, or similar).

Experience with Walmart Marketplace, TikTok Shop, Shopify, or eBay back ends.

Experience with 3PLs and international warehousing, including multi-location, multi-currency, and in-transit/customs inventory.

Exposure to Amazon FBA reimbursement / inventory-recovery workflows.

SQL, Power Query, or other data-tooling skills for larger reconciliations.

Background in inventory or cost accounting.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days: You understand our channels, warehouses, and how data flows through Fulfil; you're running existing reconciliations and asking sharp questions.

60–90 days: You own the reconciliation cadence end-to-end, have documented SOPs for the processes you run, and are steadily driving down recurring discrepancy types.

Ongoing: Inventory accuracy across channels and warehouses is high and trending up; variances are explained and closed quickly; Operations and Finance trust the numbers you sign off on.

Engagement & Compensation

This is a full-time, fully remote position based in the Philippines. You will be engaged as an independent contractor and are responsible for your own local taxes, statutory contributions, and any required registrations. Compensation is competitive for the Philippine market and commensurate with experience $17K. 

How to apply: Tell us about a time you found and resolved a stubborn inventory or data discrepancy — what the gap was, how you traced it, and how it ended. Rhino USA is an equal-opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants on merit and fit for the role.

Write the knowledge base. Every ticket you answer twice becomes an article.



WHO THIS IS FOR



You have supported real software before, not a call center script. You are comfortable being told "here is a log file, tell me what happened." You would rather spend twenty minutes finding the real cause than five minutes sending a polite non-answer.

- You can write basic SQL SELECT statements (joins, WHERE, ORDER BY)

- You understand what an API is, what a 500 error means, and the difference between "the server rejected it" and "the page did not load"

- Excellent written English. Our customers are US real estate agents. Your replies go out under our name with no one editing them.

- You can work 9:00am to 5:00pm US Eastern Time. That is 9:00pm to 5:00am Manila time. This is a night shift and it is not negotiable. Do not apply if you cannot do this permanently.

- US real estate knowledge

as results improve and our advertising budget grows.



---

### **POOL GROWTH**

We're looking for someone who wants to become a real part of our growth — not simply manage another social media account.

title: Social Media Content Producer & Growth Specialist
description:
About Alarmed Media LLC

Alarmed Media LLC is building a digital media platform designed to create compelling, emotionally powerful, highly engaging content across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and other social media platforms.



We are looking for a talented Social Media Content Producer & Growth Specialist to become one of the foundational members of our content team.



This is a unique, hands-on role. You will help take content from:



Idea ? Strategy ? Recording ? Hook ? Edit ? Publish ? Analyze ? Improve



Because Alarmed Media is in an early stage of building its content operation, this position will initially have responsibility across several areas. However, we do not expect one person to be an expert in every social media discipline. Your strongest skill should be creating exceptional video content.



You should also be capable of helping develop content ideas, managing the publishing process, understanding basic social media performance, monitoring audience feedback, and using what you learn to help determine what we should create next. As Alarmed Media grows, additional team members will be added and these responsibilities will become more specialized. An exceptional person in this position could eventually grow into a Lead Content Producer, Creative Lead, Social Media Growth Manager, or other leadership position within Alarmed Media.



Purpose of the Position



Your primary responsibility is to turn ideas, interviews, conversations, recordings, and raw footage into content that people actually want to watch. We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to operate editing software.



We want someone who understands what makes someone stop scrolling, what creates curiosity and emotion, what makes someone continue watching, what makes someone share or comment, what makes someone remember what they watched, and what makes someone want to see the next video.



If we give you a 30-minute interview, we want you to be able to identify moments we may not even realize are important.



You should increasingly be able to say:



"This is the clip."

"This is the hook."

"This sentence should actually start the video."

"There are five different videos hiding inside this interview."

"The audience keeps asking this question—we need to create something about it."

That type of creative judgment is extremely important to this position.





Initial Areas of Responsibility

Your approximate initial responsibilities will be:

45–50% — Video Editing & Content Creation

20% — Content Strategy & Ideation

15% — Publishing & Platform Management

10% — Analytics & Optimization

5–10% — Community & Audience Intelligence



These percentages will change as the company grows and additional team members are hired.



Core Responsibilities

1. Video Editing, Storytelling & Content Creation. 

This is the most important responsibility of the position.



You will:

Edit raw footage into engaging, polished, platform-ready content.

Create short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts,
, and other platforms.

Edit longer-form YouTube or digital content when needed.

Review raw footage and independently identify strong moments.

Determine what should stay and what should be removed.

Improve pacing and storytelling.

Restructure footage when doing so improves the video.

Create compelling openings and hooks.

Add captions, subtitles, text overlays, B-roll, graphics, music, and sound effects when appropriate.

Use transitions intentionally rather than unnecessarily.

Create thumbnails and supporting visual assets when needed.

Maintain consistent brand standards.

Complete revisions quickly and accurately.

Maintain organized editing files and finished-content libraries.



The goal is not simply to make content look professional. The goal is to make it worth watching.



Hook Development & Storytelling

You will identify the strongest possible opening for a video, develop multiple hook ideas for important content, recognize when the strongest statement occurs later in raw footage and should be moved forward, and experiment with verbal, visual, and text-based hooks, curiosity, emotion, conflict, and unexpected ideas when appropriate.



You should understand how pacing affects audience retention and help create storytelling structures that encourage viewers to continue watching.





2. Content Repurposing



One recording should rarely create only one piece of content.

For example, one longer interview might become a long-form YouTube video, multiple YouTube Shorts, TikTok videos, Instagram Reels,
 content, quote-based content, different hooks, audience-response videos, follow-up topics, and future recording ideas.



Responsibilities include:

Identify multiple standalone clips within longer recordings.

Create different lengths when appropriate.

Adapt footage for different platforms.

Revisit older footage for unused opportunities.

Identify content that could be reframed or updated.

Maintain organized libraries of raw and completed content.

Prevent valuable content from being forgotten.



We want someone who thinks:"How much great content can we create from what we already have?"





3. Content Strategy & Ideation

You will help develop Alarmed Media's content direction.



Initially, you will work collaboratively with leadership to help turn the company's expertise, ideas, stories, and message into content. As you learn the brand and audience, we expect you to become increasingly proactive.



Responsibilities include:

Help create weekly content plans.

Help maintain the content calendar.

Bring new content ideas forward.

Identify topics with strong audience potential.

Identify questions that could become videos.

Recommend recurring content series.

Identify opportunities within current conversations or trends.

Research successful content formats.

Study creators and content inside and outside our industry.

Understand why high-performing content works rather than simply copying it.

Maintain an organized content idea bank.

Recommend topics that should be recorded next.

Identify opportunities to expand successful topics into additional content.



We don't want someone who simply asks: "What do you want me to edit today?"



We want someone who increasingly asks: "Here's what I think we should create next—and here's why."





4. Social Media Publishing & Platform Management

You will initially help manage publishing across Alarmed Media's social media platforms.



Platforms may include: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram,
, LinkedIn, Threads, X, and other emerging platforms.



Responsibilities include:

Schedule and publish approved content.

Maintain the social media content calendar.

Adapt videos appropriately for different platforms.

Write or refine titles, captions, and descriptions.

Select appropriate hashtags and keywords.

Upload correct thumbnails.

Add appropriate links.

Confirm platform settings.

Verify content before publishing.

Maintain accurate publishing records.

Follow established approval procedures.



We expect high attention to detail. Wrong videos, incorrect captions, missing thumbnails, broken links, or unauthorized posts are preventable mistakes.



5. Audience & Community Intelligence

You do not need to function as a full-time community manager. However, we do expect you to pay attention to the audience.



You will:

Monitor important comments and questions.

Identify recurring themes and audience objections.

Identify topics viewers want to understand better.

Identify strong comments that could become future content.

Identify opportunities for response videos.

Surface significant audience reactions.

Escalate concerning or sensitive comments when appropriate.



Comments are not simply comments. They are information about what the audience cares about. We want you to use that information.





6. Analytics, Testing & Optimization

You will track basic content performance and help us learn from it.



Available metrics may include: views, reach, impressions, watch time, average view duration, audience retention, completion rate, shares, saves, likes, comments, click-through rate, subscribers gained, followers gained, and traffic sources. We are not looking for a sophisticated data scientist. What we need is someone who can recognize patterns.



Instead of simply reporting:

"This video received 50,000 views."



We want you to begin thinking:

"This video performed significantly better than our normal content. The opening was much stronger, viewers stayed longer, and people repeatedly commented about the same topic. We should create three more videos around that idea."



You will also help experiment with hooks, video lengths, titles, captions, thumbnails, opening visuals, editing styles, pacing, story structures, topics, recurring series, comment-response content, and posting approaches. We don't expect every experiment to work. We expect you to learn from what happens.



Weekly Expectations

Each week, the person in this role should be able to answer three questions:

1. What worked?

Identify the strongest-performing content and what you believe contributed to its performance.

2. What did we learn?

Identify meaningful audience behavior, content patterns, comments, questions, or opportunities.

3. What should we do next?

Recommend at least three specific content opportunities, improvements, or experiments for the upcoming week.



The objective is not to create busywork.



The objective is continuous improvement.

Key Performance Indicators

Content Production

Complete assigned video projects according to agreed deadlines.

Meet established weekly content-production expectations.

Consistently produce high-quality short-form video.

Complete assigned long-form video when needed.

Review priority footage for additional content opportunities.

Repurpose appropriate footage into multiple content pieces.

Maintain organized project and content files.

Creative Quality

Demonstrate continued improvement in editing quality, storytelling, hook development, pacing, and audience retention.

Independently identify strong moments within raw footage.

Bring meaningful new content ideas forward.

Publishing

Publish or schedule at least 95% of approved content on time.

Maintain 100% compliance with the established approval process.

Maintain accurate publishing records.

Maintain extremely low preventable publishing-error rates.

Never publish unauthorized content.

Strategy & Initiative

Bring forward at least three meaningful content recommendations or opportunities each week.

Identify successful themes worth continuing.

Identify unsuccessful approaches worth changing.

Demonstrate increasing independence in content decision-making.

Analytics



Submit a concise weekly review identifying the strongest-performing content, lowest-performing content, meaningful performance patterns, important audience feedback, what we should continue, what we should change, and at least three recommendations for the next content cycle.



Required Qualifications

At least 2 years of hands-on video editing or digital content experience preferred.

Strong portfolio demonstrating video editing ability. Portfolio is required.

Experience creating short-form social media content.

Experience with TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts,
 video, or similar platforms.

Strong understanding of storytelling and social media hooks.

Ability to identify compelling moments within raw footage.

Ability to make creative decisions without needing every decision prescribed.

Strong written English.

Strong attention to detail.

Strong organizational skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects and consistently meet deadlines.

Ability to receive feedback and make changes quickly.

Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Reliable high-speed internet.

Reliable computer capable of professional video editing.

Secure computer and file-management practices.

Editing Software



Strong proficiency with at least one editing platform such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or similar professional editing software.



We care more about the quality of the finished content than which software you use.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with YouTube, TikTok, Instagram,
, podcasts, interview-based content, personal brands, educational content, healthcare content, mental health content, storytelling, content repurposing, social media management, thumbnail design, basic graphic design, motion graphics, social media analytics, or AI-assisted creative tools and workflows is a plus.



Behavioral Competencies



We are looking for someone with:

Creative Judgment — You can look at raw content and recognize what matters.

Ownership — You take responsibility for the work from beginning to end.

Initiative — You do not wait to be told every next step.

Curiosity — You want to know why people watched one video and ignored another.

Coachability — You receive feedback professionally and improve quickly.

Resourcefulness — When you encounter a problem, your first instinct is to try to solve it.

Speed — You balance quality with the need to move.

Attention to Detail — You recognize that small publishing and editing mistakes can damage otherwise excellent content.

Audience Awareness — You are interested in what makes people Stop ? Watch ? Feel ? Think ? Comment ? Share ? Follow.

Continuous Improvement — You continually look for ways to make the next piece of content better than the last one.

What This Position Is NOT



This role is probably not the right fit if you primarily want to:

Receive exact timestamps and simply cut videos.

Schedule posts without participating in content creation.

Wait for someone to provide every idea.

Follow an editing checklist without making creative decisions.

Make videos visually attractive without considering whether viewers will actually watch them.

Copy trends without understanding why they worked.

Report analytics without drawing conclusions from them.



We are looking for someone who wants to create, not merely process.



Growth Opportunity



This position is intentionally broad because the individual hired will help establish Alarmed Media's initial content operation.

As content volume and audience size increase, Alarmed Media intends to add specialized team members.



The role may eventually develop toward areas such as Lead Content Producer / Creative Lead, Social Media Growth Manager, Video Editor, Content Repurposing Editor, Social Media Coordinator, Graphic / Motion Designer, Community Manager, Content Manager, or Head of Content, depending on demonstrated abilities and company needs.



An exceptional foundational hire may have the opportunity to advance into leadership as the company grows.



What We Offer

Opportunity to help build a growing media company from an early stage.

Opportunity to influence content direction.

Opportunity to contribute creative ideas.

Significant hands-on responsibility.

Direct exposure to the development of a growing media brand.

Opportunity to expand your skills beyond a traditional editing position.

Potential advancement as the Alarmed Media content team expands.

Collaborative, entrepreneurial, and fast-moving environment.





How to Apply

Please provide:

** Your most current resume.

** Your video editing portfolio.

** At least three examples of short-form content you personally edited.

** At least one example of longer-form content, if available.

** Links to social accounts or channels you have contributed to, if available.

** Your portfolio is one of the most important parts of your application.



Application Instructions



Please begin your application with the sentence:



"I know how to earn attention."



Then answer:



1. If we gave you a 30-minute interview, how would you determine which parts should become social media content?



2. What do you believe makes someone stop scrolling and watch a video?



3. Choose one video from your portfolio and explain what you personally did to make it better.



We care less about hearing the names of the software you use and more about understanding how you think.



Final Note



We are not looking for someone who simply edits videos.



We are looking for someone who can increasingly help us build a content engine:



Find the Idea ? Find the Moment ? Build the Hook ? Tell the Story ? Edit ? Repurpose ? Publish ? Listen ? Learn ? Improve



Your strongest skill should be creating excellent content.



You do not need to be world-class at every other responsibility on your first day.



But you should be excited about learning the entire content process and helping Alarmed Media build something significantly bigger over time.

title: Sizzle reel producer and video editor
description:
Sizzle Reel: Producer & Video Editor



Strong Storytelling & Marketing Judgment Required — Potential Long-Term Position



I am looking for an exceptional video editor and creative producer to help me create a powerful 2–3 minute professional speaker sizzle reel designed for this specific purpose:

-To help me get hired for paid speaking engagements and a guest on podcasts.

-This is NOT simply a video-editing job.



I need someone who can watch my existing speaking videos, podcast interviews, teaching/educational videos, look at my on-line resource, wellness practice videos, stock, branding assets and independently recognize the moments that would most likely make a meeting planner, corporation, association, conference organizer, or other decision-maker get a sense of who I am, what I’m about, want to hire me as a speaker, or invite me on a podcast or collaborate to benefits my business.



About My Speaking Topic:



My primary speaking topic is: Why Smart People Make Bad Health Decisions—and How to Make Better Ones



This isn't a talk about diets and exercise, per se. It's about the psychology of better decision-making.



I explore why intelligent, well-intentioned people can still make poor health decisions—and how factors such as confirmation bias, authority bias, social media, AI, Google, influencers, fear-based marketing, miracle cures, and misinformation influence what we believe and the choices we make.



I also explore why our brains are naturally attracted to simple answers, even if the reality is a bit more nuanced.



My goal is for audiences to leave thinking differently and feeling empowered—better able to evaluate health information, question their assumptions, and make healthier choices that can directly and significantly affect both the quality and length of their lives.



This context is important because I need an editor who can recognize not only entertaining or visually impressive moments, but also the ideas, insights, audience reactions, and memorable statements that make someone want to hear more.



The Most Important Skills

I do not want to have to watch my footage myself and tell you exactly which clips to use.

I need you to be able to review the footage and identify things such as:

• Powerful or memorable statements

• Moments that demonstrate authority and credibility

• Strong audience reactions

• Applause, laughter, and engagement

• Emotional moments

• Compelling stories

• Strong teaching moments

• Clips that demonstrate stage presence and personality

• Testimonials or other credibility elements

• Moments that would make an event organizer think, “We should hire this speaker.”



You therefore need both excellent video-editing AND excellent editorial and marketing judgment, and story-telling ability.



I also want you to incorporate:

• My branding assets, stock photography, slogans and quotes (as provided)

• Give a “world view “of the wellness resources I have developed and provided for the public at large (my online biz, selfcare programs, formulations and shop)

• Use music to evoke a more heart-opening experience.



The FIRST Project

The first project will be to create an approximately 2–3 minute professional speaker sizzle reel from my existing speaking footage and other relevant material.



You will:

1. Review and organize my existing footage and assets provided

2. Identify and timestamp the strongest potential segments.

3. Recommend which segments should be included and explain why.

4. Develop a compelling storyline and structure for the reel.

5. Edit the selected footage into a highly professional 2 to 3-minute speaker sizzle reel.

6. Incorporate appropriate music, graphics, stock photos, branding statements, titles, transitions, audience reactions, testimonials, and other elements where they strengthen the reel.

7. Make recommendations if you believe something is missing that would significantly improve the finished product.

8. Work with me through revisions until we have a highly professional final reel.



The finished product should not simply look attractive. It needs to market and sell me as a professional speaker.



Potential LONG-TERM Opportunity

Although this sizzle reel is the first project, I would strongly prefer to find someone I can work with long term.

For the right person, additional responsibilities could eventually include:

• Creating shorter videos from my speaking footage

• Repurposing long-form content into social-media clips

• Organizing and maintaining my video/content library

• Creating promotional videos

• YouTube and social-media video preparation

• Basic marketing and content-related tasks

• Other virtual-assistant responsibilities depending upon your abilities Video storytelling, brand identity and judgment are the priority.



I can teach many administrative tasks. It is much harder to teach someone how to recognize an exceptional moment in a piece of footage.



Who I'm Looking For

You should have:

• Excellent professional video-editing skills

• Strong storytelling instincts

• Excellent English speaking and comprehension

• The ability to understand nuance, emotion, and persuasive communication

• Strong judgment about what makes a speaker compelling

• Experience editing speaker reels, sizzle reels, demo reels, promotional videos, event videos, or similar material

• The confidence to make recommendations rather than waiting for detailed instructions

• Follows direction when necessary and listens deeply to what the client is wanting 

• Good communication and reliability

• The ability to receive and incorporate feedback

• Strong attention to detail



Experience creating promotional videos for professional speakers, authors, experts, consultants, coaches, thought leaders, conferences, or corporate audiences in the wellness space is a major advantage.



STEP 1 — Submit 2–3 Samples of Your Work

The first step is simply to send me 2–3 examples of your best and most relevant work.

I am especially interested in seeing:

• Speaker sizzle reels or demo reels

• Keynote speaker promotional videos

• Expert or thought-leader promotional videos

• Event highlight reels

• Videos in which you had to review longer-form footage and determine which moments were strongest

• Similar work that demonstrates both excellent editing and strong storytelling judgment



Please do not send me a large portfolio or a long list of links. I would rather see the 2–3 examples that you believe best demonstrate why you are the right person for this particular project.



I will review these samples first and invite the strongest candidates to the next step.



STEP 2 — Paid Evaluation for Finalists

After reviewing the submitted samples, I expect to select a small number of finalists for a paid evaluation.

Each finalist will receive the same approximately 20–30 minutes of my speaking footage and will be asked to:

• Identify the 6 strongest excerpts

• Provide the beginning and ending timestamp for each

• Rank them from strongest to weakest

• Give me 1–2 sentences explaining why each excerpt would help persuade someone to hire me for a paid speaking engagement

I may then ask the strongest candidates to produce a short sample edit.

This evaluation will be paid.

I'm specifically interested in discovering how you think—not simply whether you know how to operate video-editing software.



HOW TO APPLY

Please do not send a long generic cover letter!

For the initial application, please keep it simple.

Send me:

1. 2–3 links to your best and most relevant video samples.

2. Briefly tell me what role you personally played in creating those videos.

3. If you have created a sizzle reel or demo reel specifically for a professional speaker, tell me which sample it is.

4. Tell me your approximate hourly rate and/or typical project rate.



Please begin your application with these exact words:

“I understand that selecting the right moments is as important as editing them.”

Applications that do not begin with that sentence will not be considered.



At this stage, I primarily want to see the quality of your work and determine whether your editing and storytelling style might be a good fit.



If your samples stand out, I will contact you about the next step.



Thank you for your interest and I look forward to hearing from you if you are drawn to this project and believe you can do an exceptional job!

title: Short-Form Video Editor + Content Virtual Assistant
description:
Short-Form Video Editor + Content Virtual Assistant



Part-Time to Start | Long-Term Position | Philippines-Based



I am a high-volume TikTok Shop affiliate and content creator in the beauty, wellness, skincare and lifestyle space. My business is growing quickly, and I am looking for one highly organized, creative person who is BOTH a strong short-form video editor and capable virtual assistant.



This is NOT a traditional corporate editing position.



You need to understand TikTok, Reels, UGC, short-form content, hooks, retention and fast-paced social media editing.



I film a high volume of content. Your job will be to help me turn that raw content into finished videos quickly while also keeping the content side of my business extremely organized.



Your #1 Responsibility: VIDEO EDITING



You will:



* Edit TikTok Shop and short-form videos primarily in CapCut

* Turn raw talking-head footage into polished, natural videos

* Remove pauses, mistakes and unnecessary footage

* Understand pacing and retention without over-editing

* Add appropriate on-screen text and captions

* Add B-roll, zooms and visual elements when needed

* Follow example videos and recreate editing styles

* Create multiple videos efficiently from batches of footage

* Keep my natural personality and speaking style intact

* Learn my preferred editing style and eventually require very little direction

* Meet deadlines consistently



I do NOT want overly produced, corporate-looking content.



You should understand that high-performing TikTok content often feels natural and native to the platform.



Content VA Responsibilities



When you are not editing, you will help me:



* Organize raw and edited content in Google Drive

* Maintain a content calendar/tracker

* Track which videos are filmed, editing, ready for review and completed

* Organize content by product and brand

* Track brand/retainer deliverables and deadlines

* Keep a running record of how many contracted videos have been completed for each brand

* Organize product information and campaign briefs

* Research TikTok trends and competitor content

* Find examples of strong hooks and video formats

* Help organize content ideas and references

* Maintain spreadsheets and databases

* Assist with light administrative tasks related to my creator business

* Help me build systems that allow us to produce more content without sacrificing quality



REQUIRED



You must:



* Have strong CapCut editing skills

* Have experience editing TikTok, Reels, Shorts or UGC

* Understand short-form pacing and retention

* Have excellent attention to detail

* Be extremely organized

* Communicate clearly in English

* Be comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

* Be reliable with deadlines

* Have reliable high-speed internet

* Have your own computer capable of video editing

* Be comfortable using Google Drive, Google Sheets and similar tools

* Be willing to learn new systems and AI tools

* Be looking for a long-term position



HUGE BONUS



Tell me if you have experience with:



* TikTok Shop

* Beauty/skincare/wellness content

* Affiliate marketing

* UGC

* E-commerce

* Social media analytics

* Canva

* Notion

* ChatGPT or other AI tools

* Content management

* Creator or influencer businesses



You do NOT need to have every bonus skill.



Editing ability, organization, reliability and willingness to learn matter most.



Hours



We will start at approximately 20–25 hours per week.



There is significant opportunity for this position to become full-time as we establish our workflow.



I am looking for someone who wants to grow with the business long-term.



Compensation 

$5–$7 USD/hour to start depending on experience and editing ability.





There will be opportunities for increased hours, increased compensation and performance bonuses for the right person.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with:



PURPLE



If the first word of your application is not PURPLE, your application will not be considered.



Then answer these questions:



1. Tell me about yourself in 3–5 sentences.

2. How many years have you edited short-form social media videos?

3. Which editing programs do you use?

4. How experienced are you with CapCut?

5. Have you edited TikTok, TikTok Shop, UGC or Reels?

6. Have you worked as a VA or content manager before? What did you handle?

7. What experience do you have with beauty, skincare, wellness or e-commerce content?

8. How would you organize hundreds of raw and completed videos for multiple products and brands?

9. What computer do you use? Include RAM and processor if known.

10. What is your internet speed?

11. How many hours per week are you currently available?

12. Are you currently working for other clients?

13. What is your desired hourly rate?

14. What time zone/hours do you normally work?

15. Why do you think you would be a good fit for this specific position?



MOST IMPORTANT:



Send me links to 3 of your BEST short-form edits.



Do not send me 30 examples. Pick the three that best demonstrate your ability to edit high-retention TikTok/Reels/UGC content.



Also include a 60–90 second introduction video telling me about yourself and why you’re interested in the position.



Applicants who appear to be a strong fit will be invited to complete a PAID editing test before being hired.



Please do not complete unpaid sample work.



I’m looking for someone dependable, talented, organized and excited to build a long-term working relationship as this business continues to grow.

title: Social Media Content Creator & Community Moderator
description:
We are looking for a highly creative, funny, fast-moving, social-media-obsessed person to help us build a rapidly growing online food community called FoodeesNation.



FoodeesNation is being built by Foodees Fest, a large traveling food festival company in the United States. Our goal is not to create another boring company
 group. We want to build a massive, active community of people who love food, food trucks, restaurants, crazy food creations, hidden gems, humor, and discovering what everyone else is eating.



We want FoodeesNation to become one of the most entertaining food communities on
 — and we need someone who wants to help build it.



This Is a Fast-Paced Content Role



We move quickly.



This position is for someone who can take an idea and turn it into finished content without spending hours overthinking every post.



We expect a high volume of quality content, fast turnaround times, and someone who is comfortable working independently.



You should be able to create a meme, graphic, poll, Reel, or
 post quickly and move on to the next piece of content.



We are not looking for perfectionism that slows production down.



We are looking for speed, creativity, good judgment, personality, and consistency.



What You Will Do



You will help operate FoodeesNation every day.



Your responsibilities will include:



Creating funny food memes

Creating highly engaging
 posts

Creating polls, debates, food battles, and conversation starters

Finding interesting food topics and trends

Creating graphics in Canva, Photoshop, or similar software

Editing short-form videos and Reels

Creating “Would You Eat This?” and “Rate This Plate” content

Developing recurring content series

Spotlighting food trucks, restaurants, vendors, and interesting foods

Encouraging members to comment and participate

Replying to comments and interacting with community members

Approving new members

Moderating spam and inappropriate content

Identifying great member-generated content

Helping us develop new ideas to grow the group

Watching what performs well and creating more of what works



You will NOT spend your entire day making corporate advertisements.



We are looking for someone who understands internet culture.



You should understand why memes work, why some
 posts get 
 comments while others get 1,200, and how to make someone stop scrolling long enough to participate.



Minimal AI Use



We are specifically looking for someone with real creative ability.



AI can be used occasionally as a tool for brainstorming, research, proofreading, or helping develop an idea.



However, we do NOT want someone who relies on ChatGPT or other AI tools to create most of their content.



If every caption, meme idea, poll, and response sounds AI-generated, this position will not be a good fit.



We want a real person with:



Their own sense of humor

Their own ideas

Their own understanding of social media

Their own creative instincts

Their own ability to recognize what people will find funny or interesting



AI should assist your creativity — it should not replace it.



The Person We Are Looking For



You are probably a great fit if you:



Work very fast without sacrificing quality

Have an excellent sense of humor

Understand memes and current social-media culture

Have strong spoken and written English

Understand American humor and sarcasm

Are comfortable writing conversational English

Have graphic-design skills

Can use Canva, Photoshop, or similar programs

Can edit short-form video using CapCut, Premiere, or similar software

Spend enough time on
, Instagram, TikTok, or Reddit to understand what people are talking about

Can work independently without needing someone to give you every single post idea

Can produce a high volume of content consistently

Enjoy experimenting with content

Understand that social media should feel SOCIAL

Are comfortable interacting with a large online community

Do not need AI to tell you what to post



We care much more about your creativity, humor, speed, judgment, and ability to create engaging content than we care about degrees or impressive job titles.



REQUIRED VIDEO INTRODUCTION



Every applicant must submit a short video introduction. Applications without a video introduction will not be considered.



Your video should be approximately 30 second long and should be addressed directly to Ron, one of the owners of Foodees.



Do not send a heavily edited promotional video. We simply want to meet you and hear you speak naturally.



In your video, tell Ron:



Your name

A little about yourself

Why this position interests you

Why you think you would be good at creating content for FoodeesNation

What makes you creative or funny

Why you believe you can help us grow a large
 community



Please speak naturally. Do not read an AI-generated script.



We are not looking for perfect English or a professional studio presentation. We want to see your personality, communication skills, energy, creativity, and how comfortable you are speaking directly to someone.



How to Apply



Please do not apply by simply telling us that you are hardworking, dedicated, detail-oriented, and a fast learner.



Show us that you are creative.



***MUST BE WILLING TO WORK ON VIDEO AND AUDIO IN A 
 SERVER WITH OTHER WORKERS***



Your application MUST include:



Your 30 second video introduction addressed directly to Ron.

A link to your portfolio or examples of social-media content you have created.

Examples of memes, graphics, videos, or social posts you have personally created.

Your desired monthly salary in USD.

The social-media platforms you are most experienced with.

Your answer to this question:



You are running a
 group with 
,000 food lovers. Give us THREE posts you would publish today that you believe would generate a lot of comments.



Please create these ideas yourself. We are not interested in AI-generated application answers.



There is no perfect answer. We want to see how you think.



Paid Trial



Final candidates may be offered a small paid creative trial before we select the person for the position.



The trial may include creating:



3 food memes

2
 polls

1 short-form video

3 engaging
 posts

Responses to sample community comments



The trial will also help us evaluate your speed.



We want someone who can move quickly, make good creative decisions, and produce content without needing excessive revisions or instructions.



We are looking for originality. AI may be used minimally as a support tool, but the work should clearly come from you.



About Foodees



Foodees Fest is a traveling food and culture festival operating throughout the United States. Our events bring together food trucks, artisans, small businesses, families, and communities.



FoodeesNation is our next step.



We are building a digital community that exists every day — not just when one of our festivals is happening.



If you are creative, funny, work fast, understand social media, and want to help us turn this community into something huge, we would like to hear from you.

brand.

AND



### A COMPLETE DIGITAL PRODUCT CATALOG

# 1 — LATHAM FIBERGLASS POOLS

We want a complete and visually impressive pool catalog.

* Add/remove brochures

* Update calls-to-action



without needing to rebuild an entire page manually.

### This is NOT necessarily an e-commerce website.



Customers do not need to purchase a swimming pool or $15,000+ Hot Tub directly online.

### DISCOVER ? COMPARE ? GET INTERESTED ? CONTACT US ? GET A QUOTE ? BUY

# PRODUCT SEARCH & FILTERING

* Brand

* Number of seats

* Lounger / No Lounger

* Size

* Collection

* Features



Pools could potentially be filtered by:



* Size

* Shape

* Length

* Width

* Built-in spa

* Tanning ledge

* Features



The selected developer should recommend the best UX solution.



---



# REAL SENSASSION PROJECTS



We have many REAL photos and videos from our installations.



We want these to play a major role throughout the website.



We want sections such as:



### BEFORE & AFTER



### RECENT POOL INSTALLATIONS



### HOT TUB INSTALLATIONS



### SWIM SPA INSTALLATIONS



### PROJECT GALLERIES

For example:

We want customers to see that we actually install these products locally.



---



# LEAD GENERATION — HIGH PRIORITY

### IT MUST GENERATE LEADS.



We want clear and strategically placed calls-to-action throughout the website:



**GET A FREE POOL QUOTE**



**REQUEST PRICING**



**CHECK AVAILABILITY**



**ASK ABOUT THIS MODEL**



**VISIT OUR SHOWROOM**



**CALL US**

Ideally, when a customer submits an inquiry from a product page, we should know **exactly which model they were viewing**.



Our objective is:



### WEBSITE VISITOR ? LEAD ? APPOINTMENT ? QUOTE ? CUSTOMER



---



# LOCAL SEO — VERY IMPORTANT



We want to build strong organic visibility throughout our ACTUAL service area.



## PALM BEACH COUNTY



Including important markets such as:



West Palm Beach, Palm Beach Gardens, Jupiter, Wellington, Lake Worth Beach, Boynton Beach, Delray Beach, Boca Raton and surrounding communities.



## BROWARD COUNTY



Including relevant markets such as:



Deerfield Beach, Pompano Beach, Fort Lauderdale and surrounding communities within our service area.



## MARTIN COUNTY



Including:



Stuart, Palm City, Jensen Beach and surrounding communities.



## ST. LUCIE COUNTY



Including:



Port St. Lucie and other relevant communities within our service area.



We want the developer to create a **strategic Local SEO architecture**, not simply generate dozens of identical city pages.



---



# SEO TARGETS



We want to build visibility around searches related to our services, products and brands, including:



* Fiberglass Pool Builder

* Latham Pool Installer

* Latham Fiberglass Pools

* Fiberglass Pool Installation

* Pool Builder Near Me

* Pool Contractor

* Hot Tub Store

* Hot Tub Dealer

* Caldera Spas

* Be Well Canada Spa

* Maple Spas

* Platinum Spas

* Aquavia Spa

* Swim Spas

* Chill Tubs



The developer should perform keyword research and recommend the best strategy based on actual search opportunities.



---



# PRODUCT PAGE SEO



Individual product pages are extremely important.



Every important model page should have:



* SEO-friendly URL

* Unique page title

* Meta description

* Correct H1/H2 structure

* Product specifications

* Internal links

* Optimized images

* Alt text

* Relevant schema markup

* Related products

* Strong CTA



We want customers searching for specific brands and models to potentially discover **Sensassion Pool & Spa directly through Google**.



---

title: Part-Time Business Development & Cold Calling Specialist
description:
About Radiate



Radiate is a growing real estate media company serving San Diego County. We provide professional real estate photography, videography, drone, 3D tours, floor plans, and marketing content for real estate agents, teams, property managers, and vacation rental companies.



We are looking for a confident, personable, and motivated Business Development Specialist to help us grow our client base.



The Role



Your main responsibility is simple:



Help Radiate generate new business and bring in new clients.



You will research potential clients, cold call real estate professionals, introduce them to Radiate, follow up with prospects, and help turn conversations into first-time bookings.



This is not a general virtual assistant position. Your primary focus will be sales, prospecting, cold calling, and follow-up.



Responsibilities



Research active real estate agents, teams, brokerages, property managers, and vacation rental companies in San Diego County



Build and maintain targeted prospect lists



Cold call potential clients and introduce Radiate



Follow up with prospects by phone,
, and text when appropriate



Reconnect with previous leads who have not booked



Follow up consistently with interested prospects



Track calls, conversations, follow-ups, and results



Hand qualified or highly interested prospects to the owner when needed



Learn Radiate's services, brand, and competitive advantages



Represent Radiate professionally on every call



What We're Looking For



Excellent spoken English is extremely important for this position.



You should:



Speak fluent, natural, professional English



Be comfortable cold calling businesses in the United States



Sound confident, friendly, and conversational on the phone



Have previous cold calling, sales, lead generation, or business development experience



Be comfortable hearing "no" and continuing to make calls



Be organized and consistent with follow-ups



Be self-motivated and results-oriented



Have reliable internet and a professional work environment



Be comfortable learning new software and CRM systems



Experience working with real estate agents, real estate companies, photographers, marketing agencies, or other U.S.-based businesses is a major plus.



What Success Looks Like



We care about results, not simply the number of calls made.



Success will be measured by:



Conversations with qualified prospects



Interested potential clients



Follow-ups generated



New first-time Radiate clients



Paid bookings generated



Clients who continue booking Radiate



How to Apply



Please include:



A short introduction about yourself and your sales/cold calling experience



Your previous experience working with U.S.-based businesses



Your availability during Pacific Time business hours



A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and pretending you are cold calling a real estate agent on behalf of Radiate Real Estate Media



In your sample call, imagine you are contacting a real estate agent in San Diego who has never worked with Radiate before.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who can grow with Radiate long-term. If you are confident on the phone, enjoy sales, and like the challenge of turning cold prospects into customers, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Creator Acquisition, Influencer Seeding & TikTok Shop Affiliate Manager
description:
Natural Renewals is a growing U.S.-based health and wellness company and the company behind My Moss Sea Moss Gel.



We are looking for an experienced Creator Acquisition, Influencer Seeding & TikTok Shop Affiliate Manager to help us aggressively grow awareness and sales of My Moss through TikTok Shop, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and other creator-driven platforms.



This is not a general social media management job.



You will not be responsible for simply posting on our social media pages.



We are not looking for someone to casually send influencer DMs.



We are building a large creator acquisition system. We need someone who understands both quality and scale.



TikTok Shop will be one of the biggest engines for this role.



Your main responsibility will be to build and manage a creator acquisition machine that can eventually get My Moss products into the hands of hundreds of qualified creators every week, continue scaling beyond that, and turn the best creators into repeat content creators, TikTok Shop affiliates and sales drivers.



This includes finding creators, qualifying them, contacting them, following up, collecting shipping information, coordinating product seeding, tracking content, recruiting affiliates and identifying creators who can drive real awareness and sales.



THE GOAL



Our goal is to build one of the most aggressive creator seeding and TikTok Shop affiliate acquisition programs in our category.



We want to consistently identify, contact, activate and retain creators who can generate content, influence buying decisions and drive measurable sales for My Moss.



But quality matters.



We do NOT want random influencers just because they have followers.



We want creators whose:



* Audience fits our target customer

* Content quality is strong

* Engagement appears genuine

* Audience is primarily U.S.-based

* Content is relevant to health, wellness, fitness, food, beauty, lifestyle, natural products, motherhood, clean eating, supplements or related interests

* Posting history shows they actually create product-related content

* Content style fits the My Moss brand

* Audience is likely to trust product recommendations

* Content has potential to drive views, engagement, product trials or sales

* Profile has potential for TikTok Shop affiliate performance



Micro-creators are welcome and encouraged.



A creator with 8,000 highly engaged followers may be more valuable than someone with 200,000 disengaged followers.



We care about creators who can create content, influence buying decisions and potentially become productive TikTok Shop affiliates.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will be responsible for:



* Finding and researching creators on TikTok, TikTok Shop, Instagram, YouTube and other relevant platforms

* Finding and recruiting TikTok Shop affiliates

* Identifying creators already selling health, wellness, food, beauty and related products

* Identifying creators with strong product-selling ability, not just large follower counts

* Qualifying creators by audience fit, content quality, engagement, average views, niche, location and likelihood to post

* Building and maintaining a large database of qualified creators

* Finding creator contact information when publicly available

* Contacting creators through
, Instagram DM, TikTok and other appropriate channels

* Writing personalized outreach instead of obvious copy-and-paste spam

* Following up consistently with creators who do not initially respond

* Communicating with creators who are interested in receiving product

* Collecting shipping information and product/flavor preferences

* Coordinating sample shipments with our internal team

* Tracking every creator from initial research through outreach, delivery, posting, affiliate activation and repeat content

* Following up after creators receive the product

* Encouraging creators to post authentic content featuring My Moss

* Recruiting strong creators into our TikTok Shop affiliate program when appropriate

* Tracking which creators generate views, engagement, content, TikTok Shop activity, GMV or sales where available

* Tracking creator activation rate, posting rate, repeat content rate and affiliate performance

* Re-engaging strong-performing creators and encouraging repeat content

* Researching competitor brands and identifying creators already producing relevant content

* Building lists of creators who have already demonstrated product-selling ability

* Continuously finding new creator niches and outreach opportunities

* Maintaining organized Google Sheets or CRM records

* Providing weekly performance reports

* Building SOPs for creator research, qualification, outreach, follow-up and post tracking

* Recommending tools and systems that allow creator outreach to scale efficiently

* Identifying which parts of the workflow should be automated and which should remain human

* Continuously improving the creator acquisition funnel using data

* Helping hire, train and manage additional creator researchers or outreach assistants as volume increases



AI LEVERAGE EXPECTATION



We expect you to use AI intelligently to work faster and better.



AI can help with creator research, qualification, profile summaries, outreach angles, message drafts, CRM organization, reporting, performance analysis and SOP creation.



But outreach must remain human, relevant and specific.



We do not want mass-DM spam, fake personalization, robotic messaging, random influencer lists or fully automated outreach with no judgment.



AI should improve speed and organization without lowering quality.



We are especially interested in someone who can use AI and automation in ways we may not have thought of yet.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who:



* Has experience with influencer outreach, creator seeding, affiliate recruitment, TikTok Shop or creator partnerships

* Has TikTok Shop experience, or strong hands-on creator affiliate experience that can transfer quickly

* Understands TikTok, Instagram and creator culture

* Can identify strong creators quickly

* Understands the difference between follower count, real engagement, average views, content quality and audience fit

* Can spot fake engagement or low-quality creator accounts

* Has excellent written English

* Is comfortable communicating with U.S.-based creators

* Is persistent without being annoying or spammy

* Understands follow-up and relationship building

* Is highly organized

* Can handle many creator conversations at once

* Can work independently without waiting for instructions every day

* Understands influencer marketing metrics

* Has experience with spreadsheets, CRMs or creator databases

* Understands affiliate marketing or creator partnerships

* Can use AI tools to work faster without making outreach generic

* Can help build and improve a scalable creator acquisition funnel

* Thinks in systems, not just one-off tasks



Experience working with health, wellness, supplements, food, beauty, CPG, natural products, TikTok Shop, Amazon influencers or e-commerce brands is strongly preferred.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF



This role is not for you if:



* Your strategy is mass-DMing random influencers

* You judge creators entirely by follower count

* You have never managed creator outreach before

* You cannot show examples of previous creator campaigns or outreach work

* You need to be told exactly what to do every day

* You do not track your work

* You send generic copy-and-paste outreach without reviewing the creator

* You do not understand response rates, acceptance rates, posting rates or creator activation rates

* You are not comfortable using spreadsheets or CRM systems

* You think influencer marketing is just finding people with large audiences

* You use AI to create generic messages instead of better personalized messages

* You are good at making lists but weak at follow-up and execution



We are building a real creator acquisition system.



We need someone who understands both quality and scale.



METRICS WE WILL TRACK



Your performance will be measured using metrics including:



* Qualified creators researched

* Creators contacted

* Response rate

* Positive response rate

* Creators agreeing to receive product

* Samples shipped

* Cost per creator acquired

* Creators activated

* Creator activation rate

* Creators who post

* Posting rate

* Repeat content rate

* Content generated

* Views generated

* Engagement generated

* TikTok Shop affiliates recruited

* Affiliate creators activated

* TikTok Shop GMV or sales generated where trackable

* Repeat content from creators

* Quality of CRM tracking

* Quality of weekly reporting

* Improvement of the outreach system over time



COMPENSATION



Starting salary: $1,100/month full-time



Performance bonuses and growth opportunities are available for strong results, especially around qualified creator activation, posting rate, affiliate activation, repeat content and trackable sales.



HOW TO APPLY



Important:



At the very beginning of your application, write:



MY MOSS CREATORS



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be considered.



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself



2. Your experience with influencer outreach, creator seeding, affiliate recruitment, TikTok Shop or creator partnerships



3. Examples of campaigns, brands or creators you have worked with



4. Measurable results if available, such as creators contacted, response rate, posting rate, affiliate signups, sales, GMV or content generated



5. Tools, spreadsheets or CRM systems you have used



6. AI tools you use and how you use them for creator research, outreach, organization or reporting



7. One unusual way you would use AI or automation to improve creator acquisition that most brands are probably not using yet



8. How you d
 whether a creator is worth contacting



9. If you disagreed with our current creator acquisition strategy, what would you change first and why?



10. Your expected monthly salary for full-time work



11. One short sample DM you would send to a wellness creator offering free My Moss Sea Moss Gel



Applications that are generic, copied or clearly AI-generated without real thought will be ignored.



PAID TEST



Strong applicants will be invited to complete a short paid test before we make our final hiring decision.



The test will be practical and focused. Full instructions will be sent only to shortlisted applicants.



The paid test will cover:



* Creator research and qualification

* Creator rejection and prioritization

* Personalized outreach

* AI-assisted creator acquisition workflows

* A scale plan for reaching 500+ qualified product seedings per week, then scaling toward thousands of active creator and affiliate relationships



You may use AI during the test. In fact, we expect you to.



However, we care more about your judgment, originality, verification and final decisions than the AI output itself.



We are looking for someone who can repeatedly answer one question:



Which creators can actually help My Moss grow, how do we reach them at scale without becoming spammy, and how do we turn the best ones into repeat creators, TikTok Shop affiliates and sales drivers?



At the very beginning of your application, write:



MY MOSS



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be considered.

title: AI-Enhanced SEO, GEO & Online Visibility Specialist
description:
Natural Renewals is a growing U.S.-based health and wellness company and the company behind My Moss Sea Moss Gel.



We are looking for a smart, resourceful SEO, GEO and Online Visibility Specialist to help more people discover My Moss across the internet.



This is not a basic blog-writing SEO role.



We are not looking for someone who only changes meta descriptions, writes generic AI articles or builds random backlinks.



We want someone who thinks deeply about modern online visibility:



Where are people searching for sea moss?



Which websites, Reddit threads, TikToks, YouTube videos, articles and AI search results influence what they buy?



Which competitors are showing up where we are not?



Why are they winning?



How do we ethically earn visibility in the places where customers are already looking?



Your main goal:



Help Natural Renewals and My Moss become more visible across Google, Reddit, TikTok, YouTube, ChatGPT, Google AI, Perplexity, blogs, publications, directories, product guides and other discovery channels.



AI proficiency is important, but this is primarily an SEO and online visibility role.



We are not looking for an AI generalist learning SEO on the job.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will be responsible for:



* SEO and keyword research

* Finding high-value keywords and search topics we can realistically win

* Improving existing website pages for SEO

* Finding content gaps and new page opportunities

* Researching buyer-intent, comparison, problem-solution and social search keywords

* Researching TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and social search trends related to sea moss, wellness, functional foods and customer problems or benefits

* Finding backlink, brand mention and digital PR opportunities

* Finding opportunities for My Moss, Natural Renewals, our products or our founder to be featured in articles, product guides, expert roundups, podcasts, gift guides, newsletters and relevant media coverage

* Pursuing placements, mentions and coverage from discovery through outreach and follow-up

* Researching how we can appear more often in ChatGPT, Google AI, Perplexity and other AI-powered search tools

* Auditing consistency of Natural Renewals and My Moss information across our website, social profiles, retailers, directories, listings and third-party sources

* Researching competitors and identifying where they get traffic, backlinks, mentions, social visibility and AI search visibility

* Conducting outreach to bloggers, websites, publications and potential partners

* Executing approved SEO and visibility initiatives, not just identifying them

* Tracking outreach, backlinks, mentions, rankings, opportunities and progress

* Tracking branded search growth, referring traffic, earned mentions and AI-search visibility where practical

* Providing short weekly reports showing what was completed, what changed, what was learned and what opportunities were found



AI LEVERAGE EXPECTATION



We expect this person to use AI tools intelligently to work faster and better.



AI may be used for:



* Keyword clustering

* Competitor research

* Content gap analysis

* Reddit and social listening

* AI search testing

* Outreach research

* Digital PR research

* Entity consistency audits

* Reporting

* Organizing large amounts of information

* Finding patterns across large amounts of research



GEO means generative engine optimization: improving how the brand appears in AI-powered search tools like ChatGPT, Google AI, Perplexity and similar platforms.



However, we do NOT want someone who blindly relies on AI.



We do not want:



* Generic AI articles

* Copied AI content

* Fake reviews

* Fake Reddit activity

* Spam comments

* Low-quality backlinks

* Automated directory blasting

* Unverified AI output

* Generic SEO reports with no real thinking



AI should support your judgment, not replace it.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who is:



* Strong in SEO fundamentals

* Excellent at internet research

* Resourceful and independent

* Excellent at written English

* Familiar with Google Search Console and keyword research tools

* Familiar with Reddit, TikTok, YouTube, Google and social search

* Comfortable using AI tools for research, analysis and productivity

* Organized and able to document work clearly

* Able to prioritize high-value opportunities instead of just staying busy

* Comfortable executing approved ideas, not just making reports

* Strategic and practical about what will actually move results



Experience with e-commerce, wellness, food, functional foods, consumer products, natural products, digital PR or content marketing is a major plus.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF



This role is not for you if:



* Your SEO strategy is just writing AI blog posts

* You focus on low-quality backlinks

* You use spammy SEO tactics

* You create fake Reddit conversations or fake customer accounts

* You cannot explain why an SEO opportunity matters

title: Video editor
description:
# YouTube Video Editor – Photography & Filmmaking Channel



I’m looking for a freelance video editor for an ongoing collaboration editing YouTube videos about photography, filmmaking, camera equipment and real-world productions.



I’m a professional photographer and filmmaker from Norway, and most of the material is shot during actual assignments, tests and small productions rather than in a studio.



## What the films look like



Typical videos will include:



- Real-world lens and camera tests

- Photography and filmmaking

- Behind-the-scenes from productions

- Outdoor and underwater filmmaking

- Camera and lighting equipment

- Short documentary-style stories

- YouTube Shorts and Reels



For example, a lens review might not be a traditional studio review.



I may spend a day with a blacksmith in his workshop, shoot the entire production with one lens, and use those images to tell the story while discussing how the lens actually performs.



Another film might compare two cinema zoom lenses using real footage from a working environment.



The images and storytelling are important.



## Editing style



I am NOT looking for typical hyperactive YouTube editing.



No constant zooms, unnecessary transitions, huge animated captions or sound effects every few seconds.



I prefer:



**Cinematic. Clean. Authentic. Visual.**



Good images should be allowed to breathe.



The editor should understand pacing, storytelling and when NOT to cut.



Think more:



**Photographer / filmmaker telling a story, but with a strong hook. **



and less:



**YouTube influencer trying to maintain attention every second.**



What I will provide

Depending on the project:

- A-roll

- B-roll

- Voice-over

- Manuscript or story outline

- Music direction

- Reference films

- Camera originals

- Notes about important shots

Most material will be professionally shot.



Typical cameras include Sony cinema/mirrorless cameras, drones, action cameras and underwater cameras.

Some projects may include Log footage.



What I need from you

You should be comfortable with:

- Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

- Editing 4K footage

- Basic color correction

- Working with Log footage

- Audio cleanup and mixing

- Music editing

- B-roll selection

- Storytelling

- Simple titles and graphics

- YouTube delivery



Advanced motion graphics are NOT a priority.



Good storytelling is.



## Typical projects



A normal YouTube video will probably be around:



**5–15 minutes**



There will also be:



**30–90 second Shorts/Reels**



Some films will be equipment reviews.



Others will be much more visual and documentary-style.



## Long-term collaboration



I am not looking for someone to edit just one video.



The goal is to find an editor who can learn my style and eventually understand how I shoot and tell stories.



If the collaboration works well, I would like to send projects regularly.



As we work together, I want the editing process to become increasingly independent.



## Paid test edit



I would like to start with a small **paid editing test**.



I will provide the same footage to a few selected editors.



The test will be approximately a **60–90 second finished sequence**.



I am mainly evaluating:



1. Storytelling

2. Shot selection

3. Pacing

4. Music choices

5. How you use B-roll

6. Whether you know when to let an image breathe

7. Overall visual taste



Fancy effects will NOT give you extra points.



## When applying



Please send:



**1. Three examples of your work**



Please don't send 20 links.



Send the **three films that best represent your editing style**.



**2. Tell me what YOU edited in those films.**



**3. Tell me which software you use.**



**4. Tell me your hourly rate ($10–15/hour depending on experience.)**



**5. Tell me approximately how long you would normally need to edit a 10-minute YouTube film from organized A-roll and B-roll.**



And finally:



Write **“135mm”** at the beginning of your application.



This simply tells me that you actually read the job description.

title: Salesforce CRM Administrator
description:
About the Role



We’re looking for a detail-oriented and solutions-minded Salesforce Administrator to join our remote team and play an important role in keeping our Salesforce environment organized, reliable, and continuously improving.



This is a hands-on offshore role where you’ll work closely with U.S.-based teams across operations, intake, recruiting, billing, and leadership. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of real Salesforce projects, solve day-to-day challenges, and help build systems that make the business run more efficiently.

What You’ll Do

- Build and maintain reports and dashboards that help teams and leadership make better decisions.

- Test new configurations and changes thoroughly before they go live.

- Support integrations and connected tools when needed.

- Identify opportunities to improve existing Salesforce processes and make them more efficient, scalable, and user-friendly.

- Help maintain a Salesforce environment that is clean, organized, and easy for teams to use.



What We’re Looking For

- 1+ year of hands-on Salesforce Administrator experience.

- Strong understanding of Salesforce objects, fields, relationships, permissions, sharing, reports, dashboards, and automation.

- Experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting Salesforce Flows.

- Comfortable working with data imports, exports, updates, deduplication, and cleanup.

- Ability to understand business requirements and turn them into effective Salesforce solutions.

- Strong attention to detail and a habit of double-checking your work.

- Good written and verbal English communication skills.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote/offshore environment.

Nice to Have

- Salesforce Administrator Certification.

- Experience supporting healthcare, ABA, recruiting, intake, billing, or operations teams.

- Previous experience working with U.S.-based companies or international teams.

- Experience in a fast-moving startup or growth-stage company.



What Makes This Role Different

This isn’t a role where you’ll simply work through tickets all day. We’re looking for someone who can think through problems, understand the “why” behind a request, ask thoughtful questions, and build solutions that actually make people’s work easier.



You’ll have meaningful ownership over the Salesforce environment and the opportunity to improve systems that are used across different areas of the business. As you become familiar with our processes, we want you to bring ideas to the table, not just follow instructions.



You’ll work with a U.S.-based team while having the flexibility and independence of a remote role. It’s a great opportunity for someone in the Philippines who wants to grow their Salesforce expertise, gain international work experience, and have a real impact on a growing company.



If you’re someone who is...

- Naturally curious and enjoys solving problems

- Good at connecting business needs with technical solutions

- Organized and careful with details

- Comfortable taking ownership and working independently

- Confident communicating with an international team

- Excited to keep learning and improving



We’d love to hear from you.
