title: Amazon PPC Advertising Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Amazon PPC Advertising Specialist who understands how to take established brands with proven success on Shopify/DTC and successfully launch and scale them on Amazon.



This role requires more than simply managing existing campaigns. Many of the brands you will work with are established businesses but are new or relatively new to Amazon. These accounts require close attention, frequent optimization, and careful campaign development during the early stages.



What You'll Be Responsible For

Build Amazon PPC campaign structures for new and growing Amazon accounts

Develop launch strategies for brands with established Shopify/DTC sales

Perform keyword and competitor research before and during launches

Build and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns

Manage Exact, Phrase, Broad, Broad+, product targeting, and category targeting appropriately

Closely monitor new campaigns and make frequent bid and budget adjustments

Analyze search term reports and continually develop keyword targeting

Move converting search terms into more controlled campaign structures

Manage branded, non-branded, competitor, and product-targeting strategies

Scale advertising while monitoring ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, conversion rate, CPC, and overall sales

Identify when campaigns need more budget versus when spend needs to be controlled

Work closely with inventory levels so advertising does not create unnecessary stock issues

Identify listing or conversion problems that are preventing PPC from scaling

Provide clear reporting on performance, opportunities, problems, and next steps

What We're Looking For



You should have hands-on experience managing Amazon PPC accounts and understand that launching an established Shopify brand on Amazon requires a different approach than simply taking over a mature Amazon account.



We're looking for someone who understands how to:



Build an account correctly from the beginning

Generate initial traffic and sales without wasting spend

Develop search-term data and identify winning keywords

Protect branded traffic

Target competitor brands correctly

Scale winning campaigns

Control wasted spend

Balance ACOS and TACOS with overall growth

Recognize when PPC is not the problem and the listing, pricing, reviews, inventory, or offer needs attention



Attention to detail is extremely important. New accounts need close grooming and care. We do not want someone who launches campaigns and checks them once a week. You should be comfortable actively monitoring performance, identifying issues quickly, and making adjustments as the account develops.



Amazon PPC Knowledge Required



You should have a strong understanding of:



Sponsored Products

Sponsored Brands

Sponsored Display

Keyword targeting

Product/ASIN targeting

Broad, Broad+, Phrase, and Exact match types

Branded vs. non-branded campaign strategy

Competitor conquesting

Search term harvesting

Negative keywords/targets

Bid optimization

Placement adjustments

Budget management

ACOS and TACOS

Campaign scaling

New-product launches

Ideal Candidate



The ideal person is analytical but also proactive. We don't want someone who simply follows an automated optimization routine.



You should be able to look at an account and explain:



What's working? What's not working? Why? What should we change? Where should we spend more? Where should we pull back? And what needs to happen next to scale the brand?



Experience helping established Shopify/DTC brands expand onto Amazon is highly preferred.



When Applying



Please include:



How many years you have managed Amazon PPC.

Examples of Amazon accounts or brands you have helped launch or scale.

Typical monthly advertising spend you have managed.

Your approach to launching PPC for an established Shopify brand that is new to Amazon.

How you use Broad, Broad+, Phrase, and Exact differently.

How you approach branded and competitor-brand targeting.

How often you review and optimize a newly launched Amazon account.

An example of an account where you successfully scaled sales while managing TACOS/ACOS.



Optional Video Introduction



You are also welcome to include a short video introduction with your application. This is optional, but encouraged.



In the video, briefly introduce yourself and tell us about your Amazon PPC experience, the types of accounts you have managed, and your experience launching or scaling brands on Amazon.



This does not need to be professionally produced. A simple, short introduction is perfectly fine and gives us an opportunity to learn more about you and your experience beyond the written application.



Please provide specific answers. Generic or AI-generated PPC responses without examples of actual Amazon advertising experience will not be considered.



Position will begin as part time but can easily become a full time position once proven.

The primary focus of this role is answering incoming calls, making outbound calls, following up with prospective buyers and sellers, maintaining our lead database, and helping connect qualified opportunities with our real estate agents.

The right person is professional, personable, organized, dependable, and persistent without being overly aggressive.



Primary Responsibilities

Answer incoming phone calls professionally and promptly.

Make a minimum of 100 outbound calls per workday.

Contact and follow up with buyer and seller leads.

Speak confidently with prospective clients and determine their real estate needs and timeline.

Identify qualified opportunities and transfer or schedule them with the appropriate Raintown Realty agent.

Consistently follow up with leads who are not yet ready to buy or sell.

Work inside Follow Up Boss to manage leads, conversations, notes, tasks, appointments, and follow-up.

Work with leads generated and nurtured through Ylopo.

Keep detailed and accurate notes after conversations.

Update lead stages, statuses, and contact information.

Complete scheduled follow-up tasks every day.

Respond quickly to new lead inquiries.

Help ensure that opportunities do not fall through the cracks because of poor or inconsistent follow-up.

Communicate regularly with agents and management regarding qualified opportunities and important lead activity.

What We Are Looking For

Exceptional English Communication



Exceptional spoken English is required. You must be able to communicate naturally, confidently, and professionally with clients in the United States.



We are looking for someone who:



Speaks English fluently and clearly.

Has excellent listening and conversational skills.

Is easy for American clients to understand over the phone.

Can build rapport quickly.

Does not sound as though they are simply reading from a script.

Can comfortably handle unexpected questions and keep a conversation moving.



Excellent written English is also important for texting,
ing, documenting conversations, and communicating with our agents.



Strong Phone Skills



You must be comfortable making a large number of calls every day.



This position requires someone who can:



Consistently complete 100+ outbound calls per day.

Handle rejection without becoming discouraged.

Have natural conversations rather than simply reading a script.

Ask good questions.

Listen carefully.

Recognize potential buying or selling opportunities.

Follow up repeatedly when appropriate.

Know when a prospect is ready to speak with an agent.



If you dislike being on the phone or are uncomfortable making outbound calls, this will not be the right position for you.



Dependability



Reliability is extremely important to us.



You will be expected to:



Be logged in and ready to work on time every day.

Maintain consistent attendance.

Work your complete scheduled shift.

Communicate immediately if an emergency affects your ability to work.

Complete assigned tasks without needing constant reminders.



Our agents depend on this position, so attendance and punctuality are essential.



Preferred Experience



Candidates with the following experience will receive additional consideration:



Follow Up Boss

Ylopo

Real estate lead generation

Real estate ISA or inside sales experience

Cold calling

Appointment setting

Lead qualification

CRM management

Buyer and seller lead follow-up

Calling U.S.-based consumers



Experience with Follow Up Boss and Ylopo is strongly preferred. Candidates without direct experience may still be considered if they have strong real estate calling, CRM, or inside-sales experience and can learn new systems quickly.



Performance Expectations



Success in this position will be measured by more than simply the number of calls made. We are looking for someone who produces meaningful conversations and opportunities.



Performance may include:



Minimum of 100 outbound calls per day

Inbound call responsiveness

Number of meaningful conversations

Qualified lead transfers

Appointments or opportunities created

Consistency of follow-up

Accuracy of CRM records

Closed transactions resulting from transferred or nurtured leads

Attendance and punctuality

Compensation



Compensation consists of:



Hourly Pay + Performance Bonuses



Hourly compensation will depend on experience, English communication ability, real estate knowledge, and familiarity with Follow Up Boss and Ylopo.



Additional bonuses are available based on performance, including:



Qualified lead transfers

Successful appointments/opportunities

Closed real estate transactions resulting from your leads



This gives strong performers the opportunity to earn significantly more than their base hourly wage.



Schedule



Monday through Friday

8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time



Applicants must be able to reliably work these hours.



The Person Who Will Succeed Here



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work.



You should be someone who thinks:



“There are people in this database who are going to buy or sell a home. My job is to find them, build a relationship with them, follow up with them, and make sure we are there when they are ready.”



You should be persistent, competitive, friendly, organized, coachable, and comfortable being measured by results.



This is an important position within our company, and there is an opportunity to grow with us for someone who consistently performs.



How to Apply



When applying, please include:

Your experience with Follow Up Boss.

How many outbound calls you are accustomed to making in a normal workday.

Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant



$6–$8 USD/hour | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time



Every day, dozens of cleaning appointments depend on someone noticing small scheduling problems before they become big ones.



We are looking for that person.



Maid In America Cleaning Services is hiring a highly organized Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant to coordinate mobile cleaning teams, maintain accurate operational data, and communicate with customers when schedules change.



This is not a general administrative assistant role. This role is best suited for someone with experience coordinating schedules, customers, and day-to-day operations in a fast-paced service environment.



What You’ll Do



Your primary responsibility will be helping keep our field operations organized and running on schedule.



You will:

-Prepare and adjust cleaning schedules in Jobber

-Coordinate changes caused by call-outs, delays, and customer rescheduling requests

-Identify overlaps, drive-time issues, staffing conflicts, and other schedule problems

-Reassign or resequence jobs within established guidelines

-Answer inbound customer calls related to scheduling and basic support

-Make outbound calls to communicate delays and schedule changes

-Maintain accurate customer, job, and service information

-Update operational trackers and reports

-Complete invoicing, payroll-support, and cost-of-service tasks

-Escalate decisions that require management approval



You will follow established processes while also using judgment when a situation does not perfectly match the written procedure.



Who We’re Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you:

-Notice small details and inconsistencies others miss

-Work quickly without sacrificing accuracy

-Enjoy solving scheduling and logistics problems

-Follow SOPs, checklists, and operating rules consistently

-Can investigate and solve routine problems independently

-Know when to stop and escalate a decision

-Communicate confidently and professionally with customers

-Stay calm when priorities change

-Learn new software quickly

-Take ownership of mistakes and correct them promptly



Experience



Previous experience in scheduling, dispatching, operations coordination, or managing appointments in a fast-paced service environment is preferred.



Direct experience scheduling or dispatching employees who travel to customer locations is strongly preferred, but candidates with strong general scheduling, customer service, administrative coordination, or operations experience may also be considered.



Relevant backgrounds may include:

-Residential cleaning

-HVAC

-Plumbing

-Electrical

-Landscaping

-Pest control

-Home health

-Delivery

-Property maintenance

-Appointment scheduling

-Customer service

-Administrative or operations coordination

-Managing changing schedules, CRM updates, multiple priorities, and operational processes



Strongly Preferred

-Direct Jobber experience

-Experience with other field-service platforms

-Customer phone support experience

-Dispatch or logistics experience

-Google Workspace

-Slack

-Spreadsheet and reporting experience



Work Requirements

-Full-time availability

-Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time

-Fluent spoken and written English

-Reliable computer and dedicated workspace

-Reliable internet connection with a backup option

-Backup power solution

-No work for another employer or client during scheduled working hours



Compensation



$6–$8 USD per hour, based on directly relevant experience.



Candidates with direct Jobber experience, mobile-team scheduling experience, and strong customer phone skills will receive priority consideration.



Our Core Values

-Communication

-Connection

-Quality

-Service

-Teamwork



How to Apply



Complete our Culture Index survey:


/p/8Y0GG4Nyz4



In your application message, please include:

- A brief summary of your scheduling, dispatch, or operations experience

- The scheduling, CRM, or field-service software you have used, including whether you have Jobber experience

- One specific scheduling or operational problem you handled and what you did to resolve it



Please make your answers specific and based on your actual experience.



Applications that do not complete the Culture Index survey or do not provide enough information for us to understand your relevant experience may not be reviewed.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Part-Time) — Food Brand, Instagram Reels & TikTok
description:
I run a small Palestinian food brand in the United States. I film all my own content and I need a part-time editor to take the raw footage and build the rough cut so I can post more often.



This is a long-term part-time role, not a one-off project. I want to build a real working relationship with one editor.



What you'll do:



- Edit vertical short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts (20 to 60 seconds each)

- Take my raw phone footage from a shared Google Drive folder and cut it down to a rough edit, about 80 percent finished

- Trim clips, build the structure, set the pacing, add sound effects

- Deliver the rough cut back to me so I can do the final polish myself



Most videos are cooking and recipe content. Some are me talking to the camera telling a story about the business.



What I need from you:



1. Experience editing short-form vertical video for Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts. Please show me examples you personally edited.

2. Fast, tight pacing. No slow openings. In a recipe video the food needs to be on screen quickly.

3. Good instinct for sound effects — sizzles, chopping, crunching. Food videos live and die on this.

4. You can follow a written format and repeat it consistently. I will give you a detailed brief and reference videos.

5. Reliable communication and on-time delivery. I would rather have honest updates than silence.



Software: I edit in CapCut. Tell me what you use, open to whatever since in the end, you will share me your rough cut and I will polish in CapCut. 



Hours and pay: Starting at about ~10 hours per week, pay depending on experience. Hours can increase over time if it goes well. Paid weekly. I'm hiring for the long term. The trial edit is paid and exists so we can both find out if the style is a fit before committing.



How to apply — please read carefully, I will not respond to applications that skip this:



1. Start your message with this password: "ZAATAR" so I know you read the full post :) 

2. Send links to 2 or 3 short-form videos you personally edited. Tell me specifically what you did on each one.

3. Tell me what software you edit in.

4. Answer this question in one or two sentences: what makes for a great, engaging video?



Shortlisted applicants will be paid for a short test edit on one real video before I make a final decision. Everyone gets the same footage so I can compare fairly.

title: You tube editor
description:
Part-Time YouTube Video Editor



We are looking for an experienced YouTube Video Editor to join our team on a part-time basis.



This is primarily a long-form YouTube editing position. We are NOT looking for someone whose main experience is making TikToks, Reels, or short-form videos.



Our goal is to create high-quality YouTube videos that keep viewers watching and encourage them to come back for more.



What You'll Do

Edit long-form YouTube videos, generally 8–20+ minutes

Turn raw footage into engaging, polished YouTube content

Create strong pacing and storytelling throughout the video

Remove unnecessary pauses, repetition, and boring sections

Add B-roll, graphics, images, screen recordings, music, and sound effects when appropriate

Create an engaging opening/hook

Use editing techniques that help maintain viewer retention

Add clean, professional captions or text when appropriate

Make revisions based on feedback

Deliver completed videos on schedule

What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate:



Has proven experience editing successful YouTube videos

Understands YouTube audience retention

Knows how to keep a long-form video interesting without over-editing

Has strong storytelling and pacing skills

Can recognize when a section needs to be shortened, rearranged, or removed

Has good judgment about B-roll, music, graphics, and sound effects

Is comfortable working independently

Communicates well and meets deadlines

Is interested in building a long-term working relationship



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar professional editing software is preferred.



YouTube Experience Is Important



Please do not apply if your experience is primarily TikTok/Reels/Shorts editing.



We want to see examples of your long-form YouTube work.



When applying, please provide:



Your portfolio

Links to 3–5 YouTube videos you have edited

If possible, tell us what part of each video you were responsible for

Your video editing software

Your hourly rate

Your availability and how many hours per week you can commit



If you have worked on a YouTube channel where you can share performance information such as average view duration, audience retention, or views, that is a major plus.



Hours



Part-time: approximately 10–20 hours per week



We are looking for someone reliable who can consistently meet deadlines. The schedule can be flexible as long as communication and deadlines are maintained.



Compensation will depend on experience and editing ability.



Trial Project



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a paid test edit using our footage.



The test will help us evaluate your storytelling, pacing, editing style, and ability to create a video that keeps viewers engaged.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to work with us long term and become familiar with our content, audience, and style.



If you understand that successful YouTube editing is about much more than simply cutting footage together, we would love to hear from you.



To apply, please begin your application with the words "YOUTUBE EDITOR" so we know you read the entire posting.

title: Ecom Video Editors
description:
We're launching a new brand under our company umbrella, and we need a video editor who can help us scale it fast. Our main product currently spends $15,000/month on Meta ads, and this new product has huge upside potential — we're building out a dedicated video editing team to fuel it.



This is a full-time, high-output role. We need someone who can ramp up quickly and hit our production pace within the first two weeks: 7 edited batches per week, with each batch containing 3 basic variations of the original ad.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Edit and produce ecom-style video ads (UGC, native, direct-response) for Meta/Facebook and other paid social platforms

- Turn winning ad concepts into fast, on-brief variations (hooks, pacing, captions, text overlays, etc.)

- Work closely with our creative and media buying team to keep a constant pipeline of fresh creative moving

- Hit weekly batch quotas consistently once ramped up



BONUSES (on top of your base salary):

- Spend Winner Bonus: $150 per video

- KPI Winner Bonus: $150 per video

- Breakthrough Winner Bonus (an ad that allows us to scale the account): $800 per video



Most of our video editors land 1-3 bonuses per month, which typically pushes total monthly pay to $3,000-$4,000.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

This is a hyper-competitive, self-selective role. We already have a team of 14 people producing at a high level, and we need someone who can keep up. You must be able to commit full-time and consistently hit our output requirements — this is not a fit for editors looking for light, part-time, or low-volume work.



REQUIREMENTS:

- Proven experience editing short-form ecom/DTC video ads (UGC-style, direct-response, or performance creative)

- Strong sense of pacing, hooks, and what makes an ad "scroll-stopping"

- Ability to work efficiently in Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar editing software

- Reliable, fast turnaround, and comfortable with a high-volume production schedule

- Full-time availability, 50 hours/week



Desired Hours per Week: 50

Base Wage: $2,500/month (plus bonuses — see above)

title: Virutal Assistant - Newsletter Production and Admin
description:
We run two growing newsletters SCV Secret Sauce, a Santa Clarita food and dining newsletter, and Bottom of the 90, a Premier League newsletter built for American fans.



We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to become part of our weekly production process.



This is primarily a production role, not a content-creation role. We provide the articles, photos, information, templates and editorial direction. Your job is to help turn that material into polished newsletters ready for final review.



The position starts at approximately 6 hours per week at $7 USD/hour, with a clear opportunity to grow to 12 and eventually 20 hours per week as the newsletters grow.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



SCV Secret Sauce — Weekly



You'll receive most of the week's material by Sunday night.



* Build approximately 3 articles into our existing Beehiiv template

* Upload and format articles and photos

* Proofread and flag errors or inconsistencies

* Check links and newsletter formatting

* Resize, crop and make basic adjustments to images

* Find and compile upcoming Santa Clarita food events using Instagram, web research and AI tools

* Format our "Next Week" section

* Have the newsletter ready for our review by Tuesday



Bottom of the 90 - Weekly



* Build our Friday Premier League newsletter in Beehiiv

* Upload and format articles and fantasy football content we provide

* Proofread and flag errors

* Resize and make basic adjustments to images

* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT to assist with research, fact-checking and editing when instructed

* Check links, images and formatting

* Have the newsletter ready for our review by Wednesday



We provide the core editorial direction and material. You will **not** be expected to independently write the newsletters or decide their editorial direction.



Admin — Approximately 1–2 Hours Per Week



* Bookkeeping data entry from statements and receipts we provide

* Organize receipts and supporting records

* Keep Dropbox folders organized

* Maintain simple spreadsheets and internal records



No banking access will be provided or required.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should have:



* Experience with Beehiiv OR another
/newsletter platform

* Strong written English

* Excellent attention to detail

* Experience using ChatGPT, Claude or similar AI tools

* Basic image-editing skills

* Adobe Illustrator experience is helpful

* Good organization and file-management skills

* Reliable communication

* Ability to work independently from templates and written instructions



Experience with newsletters, publishing, social media or digital media is a bonus.



Direct Beehiiv experience is preferred but not essential if you're experienced with similar platforms and willing to learn.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Once you've learned our systems, we want to be able to send you the week's material and trust you to:



1. Organize everything correctly

2. Build the newsletters using our templates

3. Catch obvious mistakes

4. Flag anything you're unsure about rather than guessing

5. Deliver everything on time for final review



We will provide templates, examples and clear processes.



We're looking for someone who wants a long-term position and can grow with us.



GROWTH PATH



Level 1 — $7/hour — approximately 6 hours/week

Newsletter production and basic admin.



Level 2 — $8.50/hour — approximately 12 hours/week

Increased newsletter production plus Instagram publishing and additional responsibilities.



Level 3 — $10/hour — approximately 20 hours/week

Expanded operations, store/e-commerce support and monetization administration.



Progression is based on business growth, performance, reliability and increased responsibility rather than time alone.



Our current goal is potentially to move toward Level 2 around October and Level 3 around January.



WORKING STYLE



This is a remote and mostly asynchronous role.



You don't need to work U.S. hours, but you must meet our weekly deadlines and communicate clearly if you have questions or encounter a problem.



We're looking for someone dependable who wants to become part of the team long-term.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your experience with Beehiiv or similar newsletter/email platforms

3. Your experience using ChatGPT, Claude or other AI tools

4. Your experience with Adobe Illustrator or other image-editing software

5. Your current availability

6. An example of newsletter/email work you've done, if available



Please also answer this question:



You're building a newsletter from our template and notice that information in the article doesn't match information shown in an image we've provided. What would you do?



Please include the words "Secret Sauce" at the beginning of your application so we know you've read the full job post.

title: Creative Director/Brand Strategist

-Identify and prioritize the essential MVP features

-Establish the overall creative and product direction

-Collaborate with UX/UI designers and developers

title: Head of Customer Support
description:
About Us



JustFloow is a fast-growing, seven-figure UK supplement brand. Our products – Genius Mind (cognitive performance) and Aura (nicotine-free nootropic pouches) – help thousands of subscribers perform at their best every day. We're a lean, ambitious team, and customer experience is at the heart of how we grow.



The Role:

You'll own the entire customer experience. This is not a ticket-answering job — this is a leadership role. You'll be the voice of JustFloow to our customers and the voice of our customers to the team.



What you'll do:

Own the inbox. Reply to customer
s quickly, clearly, and warmly. Fast response times, zero backlog.

Retain subscribers. We're a subscription business. Every cancellation request, delivery issue, or complaint is a chance to save a customer you'll know how to turn frustration into loyalty.



Drive reviews. Make sure every happy customer is invited to leave a Trustpilot review. Grow our review count and rating month over month.



Master our tools. Manage subscriptions in Loop, run support through Richpanel (including its AI/automation features), and work within Shopify.



Automate with a human touch. We use automation — but our customers should never feel like they're talking to a robot. You'll refine templates, macros, and AI-assisted flows so they sound personal, warm, and on-brand.



Build systems. Spot repeated questions, create and improve saved replies, streamline processes so we get more efficient every month.



Report to the team. You're on the ground listening to customers. You'll produce regular reports on patterns, complaints, product feedback, and insights that improve our marketing and products.



Take ownership. No hand-holding. You see a problem, you fix it or flag it with a proposed solution.



Who we're looking for:



- 3+ years in ecommerce customer support, ideally DTC / subscription brands

- Experience with Richpanel (or Gorgias/Zendesk) and Loop (or Recharge/other subscription apps) and Shopify

- Excellent written English — clear, warm, concise. Your
s feel human, No robotic chatgpt answers allowed. 

- Retention mindset: you understand LTV and know how to No robotic chatgpt answers allowed subscribers, not just close tickets

- Know common human psychology and how to make people feel safe, comfortable, happy, and make them trust us

- Organised, proactive systems thinker — you build processes, not just follow them

- Comfortable working UK business hours (at least significant overlap)

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, own computer



Bonus points:

- Health/supplement brand experience

- Experience setting up Richpanel automations or AI agents

- Experience driving Trustpilot/review growth

- Team lead experience (you may hire and manage CX agents as we scale)



What we offer:

- Competitive salary (based on experience) — paid on time, every time

- Full-time, long-term stable role

- Real growth path: as JustFloow scales, so does your role and pay

- Work directly with the founder — your ideas will actually be implemented

- 13th month pay and paid time off



How to apply — READ CAREFULLY



We only consider applications that follow these instructions. Generic copy-paste applications are deleted without reading.

Start your application with the word "FLOWSTATE" in the first line.



Answer these three questions (short paragraphs, in your own words — AI-generated answers are obvious and will be rejected):



A subscriber
s: "This didn't work for me, cancel my subscription and refund me." Write your exact reply.



Tell us about a support system or process you built that made a team more efficient. What was the measurable result?



Which support tools have you personally used (be specific — name the platforms), and what did you use them for?



Include your expected monthly salary and earliest start date.



Attach a short Loom video (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself and telling us why this role fits you.



Applications missing any of the above will not be considered. If you're detail-orientated, this is your first chance to test and show your expertise and potentially gain a role in one of the fastest-growing brands in the UK.

 ) is a stable, profitable US company operating two fast-growing e-commerce brands on Amazon and our own websites. We're small by design — which means your work is visible, your ideas get implemented, and there's nowhere to hide mediocrity. Tea
mbers who prove themselves here stay for years and grow into leadership.

- Building and refining AI-assisted content workflows that make the whole team faster





Who Thrives Here:

- Expert English writers with a broad, creative vocabulary and flawless grammar

- Self-teachers — people who've learned skills on their own, without a classroom

- Process-improvers — you notice repetitive work and instinctively find a faster way

- Independent problem-solvers who find answers before asking questions

- People seeking a long-term professional home, not a gig





What We Offer:

- USD salary, paid every Friday — no waiting, no delays

- HMO health coverage

- Paid time off and paid holidays

- Performance-based raises and bonuses — results get rewarded here

- Hands-on training in premium AI tools and workflow automation most people can't access — skills that will compound your market value for the rest of your career

- Real advancement: we promote from within into strategy and leadership roles

- Permanent work from home with semi-flexible hours





Schedule & Requirements:

- Mostly graveyard shift (US business hours). 

- We use a time tracker that takes screenshots. If that's a dealbreaker, please don't apply.

- If you can't meet the highest standard of writing, please don't apply. We'd rather have an honest pass than a wasted week.





How to Apply:

Applications missing any item below will not be reviewed — attention to detail starts now.



1. **Start your application with the phrase "Built for leverage"** so we know you read this far.

2. **Complete this 15-minute exercise:** Using any AI tool you can access (free ChatGPT or Claude is fine), write a 100-word product description for a heavy-duty lockout tagout padlock used in industrial safety. Then submit all three of these:

   - (a) your final polished version,

   - (c) a few sentences on what you changed by hand and why.

   There's no "right" answer — we want to see how you think, direct a tool, and apply editorial judgment.

3. **Link to 2–3 writing samples** you're genuinely proud of.

4. **Answer in a short paragraph each:**

   - Describe one skill or tool you taught yourself entirely on your own. How did you do it?

   - Describe one repetitive task (in any job or in life) that you streamlined, automated, or eliminated.

5. **Link to your resume** with detailed work history.

6. **Tell us the hours you can commit to** within our shift.



If you've read this whole post and thought "finally, a company that gets it" — we're looking for you. Apply today.

title: Sponsorship Support Coordinator
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Sponsorship Support Coordinator to help manage the day-to-day administration of our athlete and sponsorship programs.



This is a support and coordination role focused heavily on tracking, communication, follow-up, organization, and accuracy.



You will help ensure sponsored athletes understand their program expectations, required activities are properly tracked, rewards are accurately recorded, and outstanding items are followed up on without needing constant management direction.



The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys keeping things organized, notices when information is missing, follows through until something is complete, and is comfortable communicating professionally with athletes and internal team members.



Key Responsibilities

Sponsorship Support

Assist with onboarding new sponsored athletes and program participants.

Communicate sponsorship expectations, requirements, deadlines, and routine program updates.

Answer general sponsorship and program questions.

Monitor whether sponsored athletes are completing required activities and expectations.

Follow up directly regarding missing information, incomplete requirements, or outstanding items.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date sponsorship records.

Update athlete status, account information, program details, and internal notes as needed.

Escalate contract questions, exceptions, repeated non-compliance, or other concerns to management.

Activity & Expectation Tracking



A major responsibility of this position is making sure our sponsorship program is properly tracked.



You will be expected to:



Track individual sponsorship requirements and activity.

Review submitted activities for completeness.

Maintain organized records of completed and outstanding requirements.

Proactively identify athletes who are behind on expectations.

Follow up on missing activities rather than waiting for management to identify them.

Ensure our internal systems accurately reflect the current status of each sponsorship.

Manual Reward Tracking



Some sponsorship rewards require manual review and tracking.



Responsibilities include:



Review qualifying activities and reward submissions.

Calculate and record applicable rewards based on established program rules.

Maintain accurate records of rewards earned, pending, and previously processed.

Identify discrepancies or missing information before rewards are submitted for approval.

Prepare reward information for management review.

Respond to routine questions regarding reward status or requirements.



Strong attention to detail is extremely important for this responsibility.



Customer & Administrative Support



In addition to sponsorship responsibilities, this position may assist with:



Customer service and support requests.

Account updates.

Data entry and record maintenance.

Internal administrative projects.

Researching account or order information.

Coordinating with other departments when an issue requires additional information.

Supporting other Customer Success responsibilities as assigned.

What We Expect



This is a Level II support position, meaning we are looking for someone capable of independently managing recurring responsibilities.



You should not need to be reminded every day to check whether something is overdue or incomplete.



We expect you to:



Take ownership of assigned responsibilities from start to finish.

Follow up proactively.

Keep trackers and systems updated.

Double-check your work for accuracy.

Identify missing or conflicting information.

Communicate clearly and professionally.

Ask questions when instructions are genuinely unclear.

Follow established processes consistently.

Escalate issues appropriately when management approval or intervention is required.



Passing an issue to another person does not automatically mean your responsibility is complete. You are expected to maintain visibility and follow up until the assigned matter is resolved.



Required Qualifications

Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent attention to detail.

Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Experience with customer service, administrative support, account management, operations, or a similar role.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets, trackers, and online business systems.

Ability to manage repetitive tracking responsibilities accurately.

Ability to follow written processes and instructions.

Comfortable communicating directly with customers, athletes, partners, and internal team members.

Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple responsibilities.

Reliable internet connection and remote-work environment.

Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:



Sponsorship or athlete management

Influencer or ambassador programs

Customer Success

E-commerce

Shopify

Gorgias or similar customer support platforms

Asana or similar project management platforms

Google Workspace

Spreadsheet-based tracking and reporting

title: Accountant Virtual Assistant

Teamwork

Integrity

Accuracy

Dependability

Good communication

Attention to detail

A positive attitude

Bookkeepers

Staff Accountants

Property Accountants

Senior Accountants

CPAs / Experienced Accounting Professionals

Entering and coding invoices and expenses

Bank and credit card reconciliations

Reviewing property-level income and expenses

Maintaining accurate accounting records for multiple properties and entities

General ledger accounting

Assisting with monthly financial reporting and month-end closing

Preparing and reviewing financial statements

Identifying and researching accounting discrepancies

Tracking vendor invoices and payments

Maintaining organized electronic accounting records and supporting documentation

Preparing reports and Excel spreadsheets for management

Assisting with multifamily property management accounting

Assisting with real estate development accounting

Working with multiple companies, properties, and legal entities

Working closely with our U.S. accounting and management teams

Working collaboratively with our Filipino virtual team members

Other accounting and administrative responsibilities appropriate to your experience level

What We're Looking For

Required for All Positions

College degree in Accounting

Strong understanding of accounting principles

Excellent written and spoken English

Strong computer skills

Good Microsoft Excel skills

Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills

Dependable and able to meet deadlines

Ability to manage daily responsibilities without constant supervision

Ability to work both independently and collaboratively

Positive attitude and willingness to help others

Honest and professional

A genuine team player

Fast and reliable internet connection

Interest in a stable, long-term position



Experience with multifamily real estate, property management, or real estate development accounting is a plus, but it is not required.



If you have a strong accounting education and are willing and excited to learn our business and systems, we encourage you to apply.



Additional Qualifications That Are a Plus



While not required, we are especially interested in candidates who also have:



Multifamily or property management accounting experience

Real estate development accounting experience

Advanced accounting education or certifications

CPA or similar professional credentials

Experience working with multiple properties and business entities

Strong Excel and financial reporting skills

Experience with accounting or property management software

A law degree or additional legal education

Experience with contracts, corporate matters, real estate transactions, compliance, or other business-related legal work



A law degree is not required, and this is not a position requiring the practice of U.S. law.



However, because our business involves real estate development, property management, contracts, transactions, and multiple business entities, we consider legal education or relevant legal experience to be a valuable additional qualification.



If you have a strong accounting background combined with legal education or experience, we would especially welcome your application.



One Full-Time Job Only



This is an important requirement of the position.



We understand that some virtual professionals work for multiple companies at the same time. For our company, however, full-time team members are required to work exclusively for our company and may not hold another job at the same time.



We want our team members to be fully focused on their responsibilities during working hours. At the same time, we believe it is important for people to have time away from work for themselves, their families, and their personal lives.



If you currently have another job, you are still very welcome to apply. However, if selected, you must be prepared to leave your other employment before beginning your full-time position with us.



We are looking for people who want one stable, long-term position and an opportunity to grow with our company.



What We Offer

Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications

Opportunities ranging from accounting support positions to senior professional accounting roles

Stable, long-term employment

An established California company with more than 30 years in business

Friendly, respectful, and supportive working environment

U.S. and Filipino team members who work together

Opportunity to learn U.S. multifamily real estate accounting

Exposure to both real estate development and property management

Opportunity to take on additional responsibilities as you learn our business

A company that values good people and long-term working relationships

How to Apply



Please send us your resume along with a short introduction telling us:



Your college degree and accounting education

Your accounting experience

The type of accounting position you are interested in

Any real estate, multifamily, property management, or development accounting experience

Accounting and property management software you have used

Your experience with Microsoft Excel

Any additional degrees, certifications, CPA credentials, or legal education

Your current work situation and availability

Why you are interested in a long-term, full-time position with our company

ID Proof Requirement



Applicants must have an ID Proof score of 70 or higher.



DISC Assessment



If you have previously completed a DISC personality assessment, please feel free to include your DISC profile or results with your application.



DISC results are optional and are not required to apply.



We use DISC simply as one way to better understand communication and working styles. It is not a pass-or-fail test.



One Small but Important Request



Attention to detail is very important in accounting!



To let us know that you carefully read our entire job posting, please include the words “TEAM PLAYER” somewhere in your application.



There is no trick—we simply want to meet applicants who take the time to understand the position before applying.



We Look Forward to Meeting You!



If you have a college degree in Accounting and are organized, dependable, honest, positive, and enjoy being part of a team, we would be very happy to hear from you.



Whether you are an accounting professional early in your career or an experienced Accountant or CPA, we welcome you to apply.



We are proud to have been in business for more than 30 years, and we hope to find people who would like to build a long-term future with our team.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Client Intake Specialist (Full-Time)
description:
Job Title: Client Intake Specialist (Full-Time)

Company: A Kind Heart Healthcare Services (akindheart./info/)



About Us:

A Kind Heart Healthcare Services is a growing U.S.-based home care agency providing compassionate, non-medical support services to seniors and individuals needing assistance at home. As we expand our operations, our intake team serves as the critical central hub for all incoming communications.



We are looking for an organized, empathetic, and multi-skilled Client Intake Specialist who will not only manage prospective client inquiries across multiple digital channels but also act as the primary liaison routing all communications across our agency departments.



Important Note:

This is a high-impact, central coordination role. Applicants without proven experience in customer intake, multi-channel communication handling (Phone, SMS,
, and Social Media), or efficient call routing should not apply. We need a specialist who can hit the ground running, manage multiple communication tools seamlessly, and ensure every caller or message is directed to the right place without delay.



Responsibilities:



• Multi-Channel Communication Management: Act as the central point of contact monitoring and responding to inquiries across Dialpad (calls), GoHighLevel / GHL (SMS and
),
 Messenger/Inquiries, and web chat, consistently upholding our "sincere & humanized" brand tone.

• Central Agency Liaison & Call Routing: Serve as the primary liaison between all departments. Filter incoming calls and messages, quickly identifying non-prospect inquiries (such as caregiver applicants or current staff matters) and seamlessly transferring them to the appropriate department, such as Staffing or HR.

• Lead Qualification & Assessment: Utilize intake frameworks, care cost estimations, and initial health/support requirement questions to properly qualify prospective clients and match them with appropriate care solutions.

• Pipeline & Data Tracking: Capture, update, and manage prospective client data meticulously within JotForm, Excel, GoHighLevel, and our tracking dashboards on Monday. com.

• Collaboration: Partner closely with recruitment, HR, and care coordination teams on MS Teams to ensure smooth handoffs from initial contact to final internal resolution.

• Process Optimization: Proactively refine routing workflows, intake scripts, and follow-up cadences to improve response speeds and inter-departmental efficiency.

• Compliance & Record Keeping: Maintain accurate, confidential records of all interactions and care preferences in alignment with agency policies.



Required Skills:



• Healthcare & Communications Experience: Proven track record in healthcare coordination, medical administrative support, or client intake—preferably with a background or familiarity in nursing, medical fields, or home care operations.

• Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with tools like GoHighLevel (GHL), Dialpad,
 Business Pages, JotForm, Monday. com, and Excel.

• Communication Pro: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You know how to listen actively, triage inquiries efficiently, and maintain a warm, reassuring tone.

• Empathy & Judgment: High emotional intelligence to handle sensitive inquiries from families, clients, or staff members and route them accurately under pressure.

• Proactive & Organized: A self-starter who manages their time exceptionally well, tracks follow-ups rigorously, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

• True Autonomy: Able to work independently under minimal supervision while keeping leadership informed through clear, proactive updates.



Good to Know:



• Flexibility: We support a results-oriented work environment. You are welcome to manage other professional commitments, provided that all intake targets are met and response-time standards are upheld without exception.

• Performance Incentive: We are invested in your success. After 90 days, depending on performance, you may receive an increase of $0.50 per hour.



Work Schedule:



• Schedule: Full-Time.

• Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Pacific Standard Time (PST).

• Break: Includes a 30-minute break within the shift.



Compensation:



• $4.50 USD per hour.



How to Apply:



Please
 your Resume/CV to: 

Subject Line: "Client Intake Specialist - [Your Full Name]"



In your
, please include:



1. Your experience managing multi-channel communications and any background you have in healthcare, medical fields, or nursing (specifically mentioning your comfort with handling calls via Dialpad, social media messaging via
, and managing SMS/Email via GoHighLevel or similar CRMs).

2. Tell me which 3 keyboard shortcuts or Excel functions you use most often to increase your efficiency (to show your technical proficiency).

3. Tell me about a time you had to juggle multiple incoming inquiries across different channels at once and successfully triage or route a misdirected inquiry to the correct department. How did you handle it?

.

We’re hiring an experienced Automation & Integrations Expert to build, maintain, and improve our automation systems across these tools. This role is for someone who thinks in systems, follows instructions precisely, and produces clean, reliable automations with clear documentation.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Build and maintain automations primarily in 
, connecting tools via native integrations, webhooks, and APIs

- Build and maintain CRMs, pipelines, workflows, and automations in GoHighLevel

- Build and maintain operational systems in ClickUp (lists, statuses, templates, custom fields, relationships, views)

- Troubleshoot broken automations and improve reliability (edge cases, de-dupe, error handling, alerts/logging)

- Create SOPs and documentation for all automations (so another tea
mber can understand and maintain them)

- Improve existing workflows and recommend better system design when needed

- Collaborate with the operations team to implement new systems quickly and accurately

- Bonus (nice-to-have): Help maintain and update our website (WordPress/Webflow/Squarespace or similar).

- Bonus (nice-to-have): Familiarity with AI agents, LLM-based automation, or tools that can support more advanced workflow execution and process efficiency. 



YOU’D BE A GREAT FIT IF

- You have real experience in GoHighLevel (pipelines + workflows + automation logic)

- You’re very comfortable in ClickUp and can structure systems cleanly (not just “use tasks”)

- You can build in 
 with routers, filters, field mapping, and reliable error handling

- You understand webhooks, APIs, and JSON at a practical level

- You communicate clearly in English and can explain what you built without rambling

- You follow instructions exactly and don’t cut corners

- You’re proactive: you don’t just “build what’s asked,” you notice what will break and fix it



REQUIREMENTS

- Proven experience building automations (Make / Zapier / n8n or similar)

- Strong working knowledge of CRMs and workflow automation (GHL preferred)

- Strong working knowledge of project management systems (ClickUp preferred)

- Comfortable with webhooks/APIs/JSON

ROLE DETAILS

- Full-time, remote

- Schedule: Monday–Friday, aligned with CST (8 AM – 5 PM CST, includes lunch break)

- Pay: $3-5 USD/hour, depending on experience

- Long-term role with growth potential



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

We do not review platfor
ssages.

Applications that don’t follow instructions are disqualified.



STEP 1 — MESSAGE US

1. Send us a message here in OLJ

2. Subject line must be exactly: Automation Expert Application – [Full Name]

3.
 body must contain only:

- A short greeting (1–2 lines)

- A Google Drive folder link (see Step 2)

- Your Detail Check answer at the very bottom (see Step 3)



STEP 2 — GOOGLE DRIVE FOLDER

1. Create a folder named exactly: Automation Expert – [Your Full Name]

2. Set sharing to: Anyone with the link can view

3. Include the following items (clearly organized):

a. Resume (PDF preferred)

b. Tech & Setup

c. Video Proof (REQUIRED) — one single screen-share video

      - Quick intro

. If you have access:

title: Amazon Listing Creation & Optimization Specialist | SEO, Copywriting, Infographics & A+ Strategy
description:
Amazon Listing Creation & Optimization Specialist



We are looking for an experienced Amazon Listing Creation & Optimization Specialist to join our team for a long-term position.



IMPORTANT — Please Read Before Applying



You must have real, hands-on experience personally creating Amazon listings from scratch.



If you have not personally researched products, performed keyword and competitor research, developed the listing strategy, and created complete Amazon listings, please do not apply.



General Amazon VA experience, Seller Central experience, PPC experience, account management, or general copywriting experience alone is not enough for this position.



We are looking specifically for someone who already knows how to take a product and turn it into a strong, professional, conversion-focused Amazon listing.



What You Will Be Doing



You will be given product information, specifications, and product photos.



From there, we expect you to independently research and understand the product and develop the complete Amazon listing strategy.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Understanding the product, how it works, who uses it, and why customers would buy it

* Researching competing products and Amazon listings

* Analyzing competitor strengths and weaknesses

* Identifying important customer pain points

* Finding the strongest product features and translating them into meaningful customer benefits

* Identifying selling points and opportunities competitors may be missing

* Performing Amazon keyword research

* Selecting and prioritizing relevant keywords

* Developing the SEO strategy for the listing

* Writing optimized Amazon titles

* Writing persuasive, benefit-focused bullet points

* Writing product descriptions when applicable

* Structuring the listing so important information is easy for customers to understand

* Identifying customer questions, concerns, objections, and buying considerations that should be addressed

* Planning listing images and infographics

* Writing headlines, callouts, benefits, and copy for listing images

* Giving clear direction to the graphic designer regarding what each image should communicate

* Planning A+ Content

* Developing the messaging and structure for A+ Content

* Making sure the title, bullets, images, infographics, and A+ Content all work together as one complete sales presentation

* Reviewing completed listings and identifying areas that can be improved



This Is More Than Copywriting



We are not looking for someone who simply writes a title and five bullet points based on the information we provide.



You need to be able to think strategically about the product.



For example, if a product has ten meaningful benefits, we do not want five bullet points that repeat essentially the same benefit using slightly different wording.



We expect you to uncover different selling angles, understand what customers actually care about, anticipate their questions, and determine what information will help convince them to purchase.



The listing should feel specific to the product—not generic Amazon copy that could be used for dozens of similar products.



Independent Research Is Very Important



We do not want to provide every selling point and tell you exactly what to write.



Part of your job is to:



research ? understand ? analyze ? strategize ? create



You should be comfortable receiving basic product information and then doing the work necessary to understand the market and build the listing.



You should also know when something is unclear and be able to ask specific, intelligent product questions when necessary.



AI Usage



You may use AI tools as part of your workflow.



However, we are not looking for someone who simply enters the product information into ChatGPT or another AI tool and submits the generated copy.



The finished work must demonstrate:



* Real research

* Product understanding

* Strategic thinking

* Good judgment

* Strong Amazon knowledge

* Original selling angles

* Attention to detail



AI can assist you. It should not replace your thinking.



Experience & Skills



You should have strong experience with:



* Amazon listing creation

* Amazon listing optimization

* Amazon SEO

* Keyword research

* Competitor research

* Conversion-focused copywriting

* Product positioning

* Listing image and infographic strategy

* A+ Content strategy



Experience with tools such as the following is preferred:



* Helium 10

* Data Dive

* Jungle Scout

* Amazon Brand Analytics

* Amazon Search Query Performance

* Other Amazon keyword or competitor research tools



You should also stay familiar with current Amazon listing policies, title requirements, listing best practices, and changes to how customers discover and evaluate products on Amazon.



Who We Are NOT Looking For



Please do not apply if:



* You have never personally created Amazon listings

* Your experience is mainly general VA work

* You only upload listings that someone else has already written

* You mainly manage Seller Central but do not create listing content

* You are only a general copywriter without Amazon-specific experience

* You depend on the client to provide every feature, benefit, keyword, and selling point

* You primarily use AI to generate listings without doing meaningful research

* You cannot show examples of Amazon listings you personally worked on



How to Apply



Please send the following:



1. Tell us about your hands-on experience creating Amazon listings.



Keep this specific. We want to know what you personally do when creating a listing.



2. Send 3–5 LIVE Amazon listing links that you personally worked on.



For each listing, tell us exactly what you were responsible for.



For example:



* Keyword research

* Competitor research

* Title

* Bullet points

* Description

* Image/infographic strategy

* A+ Content

* Full listing creation



Please send live Amazon links whenever possible.



Do not send only Canva designs, screenshots, mockups, portfolios, or sample listings.



We want to see actual Amazon work.



3. Explain your normal process for creating a brand-new Amazon listing from scratch.



We want to understand how you approach:



product research ? competitor research ? keyword research ? positioning ? copy ? images ? A+ Content.



4. Tell us which Amazon research and keyword tools you have personally used.



Paid Trial



Candidates who appear to be a strong fit may be asked to complete a small paid trial project.



The trial will allow us to evaluate your:



* Research ability

* Product understanding

* Listing strategy

* Copywriting

* Attention to detail

* Ability to work independently



We are looking for someone we can work with long term, so we are more interested in finding the right person than simply filling the position quickly.



If you have strong, hands-on Amazon listing creation experience and believe you can take ownership of a listing from beginning to end, we would like to hear from you.

title: Lead Direct Response Video Editor
description:
Lead Direct Response Video Editor — JustFloow ????????



Full-time | Remote | Long-term role with leadership growth path



About Us

JustFloow is a fast-growing, seven-figure UK supplement brand. Our products, Genius Mind (cognitive performance) and Aura (nicotine-free nootropic pouches), are sold through paid social, primarily Meta. Creative is our biggest growth lever, and we take it seriously: structured weekly ideation, data-driven learnings, and a kill/iterate/scale verdict system on every ad.



The Role

This is NOT a "make it look nice" editing job. We're hiring an editor who is experienced in performance marketing and has been working with e-commerce brands for over 1 year. If it's in the supplement niche, then that's a benefit. It's key that the person we are hiring understands that every cut, caption, and pacing decision exists to hold and grab attention, show transformations, evoke emotions, show mechanisms and drive conversions.



You'll receive concepts and scripts from our creative team, but we don't want an order-taker. We want someone who takes the idea and makes it better. If we hand you a concept and you return exactly what was written without any critical thinking or creativity or editorial judgement, then this role isn't for you.



What you'll do

Edit direct response video ads for Meta (and TikTok/YouTube) — UGC-style, native-feel, VSL-style, and static-motion hybrids

Elevate every brief. Take our concept and improve it: stronger hook cuts, better pacing, smarter b-roll choices, and scroll-stopping first 3 seconds. First drafts should be near-final, not the start of five feedback rounds



Think in metrics. You know what hook rate, hold rate, and thumbstop mean. You watch retention graphs and adjust your editing accordingly



Produce hook variations. Deliver multiple hook cuts per concept as standard because you know that's how winners are found



Work fast under pressure. We run a weekly creative cadence with real deadlines. Quality AND speed, not one or the other

Own your craft. Study winning ads in the DTC/supplement space, bring references and ideas proactively, level up the whole team's output



Lead as we grow. This role has a path to leading our editing team, as we're on a trajectory to grow and hire a bigger team soon setting standards, reviewing others' work, building our editing playbook



Who we're looking for:



- 2+ years editing paid social direct response ads — not YouTube vlogs, not wedding videos, not corporate explainers. Ads that spent real money

- Deep fluency in Premiere Pro or CapCut Pro (After Effects a plus)

- You understand DR principles: hooks, pattern interrupts, pacing for retention, captions that hold attention, native platform feel

- Strong editorial judgment — you improve briefs, you don't just execute them

- You handle deadline pressure without quality dropping

- Excellent communication in English, reliable delivery, zero excuses culture

- Reliable internet, capable editing machine



Bonus points

- Supplement / health / wellness brand experience

- Experience with UGC creator footage and raw-asset organisation

- Motion graphics ability for statics-in-motion and mechanism visualisations

- Experience leading or reviewing other editors' work



What we offer:

- Competitive salary (based on experience) — paid on time, every time

- Full-time, long-term, stable role with a genuine leadership path

- Direct access to performance data — you'll SEE how your edits perform

- Work directly with the founder and growth team; your ideas get shipped

- 13th month pay and paid time off



How to apply — READ CAREFULLY



We only review applications that follow these instructions exactly. This is a precision role — the application is your first test.

Start your application with the word "THUMBSTOP" in the first line.



Include a portfolio of 3–5 direct response ads you personally edited. For each, tell us: the brand/product, what the brief was, and what YOU changed or added that improved it. (If you can share performance results, even better.)



Answer this in your own words: We send you a script for a 45-second UGC-style ad. The hook as written feels weak. What do you do and give us a real example of how you'd strengthen a weak hook.



Tell us your average turnaround time for a 60-second AI voiceover + b-roll DR ad (first draft), your expected monthly salary, and earliest start date.



Attach a short Loom video (2–3 minutes): introduce yourself and walk us through your single best-performing ad why it worked.



Applications missing any element above are deleted unread. Generic copy-paste applications are obvious and ignored.

title: US Construction (Lighting) Quotations Specialist
description:
Role: Remote Quotations Specialist



Company: Tamilux – Commercial Lighting Distribution



Location: Remote (working 8am–5pm EST)



Compensation: $18,000–$35,000 USD per year, depending on experience



About Tamilux



Tamilux supplies complete commercial lighting packages for US general contractors, developers, and building owners. We support projects from bid through approvals, value engineering, procurement, and phased deliveries. We are a small, fast team that treats lighting like a project, not just a product.



Role Summary



You will own the front-end quoting process for commercial lighting projects: reviewing bid packages, organizing fixture schedules, coordinating vendor pricing, and producing accurate, timely quotations that help our clients win jobs and protect our margins.



Outcomes (what success looks like)

In your first 90 days you will:



- Process X–Y full bid packages per week with high accuracy (we’ll define the exact number with you).

- Turn around most quotation requests within 24–48 business hours, depending on scope.

- Maintain quote accuracy so that pricing errors / missed items are near zero.

- Free up the owner and estimating lead from at least 15–20 hours per week of quoting work.



Key Responsibilities



- Review lighting bid packages (drawings, specs, fixture schedules) and identify required materials.

- Build organized bills of material (BOM) for each project.

- Request, track, and organize vendor / rep pricing for fixtures and controls.

- Compare specified products with value?engineered alternatives when directed.

- Prepare clear, professional quotations for general contractors and developers.

- Coordinate with our estimating lead and project management team for handoff on awarded jobs.

- Maintain internal records of quotes, revisions, and assumptions.



Requirements



1. 1–3+ years in construction estimating, quantity takeoff, electrical, or related technical role.

2. Ability to read and interpret architectural / electrical drawings and specifications.

3. Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills and comfort working heavily with spreadsheets.

4. High attention to detail and accuracy; comfortable working with numbers all day.

5. Reliable written and spoken English; able to communicate clearly with a US-based team.

6. Stable internet and home office setup; willing to work US Eastern hours.



Nice to Have



- Experience with lighting, electrical distribution, or controls.

- Experience working with US general contractors or commercial projects.

- Familiarity with tools like Bluebeam, PlanSwift, or similar.

title: Commercial Construction Estimator / Takeoff Specialist (PlanSwift & Excel)
description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Commercial Construction Estimator to perform digital

material and labor takeoffs. In this role, you will review US commercial blueprint sets, execute fast and

accurate takeoffs in PlanSwift or comparable take-off software and deliver organized quantity summaries to support our sales team.



Key Responsibilities

1.? Digital Takeoffs: Perform complete, accurate takeoffs in PlanSwift or comparable take-off software sousing linear, area, count, and

custom assembly tools.

2.? Blueprint & Spec Review: Review architectural sheets, structural details, and written project

specifications to capture all scope requirements, transitions, and edge details.

3.? Data Organization: Export, format, and organize raw takeoff data into clear Microsoft Excel

summary sheets.

4.? Scope Quality Control: Spot drawing discrepancies, unnoted details, and revision changes (addenda)

to flag for the sales team.

5.   Team Communication: Coordinate daily with US-based sales management regarding bid deadlines

and scope clarifications.



Qualifications & Requirements

1.? Software Proficiency: 2+ years of hands-on experience using PlanSwift or comparable take-off software and Microsoft Excel.

2.? Plan Literacy: Proven ability to read and interpret US commercial construction drawings and

specifications.

title: Front End Manager — Shopify Product Listing (Home Decor)
description:
About us

We operate multiple e-commerce brands in home & living, selling across several

markets and opening new ones. Our front end runs on Shopify, Google Sheets and our

own internal tools, with every process documented in Notion. We are a small,

fast-moving team and we take listing quality seriously — a wrong voltage or a wrong

size on a live product costs us a refund. Right now we are preparing hard for Q4,

our biggest quarter of the year, and this role is fundamental to getting there. We

are looking for someone who wants to work, wants to grow, and becomes a genuine

addition to the team — not someone looking to fill hours.





The role

You take over our product listing process. Everything is documented and we have

our own tools for it, so you are not starting from scratch.



You also pick up our open issues — small fixes on listings that are already live,

like a variant that turns out not to be available.



More responsibilities will follow as we go. Invoice checks are coming once that

process is ready. We are still building parts of the front end out, and to be able

to do that, I need these tasks off my plate first.



Every now and then something extra comes up — a set of product photos that needs

doing, or a one-off job. I set up the how and what; you run with it. We are

looking for someone flexible.



For the right person this grows into running our front end.





What your week looks like



Saturday: the supplier's quotes come back. You run the quote checks so the batch is

clean and ready to list.

Monday: I hand you a new batch of products. You enter them into the quote sheet and

send the request to the supplier.

Tuesday to Saturday: you list and check last week's batch across every store, so it

is complete and ready to go live by the end of the week. You send me one summary

when it is done.



Open issues run alongside this and get picked up the same day. They are small.



That is the rhythm: one batch in, one batch finished, every week.





Your daily responsibilities (approx. 3-4 hours/day, 6 days/week):



Move the current batch forward: quote sheet entry, listing, or listing checks,

depending on where the week is

Check the quote sheet on the day our supplier promised quotes, and follow up if

anything is still missing

Pick up open issues on live listings the same day

Keep our follow-up tracker current so nothing is left waiting unnoticed





Requirements:



2+ years in e-commerce product listing or Shopify catalogue management

Hands-on experience in Shopify admin: products, variants and options, collections,

categories, metafields and tags

Confident in Google Sheets

Excellent written English — you will be messaging our supplier directly

Detail-obsessed: you notice when a variant option is named wrong, a tag is missing,

or a spec table shows the wrong market

Comfortable following a written process exactly, and asking instead of d

when something is unclear

Experience with dropshipping or managing multiple Shopify stores is a strong plus,

as is any experience following up with suppliers

Reliable internet, own laptop, available for a daily overlap window with EU

timezone





Schedule and pay:



Part-time to start: around 20 hours per week, Monday to Saturday (flexible on exact

hours, some EU overlap required)

$4 per hour to start, paid weekly for the first two months and bi-weekly after that

We are preparing for Q4 and launching new stores, so listing volume is growing.

Your hours grow with us — from around 20 hours a week now to a realistic 40 for the

right person

The rate grows with it. For someone who genuinely becomes our front end manager,

$6 to $7 per hour is where this goes. That is earned on results, not on time served

Long-term role with real growth as our brands scale





How to apply:

Start your application with the word "LUMEN" so we know you read this.



Then record a short video (Loom or similar, camera on) where you:



Briefly introduce yourself and your e-commerce background

Answer these 3 questions:

1. What is the most complex product catalogue you have worked on? How many products,

how many variants, and what made it complex?

2. You are checking a batch of 40 new listings and you notice the same mistake on 12

of them. What do you do, step by step?

3. Describe a process you were responsible for where you had to follow a strict

checklist. How did you make sure nothing slipped through?

Captions, light text overlays, music, and basic sound design. Delivering in the aspect ratios we specify, usually 9:16 and sometimes 1:1. Turning around revisions within 24 hours.



Everything runs through our ClickUp board. Briefs, assets, feedback, and revisions all live there, so nothing gets lost in scattered messages.



Later on, organic Reels and TikToks for our brand and our clients. Looser, faster, and more native-feeling than the paid ads, often cut from raw phone footage rather than polished b-roll.

HOW TO APPLY
