title: Thumbnail/Graphic Designer
description:
Mission





This role consists of: First, design YouTube thumbnails that earn the click from a cautious, forty plus investor who has been burned before. Second, act as our general graphic designer: Instagram carousel designs/templates, static image ads for paid, post graphics and whatever else the brand needs. Everything you make should look credible, never cluttered, never hype.



Outcomes





Deliver two thumbnail concepts within 24 hours.

Ideation: read the title, brief and outline, and d
 what promise the thumbnail should make to this specific audience. 

Concepting: turn that promise into one simple visual idea. What is in frame, what the words say, where the eye lands first.

Execution: produce the finished file, cleanly and to spec.

In addition to that you must understand that a viewer’s eye typically lands on the thumbnail, the thumbnail creates interest, then the viewer reads the title to d
 whether or not they will click on the video. But it ALL starts with the thumbnail. 





Deliver two concepts minimum per long-form video, genuinely different ideas rather than colour variations of one. A single concept is acceptable only when it is clearly outstanding and agreed with the Head of Organic in advance.





Deliver ad hoc graphic design within 48 hours of request. Static image ads, Instagram carousels, post graphics and similar.





Return revisions the same working day they are requested.





Deliver files to spec: 1280 x 720, under 2MB, named to the video slug, attached to the ClickUp card.





Reply to messages in Slack within 3 hours of being tagged, within the agreed work hours.





Maintain a less than 10% revision rate caused by missed brief instructions or careless errors.







Competencies





Thumbnail ideation

Can read a title and outline and work out what promise will make our viewer click.

Ideas are rooted in who the audience is, not in what looks impressive in a portfolio.

Our audience is wealthy and sceptical. Nothing that looks like hype, bait, or a meme coin advert.

Can explain why a thumbnail should work before designing it.





Visual concepting

Reduces an idea to one clear subject and one clear message.

Simple beats busy. Few colours, few words, no stacked graphics or effects.

Text kept to a few words and readable at the size it appears on a phone.





Design execution

Clean cutouts, correct crops, no artifacts, no typos.

Strong focal contrast and deliberate composition. Keeps the channels visually consistent once a look is established.

Proven YouTube thumbnail work, with links to the live videos.





Speed

Produces high-quality work quickly and hits deadlines without being chased.

Comfortable starting from a title, a brief and raw footage stills rather than waiting for a finished video.





Coachable

Reacts calmly to feedback and iterates without friction.

Adapts based on CTR data rather than personal taste.





Communication

Clear, respectful, professional and timely, written and verbal.

Flags blockers early instead of missing a deadline silently.



Position description





You work directly with the Head of Content, who owns content strategy for both channels.

The Head of Organic supplies the approved title, the thumbnail brief and the outline. You own the thumbnail from idea to finished file. We collaborate on direction when a video is unusual or the brief is deliberately open.





One scheduled call each week (at least until things are figured out and are set in smooth motion). Everything else runs async in Slack and ClickUp.

You work in parallel with the video editors, never behind them. Your work starts while the video is still being cut.





How the work reaches you





Trigger: the video's card moves to Ready To Film in ClickUp and is assigned to you. That is your start signal, not the finished video. 

Brief: the THUMBNAIL BRIEF section and the approved title on the card.

Source imagery: the Raw footage link on the card for stills, plus Frank's photo library for posed shots.

Delivery: attach both concepts to the card and tag the Head of Organic in Slack.

Approval: The Head of Organic picks the winner. Where the channel is eligible, two concepts run as a YouTube Test and Compare and the data d
.







How to Apply:



Start your application with ‘YIELDSCHOOL’ so I know it’s not spam.





Keep your application short and relevant - we don’t read the long ones.



Structure your application exactly like this please:



“YIELDSCHOOL”



My loom:  insert loom



(Record a short 30-60 second loom explaining why you’re the right fit for this role).

(This loom is to assess your communication skills - no loom makes us assume your communication skills are low).



Top 3 Landing Pages:



 Include ONLY the top 3 links to landing pages you’ve built (no more than 3).



 insert link

 insert link

 insert link



Meta Ads:



 In 1-3 sentences, describe your experience with Meta ads.



Technical experience:

Other notes:



 insert 1-4 sentences of anything else you want me to know.

We are building an AI-first operating platform for construction companies. We use modern AI coding agents and multiple models to accelerate engineering, but we still require a strong human engineer who can own technical outcomes, challenge unsafe shortcuts, and make sure integrations work reliably in production.

  

This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable taking an unfamiliar API or SaaS platform, understanding the business workflow, using AI tools to move quickly, and then verifying the result through strong engineering judgment, testing, security, and documentation.

  

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Microsoft 365 integration, including Microsoft Graph, Entra ID, Outlook, Calendar, Teams/Chat, SharePoint, OneDrive, and related services.

- External SaaS and construction-platform integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth 2.0, service accounts, and vendor SDKs.

- API and integration architecture for client systems such as Procore, Buildertrend, CompanyCam, accounting platforms, and future construction software.

- Review and supervision of AI-generated code from tools such as Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, and similar development agents.

- Authentication, permissions, tenant isolation, secrets, tokens, consent, auditability, and safe handling of client data.

- Production deployments, monitoring, rollback, i
 investigation, and integration maintenance.

- Technical onboarding of new clients and coordination with our operations team to turn business workflows into reliable technical capabilities.

- Clear documentation and communication with nontechnical operators, VAs, and company leadership.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Strong hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs and SaaS platforms.

- Comfort with REST, JSON, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, authentication flows, retries, rate limits, and error handling.

- Solid software engineering ability in TypeScript/Node.js, Python, or a comparable modern stack.

- Experience with Git/GitHub, code review, automated testing, Linux, cloud environments, and production troubleshooting.

- Experience with Azure, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Graph, Power Automate/Power Platform, or adjacent Microsoft tooling.

- Ability to use AI coding tools productively while independently verifying what the AI produces.

- Good security judgment: you should recognize when a shortcut is unsafe even if the code appears to work.

- Excellent written English and the ability to explain technical tradeoffs clearly to nontechnical people.

- High ownership and low ego: we want someone who can say "I do not know yet," investigate, test, and return with evidence.



NICE TO HAVE

- Construction software experience, especially Procore, Buildertrend, CompanyCam, ComputerEase, QuickBooks, or similar systems.

- Experience building MCP servers, AI tool interfaces, agent workflows, or other model-to-system integrations.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.

- Experience supporting remote operations teams or client-facing implementation work.



WORKING STYLE

- Remote, Philippines-based preferred.

- Comfortable working with a U.S.-based owner and operations team.

- AI-first environment: using AI is encouraged and expected; blindly trusting AI is not.

- Initial contract-to-hire structure preferred so both sides can validate the fit through real work.

  

COMPENSATION

$2,500-$3,200 USD/month, depending on experience and demonstrated capability.



HOW TO APPLY

Please answer the questions below in your application rather than sending only a generic cover letter. Answer concretely, not with generic definitions.

1. Tell us about the most difficult third-party API integration you personally owned. What made it difficult, what failed, and how did you verify the final result?

2. A client gives you access to a SaaS platform you have never worked with before. Walk us through how you would determine what can safely be automated.

3. Explain the difference between an API credential having permission to perform an action and our application being authorized by the business to perform that action.

4. Describe an OAuth 2.0 integration you have built or supported. How did you handle token storage, refresh, expiration, and revocation?

5. What Microsoft Graph or Microsoft 365 integrations have you built? If none, describe the closest comparable identity or enterprise integration work you have done.

6. How do you use Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or other AI development tools today? Give a specific example where the AI was wrong and how you caught it.

7. An AI coding agent produces an integration that passes its tests. What would you check before allowing it into production?

8. How would you prevent data belonging to Client A from being returned to Client B in a multi-client platform?

9. Tell us about a production i
 you personally investigated. How did you contain it, determine root cause, and prevent recurrence?

10. When would you choose a human-assisted workflow instead of automating the process completely?

title: VIP Client Support Associate
description:
We're building a remote VIP Support team for a Japan-based fintech platform, and we're looking for people we can grow from the ground up — not just workers, but the kind of people who take genuine pride in doing things right. This role blends support with relationship-building: you won't just resolve client concerns, you'll also learn to spot the right moments to introduce clients to more of what we offer.



This is not a call center role. You'll be managing real relationships with high-value clients — providing support, but also recognizing opportunities to grow those relationships — and holding yourself to a high standard on every single interaction. Our clients are VIPs — quality is the only standard. We train every associate to think critically and work out the correct response on their own, using AI as a support tool rather than a substitute for judgment. Once you've proven you can consistently get it right, you'll be trusted to move fast — real speed is earned through skill, not shortcuts.



We're a growing team, and we mean that literally — the processes, tools, and structure you'll work with are still being shaped, and we actively want people who take initiative to help shape them. The culture here is built on mutual trust, shared accountability, and a genuine respect for doing things well. If that resonates with you, keep reading.



Responsibilities:



• Handle inbound client inquiries via messaging platforms with care and thoroughness

• Recognize natural opportunities within conversations to introduce clients to relevant features, promotions, or products that genuinely add value to them

• Use our drafting tool to sharpen your own well-considered responses for supervisor review — the tool supports your judgment; it doesn't replace it

• Keep thorough, accurate track of each client's concerns and history — nothing gets forgotten, nothing falls through the cracks

• Escalate immediately to your Lead when handling an irate or escalating client — do not attempt to resolve it alone

• Maintain detailed and accurate client interaction logs

• Follow team rules, protocols, and procedures diligently — structure exists for a reason and will be respected

• We believe every client interaction is a once-in-a-lifetime encounter that deserves your full presence and care.



What We're Looking For:



• Early career — fresh graduates welcome, but you need real client-facing experience (internship, part-time work, thesis project, VA work, or similar counts)

• High energy and quick on your feet — comfortable with fast, informal communication (voice notes, memes, Slack chaos included) and unfazed by a startup's rough edges

• Confident — you speak up, express yourself clearly, and don't go quiet when things get uncomfortable

• Understands hierarchy — you know when to handle something yourself and when to bring it to your Lead, and you act without being told

• Conscientious — you track every detail, follow through, and take full ownership of every client you handle

• Relationship-minded — you can naturally spot opportunities to add value for a client, not just resolve their immediate issue

• Follows rules diligently — protocols aren't suggestions

• Strong written English — clear, warm, and professional

• Sharp critical thinking — you can reason through a client's situation yourself, not just reword what a tool gives you

• Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) as an aid, not a crutch

• High discretion — you'll be handling sensitive VIP information

• Startup mindset — adaptable, steady, and not easily rattled



Bonus Points (not required, but we will prioritize you):



• Holds a TESDA BPO NC II certification

• HubSpot or Zendesk Customer Service certification

• Google AI Essentials or equivalent AI literacy certificate

• JLPT N2/N1 or business-level fluency — especially valuable if you can review Japanese-language drafts for tone and accuracy

• Familiar with crypto, DeFi, or fintech products

• Experience in sales, account management, upselling, or client retention

• Has handled foreign or executive-level clients before



Reporting to: VIP Support Lead and Growth Operations Lead



Setup:



• 100% WFH from day one

• 8 AM–4 PM Philippine Time (JST business hours) to start, 5 days/week — this window may extend depending on client traffic and business needs, so come in with realistic expectations around hours

• No time tracker

• Overtime available as needed and subject to supervisor approval

• Team communication via Slack

• BYOD — stable fiber internet required

• Confidentiality/NDA agreement required before you handle any client information

• Paid training and evaluation period — Part-Time status, working full 8-hour days, running through the 30th of the month you're hired (this lines up with our salary reporting cycle)

• Promotion to Full-Time is based on your evaluation — if your performance is clearly solid early on, that promotion can happen before the 30th too

• Initiative is welcomed — stepping up when it's needed is part of the culture here

• Internal growth and promotions for top performers



To Apply:



Start your message with the subject line:

[VIP Support] – [Your Name] – [City]



Then answer all three questions below. We read every response personally — take your time with these.



1. You're handling five VIP clients at the same time. One sends you a voice note. One sends a meme with no context. One hasn't replied in 3 days and suddenly needs urgent help. One says "???" and one says "never mind." Walk us through your exact next 10 minutes.

2. If we give you a chance at this role, what is the one thing you can promise us?

3. Think of a time you were part of a startup or company — what's one initiative you personally established that's still in use today (or was used before you left), and became part of how that company actually operates?



A note on AI: using it to help you write is fine — we use it ourselves. But we can tell when an answer wasn't reviewed by the person sending it. Edit before you submit.



Important: Do not use any of the following words anywhere in your application — passionate, dedicated, hardworking, committed, team player, fast learner, or go-getter. Applications containing these words will not be reviewed. We want your real voice, not resume language.



Applications without the correct subject line and all three answers will not be reviewed.

title: TikTok / Short-Form Video Editor
description:
We’re looking for a **creative short-form video editor** to help edit primarily TikTok content for a beauty, lifestyle, hair, and fashion-focused creator.



**Pay: $3 per finished video**



We’re looking for someone who understands TikTok-style editing and can make videos feel **smooth, feminine, bubbly, cute, and engaging** without over-editing them.



## Editing Style We’re Looking For



The overall editing style should feel:



* Smooth and polished

* Girly, bubbly, and cutesy

* Clean and aesthetically pleasing

* Fast-paced when needed, but not overly flashy

* Natural and engaging

* Native to TikTok/short-form content



We **do not** want the screen covered in text or effects the entire time. The editing should enhance the content rather than distract from it.



## Text & Captions



We’d like text to be used strategically throughout the videos.



For informational videos:



* Add text when it helps viewers understand or follow what's being said.

* Highlight important points, products, tips, or phrases.

* Avoid putting large amounts of text on the screen constantly.



For more casual/lifestyle videos:



* Use text more sparingly.

* Let the visuals and personality of the creator carry the video.



## Beauty, Hair & Lifestyle Content



A lot of the content will involve:



* Makeup

* Hair

* Fashion

* Beauty

* Lifestyle

* Promos

* Product recommendations

* General talking/entertainment content



For makeup/tutorial-style videos, we want the editing to flow naturally between clips. For example, the creator may continue speaking while the video transitions to another clip, product shot, angle, or step in the process.



The goal is to make the video feel **smooth and seamless rather than like a bunch of individual clips stitched together.**



## Promotional Content



We also create promotional content, particularly around hair and beauty.



We want someone who can creatively incorporate promotional moments into regular content so they **don't feel like obvious advertisements.**



For example, instead of stopping the video completely to say, "Here's the product I'm promoting," find natural ways to incorporate the product into the story, tutorial, routine, or conversation.



## What We're Looking For



We're looking for an editor who:



* Has experience editing TikToks/Reels/Shorts

* Understands current short-form editing trends

* Has a strong sense of timing and pacing

* Can create smooth transitions

* Knows when to use text and when to let the footage speak for itself

* Has good attention to detail

* Can make beauty/lifestyle content feel polished and engaging

* Is comfortable working with talking-head and lifestyle footage

* Can creatively incorporate promotional content

* Can take creative direction and apply feedback



**Creativity is a big plus.** We're not looking for someone who simply cuts clips together. We want someone who can look at the footage and understand how to make the final video more entertaining and engaging.



## Editing Examples



We’ve attached several example videos showing the general style and feel we’re looking for.



**Please review the examples before applying** so you can get a better understanding of the pacing, transitions, text usage, and overall aesthetic we're going for.









## Pay



**$3 per completed short-form video.**



We’re looking to build a long-term working relationship with the right editor, so consistency, quality, communication, and reliability are very important to us.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio or examples of TikTok/Reels/Shorts you've edited

2. Your editing software

3. Your availability

4. A brief description of your experience with beauty, lifestyle, fashion, or promotional content



**Please make sure your portfolio includes examples that demonstrate your ability to edit in a smooth, engaging short-form style.**

title: Virtual RN Clinical Operations & Quality Manager – Medicare Home Health
description:
Position Overview



Penn Home Health Care is seeking a highly experienced and detail-oriented Registered Nurse (RN) to join our team as a Virtual RN Clinical Operations & Quality Manager – Medicare Home Health.



This is not an entry-level RN or general healthcare virtual assistant position.



We are specifically seeking a candidate with hands-on experience working with a U.S. Medicare-certified home health agency, including strong working knowledge of Axxess, OASIS, Plans of Care, physician orders, Medicare documentation requirements, clinical record review, and quality assurance.



The Virtual RN Clinical Operations & Quality Manager will work remotely from the Philippines and support the Administrator and designated clinical leadership of Penn Home Health Care.



This position does not serve as the agency's designated regulatory Director of Nursing (DON). Instead, the role provides significant clinical operations, documentation, quality assurance, compliance, and workflow support for the agency's Medicare home health operations.



The successful candidate should be able to work within Axxess with minimal training and independently identify documentation, workflow, and compliance issues requiring follow-up or escalation.



Key Responsibilities



Medicare Home Health Clinical Operations



• Support the Administrator and designated clinical leadership with day-to-day Medicare home health clinical operations.

• Coordinate and monitor clinical workflows from referral and admission through discharge.

• Monitor Start of Care (SOC), Resumption of Care (ROC), recertification, transfer, and discharge processes.

• Review clinical records for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timely completion.

• Monitor Plans of Care and related clinical documentation.

• Review and track physician orders, outstanding signatures, certifications, and other required documentation.

• Identify incomplete, inconsistent, overdue, or potentially non-compliant clinical documentation.

• Coordinate follow-up with appropriate clinical staff regarding documentation deficiencies.

• Assist with patient care coordination and clinical workflow tracking.

• Escalate significant clinical or compliance concerns to the Administrator or designated clinical leadership.



Axxess



The successful candidate must have hands-on Axxess experience and be comfortable performing clinical and operational functions within the system.



Responsibilities may include:



• Reviewing patient charts and clinical documentation.

• Monitoring outstanding and incomplete documentation.

• Reviewing Plans of Care and physician orders.

• Tracking clinical workflow and documentation status.

• Identifying documentation deficiencies.

• Monitoring required signatures and outstanding orders.

• Supporting clinical staff with Axxess-related workflows.

• Generating or reviewing reports used for clinical operations, compliance, and quality monitoring.



Candidates should be able to work in Axxess with minimal training.



OASIS & Clinical Documentation



• Review OASIS documentation for completeness, consistency, and potential documentation concerns.

• Understand Medicare home health documentation requirements associated with SOC, ROC, recertification, transfer, and discharge.

• Review clinical documentation against the patient's Plan of Care.

• Identify inconsistencies between assessments, orders, Plans of Care, visit documentation, and other clinical records.

• Assist with documentation follow-up and correction processes.

• Support timely completion of required clinical documentation.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

• Perform routine clinical chart audits and documentation reviews.

• Assist with Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAPI) activities.

• Identify recurring documentation and workflow deficiencies.

• Track corrective actions and follow-up items.

• Assist with internal audits and compliance monitoring.

• Support preparation for Medicare, state, accreditation, or other regulatory surveys and audits as directed.

• Help maintain clinical policies, procedures, audit tools, trackers, and quality documentation.

• Assist leadership in monitoring compliance with applicable Medicare home health requirements.

• Provide reports and findings to the Administrator and designated clinical leadership.



Staff Coordination & Clinical Support



• Communicate with nurses, therapists, clinicians, and administrative staff regarding documentation and workflow issues.

• Assist with clinical staff orientation and training related to documentation, workflows, and agency procedures.

• Participate in virtual case conferences and clinical meetings as assigned.

• Assist with staff competency, education, and quality-improvement initiatives.

• Maintain professional communication with agency leadership and clinical personnel.

• Follow up consistently on outstanding clinical and compliance items.



Required Qualifications



Applicants must have:



• Registered Nurse (RN) background.

• Actual experience working with a U.S. Medicare-certified home health agency.

• Strong, hands-on Axxess Home Health experience.

• Working knowledge of Medicare home health requirements and workflows.

• Experience with OASIS.

• Experience with SOC, ROC, recertification, transfer, and discharge workflows.

• Experience reviewing or managing Plans of Care and physician orders.

• Experience with clinical documentation review and quality assurance.

• Understanding of Medicare clinical documentation and compliance requirements.

• Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to identify documentation inconsistencies.

• Ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a remote environment.

• Strong computer and technology skills.



Required Technology Experience



Candidates must be proficient with:



• Axxess Home Health

• Microsoft Teams

• Microsoft 365

• Outlook

• Word

• Excel

• OneDrive / SharePoint

• Video conferencing and other remote collaboration tools



Strongly Preferred Qualifications



Preference will be given to candidates with:



• USRN licensure or previous U.S. nursing experience.

• Several years of U.S. Medicare-certified home health experience.

• Advanced Axxess experience.

• Strong OASIS review or QA experience.

• QAPI/CQI experience.

• Clinical chart auditing experience.

• Medicare survey or audit preparation experience.

• Home health supervisory or clinical leadership experience.

• Experience training or supervising clinical staff.

• Experience identifying and correcting documentation deficiencies.

• Strong knowledge of Medicare home health compliance requirements.



What We Are Looking For



We are not simply looking for an RN with general healthcare experience.



We need someone who already understands the operations of a U.S. Medicare-certified home health agency and can contribute with minimal training.



The ideal candidate is:



• Experienced with Medicare home health.

• Highly proficient in Axxess.

• Knowledgeable about OASIS and home health documentation.

• Detail-oriented and highly organized.

• Comfortable auditing clinical records.

• Able to identify documentation and compliance concerns.

• Proactive about following up on outstanding items.

• Comfortable communicating with U.S.-based leadership and clinical staff.

• Able to manage multiple priorities independently.

• Dependable, responsive, and accountable.

• Comfortable working in a structured remote environment.



Work Expectations



This is a full-time virtual position supporting a U.S.-based home health agency.



Candidates must have:



• Reliable high-speed internet.

• Reliable computer equipment.

• Professional and private home workspace.

• Reliable communication through Microsoft Teams,
, and phone.

• Ability to work the schedule established by Penn Home Health Care, including required overlap with U.S. business hours.

• Ability to maintain strict patient confidentiality and comply with applicable privacy, security, and agency requirements.



Compensation



$8–$12 USD per hour, based on qualifications and experience.



Compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience with:



• U.S. Medicare-certified home health

• Axxess

• OASIS

• Clinical documentation and QA

• Plans of Care and physician orders

• QAPI and audits

• Medicare compliance

• Clinical leadership



Exceptional candidates with extensive Medicare home health, Axxess, OASIS/QA, compliance, and clinical leadership experience may be considered above the posted range.

title: Reddit Content Writer & Subreddit Manager
description:
About the role



We run Reddit growth and content programs for our clients. We're looking for one strong writer to join our team on Slack and become our go-to person for anything that gets posted to Reddit.



Two things make this job different from a typical content writing gig:



1. The writing has to be genuinely yours. A lot of what we send you will start as an AI draft. Your job is to throw out the wording and rewrite it as a real person — keep the meaning, change everything else. We check every piece against an AI-detection tool and it needs to come back 100% human. To be clear: we are not looking for someone who runs text through a "humanizer" tool. Those get caught. We want an actual human writing actual sentences.



2. Speed matters more than volume. Most pieces are short — 50 to 120 words. We'll send them to you in Slack, you rewrite, you send them back, we post. Turnaround is usually measured in minutes, not days. That's why we need someone reachable during the workday rather than someone who batches everything at midnight.



What you'll do



- Rewrite AI-drafted Reddit posts, comments, and replies into natural human writing that passes AI-detectors at 100% human

- Manage and grow one of our subreddits — plan what gets posted, write the posts, seed discussion, keep the community active

- Answer Reddit questions on behalf of our clients in a voice that sounds like a real person who knows the topic

Use AI (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to research and generate content angles across client niches you've never worked in before — then write the actual content yourself

- Stay responsive on Slack during agreed hours for quick-turn requests

- This job will evolve over time, so be flexible and we will too!



Requirements

- Native-level written and spoken English. This is non-negotiable. Reddit users notice awkward phrasing immediately, and so do we.

- Heavy personal Reddit experience. You should be an actual Redditor — you know how different subs behave, what gets upvoted, what gets you downvoted into oblivion, and why most marketing on Reddit fails. Tell us your favorite subs.

- You understand Reddit's rules on self-promotion and disclosure, and how to work inside them so accounts don't get shadowbanned

- Strong AI skills for ideation and research — you can take a vertical you know nothing about (roofing, dental SaaS, freight brokerage, whatever) and get up to speed fast enough to write about it credibly

- Reliable internet and a workspace where you can be on Slack during your shift

- Comfortable with fast, informal, high-volume back-and-forth communication

- Background in online marketing, SEO, or agency work



Nice to have



- Experience moderating a subreddit or running an online community

- Experience writing in multiple brand voices



Hours & pay



- Availability during Pacific Timezone work hours, Monday–Friday

- Monthly retainer, depending on experience and test results



This is a long-term role. We're hiring one person and we want to keep them.



How to apply



Please do the following — applications that skip any step will be ignored.



1. Start your message with the word UPVOTE so we know you read the whole post.



2. Tell us your Reddit experience: how long you've been on the platform, what kinds of subs you're active in, and anything you've grown or moderated.



3. Rewrite the paragraph below in your own words. Keep the meaning, change the wording completely.



Test paragraph: I've been using project management software for about three years now and I think the biggest mistake teams make is choosing a tool before they understand their own workflow. It's very easy to get impressed by feature lists and end up with something overly complicated. My advice would be to start simple and only add complexity when you actually feel the pain of not having it.



Tell us which hours you can realistically be online, in Pacific timezone.



We reply to everyone who completes all four steps.

Helpdesk (mostly escalations, but some basic if needed), cyber security related tasks/ audits, cloud hosting and virtualization (HyperV, SonicWall, VPN), MS365 management and automation, BCDR (Axcient), networking (UniFi, SonicWall), IT projects, Servers maintenance (Windows only), scripts creation, testing new technology, and other tasks related to IT.

This position requires AT LEAST 2 years of MSP experience and at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory, or lead role. 100% clean background check, highly organized, technologically savvy, and can work diligently with little supervision. Several hiring steps will take place to verify the above requirements, including reference checking, employment verification, technical testing, and more.

MORE DETAILS:

This means we will be installing our security software on that computer, will remove admin rights from you, and monitor/ control it for security and compliance reasons. In return, we will pay you additional “rent” fees, on top of your salary, in the amount of several hundred dollars. Details about this “rental” will be discussed during your second interview. There are minimum requirements that your computer must have in order to be employed with us. You must have a Computer/Laptop with at least i5 minimum 9th gen processor (preferably a newer one) with 16 GB RAM or more, or Ryzen 5/7 (MUST include TPM support) as well as Windows 11 OS.

title: Ecommerce Customer Service Rep
description:
RED | Ecommerce Customer Service Representative (Shopify)



PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB POST BEFORE APPLYING



We are a fast-growing 7-figure DTC eCommerce brand looking for an exceptional Customer Service Representative to join our team.



This isn't just another customer service job.



We're looking for someone who is driven, adaptable, proactive, and genuinely excited to grow with a company long-term.

We value attitude, work ethic, and the willingness to learn just as much as experience.



If you're someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new systems, and continuously improving, we'd love to hear from you.





Important



We need someone who wants to build a long-term career with us. While we understand that many virtual assistants work with multiple clients, preference will be given to applicants who can fully commit to our team. As our business continues to grow, we're looking for people who want to grow with us: not just fill available hours.



If you're dependable, eager to learn, and consistently perform at a high level, there is significant opportunity for increased hours, additional responsibilities, and long-term growth within the company.





Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



* Has excellent written English with strong grammar, spelling, and communication skills.

* Learns quickly and enjoys mastering new systems and processes.

* Is proactive and takes initiative instead of waiting to be told what to do.

* Can work independently with minimal supervision.

* Is resourceful and knows how to find answers before asking for help.

* Accepts feedback professionally and applies it immediately.

* Is adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where processes continue to improve.

* Is willing to unlearn habits from previous companies and fully adopt our workflows, SOPs, and standards.

* Takes pride in producing high-quality work instead of simply completing a shift.

* Is looking for a long-term opportunity rather than just another VA job.



We believe skills can be taught. A strong work ethic and great attitude are much harder to teach.



Preferred Experience



Experience in the following is a plus:



* Shopify

* Loop Subscriptions

* Checkout Champ

* Ecommerce Customer Cupport

* Subscription-based businesses

* Gorgias, Commslayer, Richpanel, Zendesk, Re:amaze, Front, or similar helpdesk platforms



If you don't have experience with every tool listed above, that's okay. We provide training for the right candidate.



Responsibilities



You'll be responsible for:



* Responding to customer
s professionally and empathetically.

* Resolving customer concerns efficiently.

* Handling order updates, shipping inquiries, refunds, replacements, subscriptions, and product questions.

* Following company SOPs while adapting to new processes as the business grows.

* Delivering a consistently excellent customer experience.



Compensation & Growth



* Starting rate: $4 USD/hour

* New hires will begin on a part-time trial period

* High-performing team members who consistently demonstrate reliability, initiative, and strong performance will have the opportunity to transition into a full-time position (40-48 hours/week)

* Performance bonuses and opportunities for career growth as the company continues to expand.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with the company.

Preference will be given to applicants who are able to make our team their primary work commitment.





Our Hiring Process



We invest heavily in building a strong team, so our hiring process is designed to identify candidates who are willing to learn and grow.



1. Submit your application.

2. Selected applicants will receive a short application form.

3. Top candidates will be invited for an interview.

4. Successful interviewees will receive access to our learning materials for a self-paced learning period (approximately one week).

5. Before the end of that week, you'll complete a timed mock customer support assessment based on the materials provided.

6. Candidates who successfully pass the assessment will proceed to paid training stage, with the opportunity to become a long-term member of our team.



Please note: The evaluation stage is designed to assess your ability to learn, follow SOPs, and apply new knowledge.

Only candidates who successfully pass this stage will move on to paid training.



Requirements



* At least 18 years old.

* Fluent in written English.

* Strong grammar and communication skills.

* Reliable computer and internet connection.

* Able to work independently.

* Eager to learn and continuously improve.

* Ecommerce customer service experience is preferred but not required.





How to Apply

To confirm you've read this entire job post, please:



1. Include the word RED at the beginning of your application title.



2. Answer the following questions:



* What motivates you to do great work?

* Why do you want to work with our company?

* Tell us about a time you had to learn something completely new. How did you approach it?

* What do you believe makes excellent customer service?

* How do you usually handle constructive feedback?

* If you don't know the answer to a customer's question, what would you do?



3. Bonus Exercise

"I've already
ed twice and nobody has helped me. This is honestly very frustrating."

We carefully review every application.



Thoughtful answers matter much more than generic responses or years of experience.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
We are a Swedish e-commerce company with multiple brands, and we are looking for a **full-time Creative Strategist / Video Editor** to join our growing creative team.



You do NOT need 10 years of experience. But you should have worked with performance creatives before and understand what makes an ad convert.



### What you will do



* Research customers, competitors, reviews and winning ads

* Find strong angles, desires, problems and hooks

* Turn research into high-converting scripts

* Source or create the material needed for the ads

* Edit complete Meta ad creatives yourself

* Analyze creative performance and understand WHY something worked or failed

* Use those learnings to create better iterations and new winners



We are not looking for someone who can simply edit a nice-looking video.



We want someone who understands **performance marketing and creative strategy**.



### The Brand



You will initially work with **Scarlet Intimates**, one of our Scandinavian e-commerce brands selling leak-proof period underwear.



Our two largest customer groups are:



**1. Mothers buying for their daughters**



Our biggest angle is mothers preparing their daughters for their first period. They want their daughter to feel prepared, confident and protected instead of worrying about leaks, pads or getting her first period unexpectedly.



**2. Adult women**



Women looking for a better alternative to pads. Something that looks and feels more like normal underwear while being comfortable, dry and reliable against leaks.



It removes the wet, bulky and uncomfortable feeling many women experience with pads while also being a nicer-looking, reusable and more economical solution.



Understanding the customer deeply and turning these desires and problems into strong advertising is a major part of this job.



### IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTION



Before writing anything else in your application, your FIRST line must be:



**PURPLE BANANA | [the city you currently live in] | [your favorite food] | [the editing software you personally use the most]**



Example format only:



PURPLE BANANA | Your City | Your Favorite Food | Your Editing Software



Do not copy the example answers.



We added this because we only want applications from people who have actually read the entire job post.



**If your application does not start with this line, we will not review it.**



### Paid Test



Before we hire you, you will complete **2 finished test creatives**.



We will provide you with a detailed test brief containing information about the brand, customers and existing research.



However, we also expect you to **do your own research**.

title: Supply Chain Manager (China Sourcing) – $100M/year E-Commerce Brand
description:
Our products are manufactured by multiple factories in China and fulfilled by our China-based partner, plus a growing Amazon FBA business. You own those relationships day to day. Your most important job: stay on top of everything, every day, and catch problems early. Our fulfillment partner needs constant pushing.



You'll do: Run the daily sync with our fulfillment partner: production capacity, QC results, quality issues, and the joint action plan, item by item, until closed with evidence. Double-check stock vs. open orders and shipping delays yourself and pull the reports to verify. Coordinate factory and warehouse inspections, insist on randomized sampling, push back on bad results. Verify factory quotes, weights, and cost calculations (we regularly catch miscalculations). Build supplier scorecards, source new factories, negotiate pricing, capacity, and penalty terms, and keep compliance and material traceability documentation complete. Organize bulk shipments China to US and to Amazon FBA (FNSKU labels, packaging, freight quotes). Plan inventory so bestsellers never run out, especially before Q4.



You:



Excellent English, patient and clear with Chinese partners daily

Detail-obsessed and skeptical, you verify numbers yourself

Strong with spreadsheets, persistent with follow-ups

China manufacturing, freight, or FBA experience is a strong plus; a sharp, relentless person can learn our setup fast



Offer: Full-time remote, long-term, direct line to the founders. $1,500 to $2,500/month plus bonus. Must overlap China business hours (PH mornings are perfect).



To apply: Start with the words ON TOP. Briefly describe your supplier, logistics, or inventory experience (or why you'd excel without it) and your salary expectation.

title: JOB TITLE: Lyric Video Editor — Turn Songs Into Visual Stories
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

A great lyric video isn't just words on a screen. It's the difference between someone hearing a song and someone feeling it before the first verse even lands. It's the reason a line hits harder because it appeared exactly when it needed to.



Q's Recording Studios (QRS) is building original music with independent artists who are doing this the real way — no label, no shortcuts, just the work. We need someone who can take a finished song and turn it into something people watch on repeat, not just listen to on repeat.



If you've ever watched a lyric video and thought "whoever made this actually understood the song" — we want to talk to you.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING

- Reading a song before you ever touch a timeline — understanding the emotion, not just the words

- Syncing lyrics so precisely to the music that the timing itself feels like part of the performance

- Designing typography and motion that matches the mood of each individual song, not a copy-paste template stretched across every release

- Building or sourcing visuals that make people stop scrolling

- Helping define what QRS's visual identity for music even looks like — this isn't a role where you're following someone else's style guide forever, this is a role where you help build it

- Delivering fast, clean, and consistent once we've locked in a workflow together



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- A real portfolio — show us something you made that actually moved you when you finished it

- An eye for timing and rhythm, not just editing software fluency

- Genuine typography and motion design instinct

- Someone efficient and reliable, who treats deadlines like commitments, not suggestions

- Comfort keeping unreleased music confidential until it's actually time for the world to hear it



SOFTWARE

- After Effects or Premiere Pro preferred

- CapCut or similar considered if the work speaks for itself

- Comfortable with shared drives and large file transfer (Google Drive, 
, or similar)



HOW TO APPLY

Don't just send a link and a resume. Send us:

1. Your best lyric video work — the one you're proudest of, and tell us why

2. Your typical turnaround time

3. In your own words — what makes a lyric video actually good, versus just technically correct?



We're not looking for someone to fill a seat. We're looking for someone who wants to help build something real.

title: AI Automation Engineer — Claude Code Skills, Agents & Next.js Site Rebuilds — $8/hr
description:
I'm hiring a second full-stack developer for my US-based multi-brand business. I already have one developer building applications from complete specs — this is a different role, and it requires a different kind of person. This time I do NOT have every detail d
. Part of your job is helping me d
.



What you'll build:



1. AI AUTOMATION (Claude Code skills, agents, and integrations). I run a small business with multiple brands, each with its own website, ad accounts, and marketing stack. I want recurring work automated using Claude Code: scheduled agents that connect to third-party tools via API (SEO platforms, Google Search Console, GA4,
), do real work weekly or daily, and surface changes for my one-click approval. Examples include an SEO content-and-technical-fixes workflow across multiple sites, and
 triage/auto-response for specific inbox types. You'll get the goals from me; you'll propose the architecture — what should be a Claude skill, what should be an MCP connector, what should be a plain script — and you'll defend those choices.



2. THE HARD PART: verification. Anyone can prompt Claude into producing something that LOOKS finished. I've seen plenty of AI output that claims to be great and is actually trash. Your value is building automations with tests, evals, and checkpoints that PROVE they work — correct data pulled, correct pages changed, no duplicate content, no broken sites, no
s sent to the wrong people. If you can't explain how you'd verify an agent's output without trusting the agent's own summary, don't apply.



3. WORDPRESS ? NEXT.JS MIGRATIONS. I'm moving several WordPress brand sites to Next.js on Vercel. This means rebuilding sites faithfully (design, content, forms, tracking), preserving SEO (301 redirects, metadata, structured data, sitemaps), and setting them up so future edits can be made through Claude Code — no page builders, no plugins, no WordPress.



4. Depending on fit, you may also work on existing application projects (a client gallery/print store, an internal CRM) — possibly alongside my other developer. Same stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Supabase, Vercel, Stripe.



The end goal: everything built cleanly enough that I can maintain and update all of it myself using Claude Code. You are building systems, then making yourself less necessary for day-to-day changes. If that bothers you, this isn't your job — the runway is long anyway, because I have more brands and more automation ideas than one person can build.



How we work:

- AI-assisted development is expected. You'll use Claude Code (I provide the plan/subscription). I care that you direct it well, review its output critically, and catch its mistakes — not that you type every line.

- Third-party integrations must stay within each platform's terms of service. If something I ask for would violate an API's rules, I expect you to tell me and propose a compliant alternative.

- All infrastructure stays under my accounts (GitHub, Vercel, Supabase, API keys). You're added as a collaborator. Non-negotiable.

- Milestone-based delivery with clear acceptance criteria. I review fast, I respond fast, I pay on time.

- Starts with a small paid trial task so we both see if it's a fit.



Requirements:

- You have actually built agentic AI workflows before — Claude Code skills/subagents, MCP servers or connectors, scheduled LLM pipelines, or similar. Not "I use ChatGPT a lot." Built, shipped, running.

- Strong TypeScript + Next.js; at least one production app shipped

- Comfortable integrating third-party APIs from documentation (OAuth, webhooks, rate limits)

- WordPress-to-modern-stack migration experience is a strong plus, especially SEO preservation

- You can scope ambiguous requests: ask the right questions, propose a plan, break it into milestones

- Writes tests and evals; can explain how you verify automated output, not just that "it ran"

- Reliable communication in English, available for async work with occasional overlap to European hours



Rate: $8/hr to start.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — applications ignoring this are deleted):

Start your application with the word SEXTANT. Then answer, in your own words:

1. Describe one AI agent, Claude skill, or LLM automation you built that ran repeatedly in production. What did it do, and how did you VERIFY its output was correct — beyond reading the AI's own summary?

2. You're asked to automate weekly SEO content publishing across multiple sites. Name three ways this could silently go wrong, and how you'd design the system to catch each one before damage is done.

3. Link to one production project you built (live URL or repo) and state exactly which parts were yours.

title: Outbound Sales Specialist
description:
Outbound Sales Specialist - Cold
, Lead Generation, and Pipeline Management (Full-Time)

We're a US-based performance marketing agency. We just built our CRM and cold
 outbound infrastructure from scratch with a HubSpot Gold Partner. The system is live, domains are warming, and we need someone to step in and run it full-time.

You're not building anything. The machine is built. You're operating it.



What You're Walking Into

A fully configured HubSpot CRM with pipelines, deal stages, automations, and reporting dashboards. Cold
 infrastructure on Instantly with multiple sending domains and mailboxes, all authenticated and warming. A prospect data source set up for local B2B targeting. 3 campaign sequences already built with follow-ups and personalization. Full system documentation and a live training session with the person who built it, plus 15 days of direct support from them.

You're taking over a running system with real data, not starting from scratch.



What You'll Be Doing

Cold
 campaign management. You'll manage and optimize campaigns in Instantly across 30 to 50 mailboxes sending roughly 1,000
s per day. You monitor deliverability daily: open rates, bounce rates, spam complaints, inbox placement. If something looks off, you pause and fix it before it becomes a problem. You write new
 sequences, test different subject lines and messaging, and scale what works.



The copy has to sound human. Not AI-generated, not templated, not salesy. You're writing like a real person reaching out to another real person. If you rely on ChatGPT to write your
s without heavy editing, this isn't the right fit.

Lead generation and list building. You'll build targeted prospect lists for local professional services businesses (dental clinics, law firms, real estate agencies, home services companies) in a specific metro area. You'll use tools like Apollo or Google Maps scrapers depending on where the prospects actually live online. You verify every contact before it goes into a campaign. No bulk lists, no unverified data.



Pipeline management. When someone replies interested, you move them into HubSpot, update the deal stage, and flag them to the CEO with a one-line summary so he can take the meeting. You own the top of the funnel. The CEO closes. Your job is to get him in front of the right people.



 marketing. Plan and send newsletters on a regular cadence. Build nurture sequences for leads who responded but aren't ready to buy yet. Manage list health: bounces, unsubscribes, segmentation, suppression.



Reporting. Every Friday you deliver a weekly pipeline update:
s sent, open rates, reply rates, new leads, meetings booked, deals moving forward. First Monday of every month you deliver a full performance report: total volume, conversion rates, pipeline value, cost per lead, what's working, what's not, and what you're changing.



What We're Looking For

Experience managing cold
 campaigns at volume. Not setting up the infrastructure, actually running campaigns, writing sequences, and optimizing performance daily. You can look at a campaign doing 45% opens and 0.5% replies and immediately know 3 things to try.



Experience with Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, or similar cold
 tools. You know sending limits, warmup, rotation, and deliverability monitoring from the operator side.



Experience with HubSpot CRM. Managing deals, updating pipeline stages, using workflows. You don't need to be a HubSpot builder; you need to be a HubSpot user.



Experience building prospect lists using Apollo, Clay, Google Maps scrapers, or similar tools. You know how to filter by location, industry, company size, and title, and you verify before you send.



Strong
 copywriting. You can write a cold
 that sounds like a human wrote it in 2 minutes, not like a marketing team spent a week on it. Short, specific, and relevant to the person receiving it.



Comfortable with data. You read open rates, reply rates, bounce rates, and conversion numbers, and you know what they mean and what to do about them. You don't just report numbers; you act on them.



Self-starter. You own this function solo. Nobody tells you what to send today. You plan your week, manage your pipeline, and flag results. If a campaign is underperforming, you fix it before anyone asks.



Agency or B2B experience preferred but not required.



Details

Schedule: Full-time, Monday through Friday, aligned with US Eastern Time.

Compensation: $800 to $1,000/month depending on experience.

Start: Within the next 2 to 3 weeks. You'll receive a live training session with the person who built the system plus 15 days of direct support from them.

 Location: Remote. Philippines-based candidates preferred.



How to Apply

Answer these 3 questions. Applications that don't answer them will not be reviewed.

Describe a cold
 campaign you ran. What was the audience, how many
s did you send, what tools did you use, and what were the results? Give us real numbers: reply rate, meetings booked, deals closed.

You take over a campaign that's been running for 2 weeks. Open rates are 45%, but reply rates are under 1%. What's your diagnosis and what do you change first?

Write a cold
 (subject line and body) to a dental clinic owner in a mid-sized city. The offer is a free marketing audit. Write it right now, don't overthink it. We want to see how you actually write, not a polished portfolio piece.

title: Meta Ads Operator (Facebook / Instagram) — B2B + Home Services — $700+/mo Full Time, Long Term
description:
ABOUT US



We are a US marketing company that builds and runs the entire lead generation system for concrete and epoxy coating contractors. Ads, funnel, booking, follow up, all of it. Our clients are real businesses doing real revenue, and when our ads work their calendar fills with estimates worth two to eight thousand dollars each.



We are growing fast and we need someone to own the day to day of the ad accounts so our founder can stop doing it.



This is NOT a strategy job. Our campaigns are built, our winning ads are written, our targeting is documented, our tracking is built. We have a playbook that works and we run it the same way every time. We need a careful, consistent operator to execute it across every account, watch the numbers daily, and tell us the second something looks wrong.



If you want to redesign our funnel and test 40 creatives, this is the wrong job. If you like running a proven system precisely and never dropping a ball, keep reading.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Launching (B2C, our clients)



Launch new client campaigns off our template. Same structure every time

Load our proven ad copy and creative, swapping in that client's city, offer and warranty

Apply our exact ad naming convention and our exact UTM string, no variation

Verify the pixel and events are firing correctly BEFORE anything spends

Confirm every new account is using that client's own pixel, never another client's



Running (B2C, our clients)



Daily check across every account: spend, cost per lead, delivery, frequency

Weekly: refresh fatigued creative from our library, rotate headlines in our test order

Verify our three number check ties out: CRM contacts, Events Manager leads, Ads Manager results. We will train you on exactly what healthy looks like

Watch Event Match Quality weekly and flag anything below the threshold we set

Flag anything that spikes or goes quiet. You pause and flag. You do not change budgets



Our own B2B lead flow (this half matters as much as the client half)



Own the top of funnel that brings coating company owners into our own machine

Build and maintain the retargeting layer: video viewers, page engagers, site visitors, lead list lookalikes, and the exclusion audiences so we never pay twice for the same person

Track the full path and know your numbers at every step: ad click ? lead ? application submitted ? booked call

Optimize for applications and booked calls, not for cheap leads. A $9 lead that never applies is worse than a $30 lead that books

Own ROAS on this funnel and be able to explain the number without being asked

Keep UTM tracking clean end to end so every booked call can be traced back to the exact ad that produced it. This is non negotiable and we will show you our exact standard



Creative direction (you direct, we pay for production)



Tell us what creative you need and why, based on what the data is showing

Write the brief: format, hook, first frame, the angle, the proof, the CTA

We have an editor and a budget. You do not have to make it, you have to know what to ask for and when

Track which creative is actually producing and retire what is not



Google Ads (nice to have, not required)



If you know Google Ads and Local Services Ads, say so. Some of our clients want search and Map Pack traffic, and it would be a real plus. Not a dealbreaker if Meta is your lane



Reporting (this is a big part of the job)



Post a clean weekly report into each client's Slack channel, in our format

Lead with booked appointments and cost per appointment. Not impressions, not reach

Post a daily internal summary line for our team across all accounts

Keep a simple running log per account so we can see the trend, not just today



Optimizing



Every account fully optimized, every week, no exceptions. No account gets forgotten

Follow our documented scale and cut rules. We will give them to you in writing

Bring us a short recommendation when you see something. We d
, you execute



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO



We are being upfront so nobody is disappointed.



You will not set or change budgets. Our founder approves every spend change

You will not turn campaigns on. You prepare them, we flip them live

You will not redesign the funnel, rewrite the offer, or restructure winning ads

You will not talk to clients on calls. You report in writing, our account manager owns the relationship

You will not have access to our master accounts or any credentials beyond the specific ad accounts you work in



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



Required:



At least 2 years running Meta ads with real money, on lead generation, not ecommerce

You genuinely understand: website conversion campaigns, the Lead event, the learning phase, attribution windows, and why you do not judge an ad on day one

You can read Events Manager and tell whether a pixel is actually working

You understand UTM tracking properly and can explain why a booked call has to trace back to a specific ad. If UTMs are a mystery to you this is not your job

You have optimized a funnel past the lead, meaning you have been held accountable for applications, calls booked or sales, not just cost per lead

You can write a creative brief that an editor can actually execute from

Written English good enough to write a client facing report with zero typos

Detail obsessed. This job is a checklist run correctly 200 times. If you skip a step, a client loses money and we lose a client

Reliable internet and a computer that can run several ad accounts at once

Available with at least 4 hours overlapping US Eastern business hours



Nice to have, not required:



Google Ads and Local Services Ads experience. This is the single biggest plus on this list

Home services, contractors, or roofing/flooring experience

B2B lead generation, especially selling to business owners

Basic Canva or video editing for quick creative variants

You have used a white labeled CRM before



HOURS AND PAY



Full time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday

At least 4 hours overlapping US Eastern time

$700 per month, flat

Paid every two weeks, on time, every time

Reviewed at 90 days with a raise if you are running the system clean

This is a long term seat, not a project. We are growing and the person who owns this well grows with it



We would rather pay one careful person properly for years than churn through cheap ones. If you are the kind of operator who never lets an account go a week without eyes on it, you will do very well here.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send a generic application. We read every reply and we delete anything that ignores these steps.



Put COATING OPS as the first two words of your subject line

In your first paragraph, answer this in your own words, no AI: "An ad set has spent $180 over 3 days with zero leads. Walk me through the first four things you check, in order." We are looking at your order of operations, not your vocabulary

Second question, one short paragraph: "Cost per lead is down 40 percent this month and booked calls are flat. What is probably happening and what do you do about it?"

Tell us the largest monthly ad budget you have personally managed, and for what kind of business

Send a screenshot of an Ads Manager view from an account you actually ran. Blur the client name. We want to see you have really been in there

Tell us whether you have run Google Ads, and your internet speed and available hours in US Eastern time



Applications missing any of the six get skipped. Not because we are strict, because this job is about following a process exactly, and this is the first test of that.

title: Customer Support Specialist

We default to “partner” language throughout our team, our tools, and our documentation, and your day-to-day will use that language too.



About Edstruments



Edstruments empowers K12 and nonprofit leaders with modern financial software spanning the Procure-to-Pay lifecycle and Budget Planning & Management. Our platform helps our partners align their spending and budgets to strategic objectives so that they can best achieve their mission. As a fast-growing startup, we add several new partners each month, and our platform is currently in use by organizations across multiple states in the US. We are seeking individuals who are excited to play a critical role in helping our partners achieve their missions.



Role Overview



The Customer Support Specialist will be the first line of defense on chat and
, helping our partners resolve technical and administrative issues, ensuring smooth communication, and troubleshooting challenges. You will manage incoming chats and
s, track tickets, and ensure partner needs are met efficiently. The role also involves vendor outreach, administrative tasks, and product setup for new clients. You handle most questions yourself by checking our documentation and Slack history first, escalate with what you have already tried and found, and keep partners and teammates updated without being asked. Over time, you will have opportunities to take on more advanced roles as you grow with the company.



Key Responsibilities



* First-Contact Resolution: Independently troubleshoot and resolve partner inquiries, checking our documentation and Slack history before escalating, ensuring a 70% first-contact resolution rate for partner inquiries. [Within the first 3 months of joining].

* Response Time: Respond to partner inquiries within 5 minutes for chats and 3 hours for
s during your regular business hours. [Ongoing].

* Ticket Management: Manage support conversations in Intercom and track work on Trello cards to ensure all issues are resolved promptly. Close 90% of inquiries within 48 hours.

* Client Onboarding: Assist with the initial setup of our systems when a new client onboards to ensure successful data syncs with a 90% success rate.

* Vendor Outreach & Admin: Provide support with vendor outreach and administrative tasks, as needed. [Ongoing].

* Collaboration: Work with the Partner Success and Product teams to communicate findings from partner interactions and ensure partner needs are addressed. [Ongoing].



Key Outcomes



* Achieve a 4.5/5 satisfaction rating or higher for partner support interactions (chat/email).

* Close 90% of support tickets within 48 hours of receiving inquiries.

* Ensure 90% success rate for assigned client onboarding tasks.

* Own inquiries end to end: resolve the majority independently and close the loop with the partner, escalating only with clear context on what you’ve already tried.



Must-Have Qualifications



* 2+ years of experience in technical support, software support, or a related role.

* Strong technical aptitude and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn and troubleshoot software-related issues.

* Experience with support and ticketing tools (Intercom, HubSpot, or similar) and a proven ability to resolve customer issues in a timely manner.

* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present technical information clearly to non-technical users.

* Strong attention to detail and excellent time management skills.

* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

* Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to research answers, draft partner replies, and work faster.

* Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision: you find answers, make a judgment call, and proactively communicate status without being chased.

title: Youtube & Podcast growing
description:
YouTube Growth Strategist & Channel Manager – German-Speaking Market (Long-Term)



Hi, my name is Thomas Matisheck. I am a German tax advisor specializing in e-commerce, digital business models, online entrepreneurs, and content creators.



I have been consistently creating content for some time, but unfortunately, my YouTube channel and podcast are growing much more slowly than I would like.



**YouTube:**


)



**Podcast:**

[
](
)



My current audience is approximately:



* 4,080 YouTube subscribers

* 211 podcast followers

* 360 newsletter subscribers



## Important: My Content Is 100% German



My YouTube channel, podcast, Shorts, newsletter, and all other content are **exclusively in German**.



My target audience is also almost exclusively based in **Germany and the German-speaking market**.



This is very important for this position.



I am not looking for someone who simply applies the same generic YouTube strategy used for English-speaking channels.



**This is not a copy-and-paste job.**



Topics, titles, thumbnails, competitors, search behavior, wording, and audience psychology have to work specifically for a **German-speaking audience**.



You therefore need to be comfortable analyzing German content.



You do not necessarily have to be a native German speaker, but you must have a reliable way to understand and evaluate German videos, titles, thumbnails, comments, competitors, and audience behavior.



## My Current Content Process



I currently publish approximately one long-form piece of content every two weeks.



I alternate between:



* interviews with guests, and

* videos about taxes, business, entrepreneurship, e-commerce, and related topics.



The same long-form content is published both on YouTube and as a podcast.



In addition:



* I use OpusClip to create short-form content from my long-form videos,

* I publish Shorts/Reels on Instagram and TikTok,

* I have a small
 newsletter that I use to promote new YouTube videos and podcast episodes.



So the content is already there.



**What is missing is growth.**



## Who I Am Looking For



I am **not looking for just a video editor or a general Virtual Assistant.**



I am looking for someone who truly understands:



* YouTube Growth

* Content Strategy

* Audience Development

* YouTube Analytics

* CTR optimization

* Audience retention

* Titles and thumbnails

* Competitor research

* Content ideation

* Shorts strategy



I need someone who can analyze my existing channel and help me understand **why it is not growing faster**.



I want you to look at the data and help answer questions such as:



* What is already working?

* What is not working?

* Are my topics attractive enough?

* Are my titles and thumbnails strong enough?

* Is my channel positioning clear enough?

* How can we improve CTR?

* How can we improve watch time and audience retention?

* Which topics should I create content about in the future?

* Which topics have the highest potential in my German niche?

* How can we use Shorts more effectively to grow the main YouTube channel?

* How can YouTube, my podcast, Instagram, TikTok, and my newsletter work together more effectively?

* What are successful German channels in my niche – or comparable niches – doing better?

* Which strategies from international channels can realistically be adapted to the German market?



## My Goal



My goal is **not simply to produce more content**.



I already produce content regularly.



My goal is to build a system that turns the content I am already producing into:



* more reach,

* more relevant subscribers,

* more podcast listeners,

* and greater authority within my niche in Germany.



I am interested in **relevant growth**, not vanity metrics.



The audience should ideally consist of entrepreneurs, e-commerce sellers, content creators, online business owners, and other people who are genuinely relevant to my business.



## Long-Term Collaboration



Ideally, I am looking for someone who can work with me long-term – not someone who just gives me a few generic recommendations.



I want someone who can:



**Analyze ? Develop a strategy ? Implement ? Measure ? Improve**



You should challenge my current approach when necessary.



If a topic is bad, tell me.



If my thumbnails are weak, tell me.



If the positioning of my channel is unclear, tell me.



I am looking for someone who takes responsibility for helping the channel grow – not someone who simply completes tasks.



## Experience



Ideally, you have already helped grow YouTube channels and can show examples and results.



Experience with the following types of channels would be particularly interesting:



* Educational content

* Business

* Finance

* Professional services

* Personal brands

* Entrepreneurship



Experience with the German-speaking market is a major advantage.



## Please Answer These Questions When Applying



Please do **not** send me a generic copy-and-paste application.



Instead, take a look at my YouTube channel first and answer these questions:



1. What would you analyze first when looking at my YouTube channel?



2. After a quick review, what are the **three biggest problems or opportunities** you currently see?



3. Give me **one example of a video/topic/title on my channel that you would change** and explain what you would do differently.



4. Have you helped other YouTube channels grow? Please share specific examples and results.



5. Which tools do you use for YouTube analytics, keyword research, competitor research, and content ideation?



6. How would you analyze a YouTube channel when the content and target audience are in German?



7. What would your general strategy be to grow my channel over the next 6–12 months?



I will give preference to applicants who actually look at my channel and provide a **specific answer instead of a generic application**.



If you believe you can help me build a significantly larger and more relevant audience in the German-speaking market, I would love to hear from you.

title: Loan Officer Assistant - Remote (PH)
description:
Loan Officer Assistant – Remote (PH)



Dominion Financial Services (DFS) is a nationally recognized private lender dedicated to supporting real estate investors. With a focus on Short-Term Bridge Loans and Long-Term Rental Loans, DFS empowers clients to scale their businesses and build lasting generational wealth. DFS stands out as a leader, consistently achieving strong, measurable growth quarter after quarter.



At Dominion, we are committed to building a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. We embrace emerging technologies, including AI, to help our team members work more efficiently, solve problems more effectively, and create greater impact in their roles. Employees are encouraged to explore new tools and processes that improve productivity, enhance the customer experience, and support the company's growth.

·        Accountable & Dependable

·        Team Centric

·        System & Process Oriented

·        Service Ethic

We are seeking a personable, professional, and highly organized Loan Officer Assistant to support our lending team by serving as the primary point of contact for borrowers during the document collection process.



In this role, your primary responsibility is to build positive relationships with borrowers, guide them through the documentation process, and ensure all required information is collected in a timely manner. Our proprietary technology, AI tools, and borrower portal handle much of the file preparation and analysis, allowing you to focus on delivering an outstanding customer experience and keeping loans moving efficiently.



This position is ideal for someone with excellent communication skills, a positive attitude, strong follow-up abilities, and a passion for providing exceptional customer service.



Key Responsibilities

·        Contact borrowers via phone,
, and text to request and collect required loan documentation.

·        Build rapport with borrowers while providing professional, responsive, and courteous service throughout the loan process.

·        Clearly explain documentation requirements and next steps.

·        Maintain consistent follow-up to ensure outstanding documents are received promptly.

·        Exceptional organizational and time management skills.

·        Comfortable managing multiple borrower files simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

·        Proficient with Microsoft Office applications.

·        Comfortable learning and utilizing CRM platforms and AI-powered technology.

·        Reliable high-speed internet connection and a quiet home office environment.

Mortgage experience is beneficial but not required. We value communication skills, professionalism, and a strong customer service mindset above all else.

Dominion Financial Services embraces artificial intelligence as part of our daily operations. Team members are provided with access to AI tools that streamline administrative tasks, improve efficiency, and support better communication. We seek individuals who are comfortable adopting new technology and eager to leverage AI to enhance their productivity.



Compensation & Benefits

·        Full-time (40 hours per week)
