·        U.S. Eastern Time working hours

·        Long-term employment opportunity

·        Access to AI tools to support daily work

·        Collaborative, team-oriented environment

title: E-Commerce Product Image & AI Visual Specialist — Virtual Assistant
description:
We are looking for a **detail-oriented Virtual Assistant who specializes in e-commerce product images and AI-generated visual content**.



This position is focused **exclusively on product photography, image editing, AI visual creation, and image organization**. You will not be responsible for titles, descriptions, pricing, inventory, or general listing management.



You will work across several e-commerce brands and marketplaces, following a specific visual structure and style guide for each brand.



## Main Responsibilities



* Redesign and improve existing product images that currently look supplier-made, AliExpress-style, inconsistent, or low quality.

* Create professional **hero/product images**.

* Create realistic **lifestyle images** showing products in appropriate environments.

* Create feature and benefit graphics.

* Create size, dimension, and "what's included" graphics when needed.

* Remove and replace backgrounds.

* Improve lighting, composition, cropping, and overall presentation.

* Rebuild unattractive supplier graphics into clean branded designs.

* Create multiple image variations for different products and marketplaces.

* Maintain visual consistency within each brand.

* Follow established image templates and image-order structures.

* Organize completed images by product/SKU.

* Upload approved images through **Shopify photo access** when assigned.

* Work through products systematically and track which image sets are completed.



## Tools You Will Be Given Access To



You will receive access to:



* **Photoroom**

* **Midjourney**

* **Shopify photo/image access**



Additional templates, reference images, brand guidelines, and instructions will be provided.



## Very Important: Product Accuracy



AI should enhance the presentation of the product, **not redesign the product itself**.



You must be able to use the original product images as the source of truth.



You may improve:



* Background

* Environment

* Lighting

* Composition

* Shadows

* Presentation

* Supporting graphics



You may **not** change:



* Product shape

* Product color

* Pattern

* Hardware

* Number of pieces

* Accessories included

* Packaging

* Logos

* Materials

* Important product details



If AI changes the actual product, the image must be corrected or recreated.



**Never guess what a product looks like.**



## Types of Products



You may work with several different categories, including:



* Pet products and accessories

* Home products

* Live orchid arrangements and planters

* Clothing and accessories

* Resale merchandise

* Giftable products



Each brand has a different visual identity. You must be able to switch styles while still following the provided brand structure.



## Example Image Set



Depending on the product, an image set may include:



1. Clean hero image

2. Lifestyle/use image

3. Product feature image

4. Benefit/problem-solution image

5. Dimensions or sizing image

6. Close-up/detail image

7. Additional lifestyle or promotional image



Not every product will use the exact same structure. You will receive instructions for each brand and product category.



## What We Are Looking For



You should have experience with:



* E-commerce product photography or product image editing

* Photoroom

* Midjourney or similar AI image-generation tools

* Creating realistic AI lifestyle scenes

* Background replacement

* Product compositing

* Image cleanup

* Maintaining accurate product details

* Shopify product images

* Organized file management



Experience creating images for Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, Etsy, eBay, TikTok Shop, Poshmark, or similar marketplaces is a major plus.



## You Must Be



* Extremely detail-oriented

* Organized

* Able to follow visual instructions exactly

* Comfortable receiving corrections and revising images

* Able to work independently once a visual template has been approved

* Consistent with image quality

* Able to recognize when AI has distorted a product

* Fast without sacrificing accuracy



## This Position Is NOT



This is **not** a general VA position.



You will not primarily be:



* Writing product descriptions

* Researching keywords

* Managing inventory

* Handling customer service

* Changing product prices

* Managing marketplace accounts

* Creating random social media graphics



Your primary responsibility is **creating and improving e-commerce product images**.



## When Applying



Please include:



1. Your hourly rate

2. Your availability per week

3. Your experience with Photoroom

4. Your experience with Midjourney

5. Your experience creating e-commerce product images

6. Links to examples of product images, lifestyle images, or AI product photography you personally created

7. A brief explanation of how you prevent AI from changing the actual product



**Please do not send a generic VA application. We are specifically looking for someone who is strong in product imagery and AI-assisted e-commerce visual production.**
